*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form SENDED_DATA_CHECK
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM data_vaildation TABLES pt_log STRUCTURE zmmt0022
                                    CHANGING pv_result pv_msg.

  DATA : lv_result TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  DATA : lv_msg TYPE c LENGTH 255.


  DATA(lt_data) = pt_log[].
  SORT lt_data BY bukrs banfn bnfpo.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_data COMPARING bukrs banfn bnfpo.

  DATA(lv_line) = lines( lt_data[] ).
  DATA(lv_line_origin) = lines( pt_log[] ).

  IF lv_line NE lv_line_origin.

  ENDIF.


  SELECT *
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_srm_send)
  FROM zmmt0020
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @pt_log
  WHERE bukrs = @pt_log-bukrs
      AND banfn = @pt_log-banfn
      AND bnfpo = @pt_log-bnfpo.

  SELECT *
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_eban)
    FROM eban
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @pt_log
        WHERE banfn = @pt_log-banfn
        AND bnfpo = @pt_log-bnfpo.

*--PR 반려 시 해당 PR 로 진행된 PO 가 취소되어야 반려
  SELECT *
    FROM ekpo
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @pt_log
        WHERE banfn = @pt_log-banfn  "구매요청
        AND bnfpo = @pt_log-bnfpo "구매요청품목
        AND loekz IS INITIAL "취소되지 않은 PO가 있으면 처리불가 전부 취소되어야 반려
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_ekpo).

  SORT lt_srm_send BY banfn bnfpo.

  IF lt_srm_send[] IS NOT INITIAL.

    LOOP AT pt_log INTO DATA(ls_data).

      CLEAR : lv_msg, lv_result.

      IF ls_data-bukrs IS INITIAL. " 회사코드 확인.
        lv_msg = TEXT-m21.
        lv_result  = 'E'.
        ls_data-picode = lv_result.
        ls_data-pimsg = lv_msg.
        MODIFY pt_log FROM ls_data TRANSPORTING picode pimsg.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      IF ls_data-banfn IS INITIAL. " 요청 번호 확인
        lv_msg = TEXT-m22.
        lv_result  = 'E'.
        ls_data-picode = lv_result.
        ls_data-pimsg = lv_msg.
        MODIFY pt_log FROM ls_data TRANSPORTING picode pimsg.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      IF ls_data-bnfpo IS INITIAL. "품목 확인.
        lv_msg = TEXT-m24.
        lv_result  = 'E'.
        ls_data-picode = lv_result.
        ls_data-pimsg = lv_msg.
        MODIFY pt_log FROM ls_data TRANSPORTING picode pimsg.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.


      IF ls_data-status IS INITIAL. "상태 확인.
        lv_msg = TEXT-m23.
        lv_result  = 'E'.
        ls_data-picode = lv_result.
        ls_data-pimsg = lv_msg.
        MODIFY pt_log FROM ls_data TRANSPORTING picode pimsg.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.


      IF ls_data-status NE 'R'. "상태 R 확인.
        lv_msg = TEXT-m36.
        lv_result  = 'E'.
        ls_data-picode = lv_result.
        ls_data-pimsg = lv_msg.
        MODIFY pt_log FROM ls_data TRANSPORTING picode pimsg.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.


      READ TABLE lt_srm_send INTO DATA(ls_srm_send) WITH KEY banfn = ls_data-banfn
                                                 bnfpo = ls_data-bnfpo.
      IF ls_srm_send-status EQ 'R'.
*    이미 반려된 경우 공통 로그 처리만
        lv_msg = TEXT-e33.
        lv_result  = 'E'.
        ls_data-picode = lv_result.
        ls_data-pimsg = lv_msg.
        MODIFY pt_log FROM ls_data TRANSPORTING picode pimsg.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

*--PR 반려 시 취소되지 않은 구매오더가 있는 경우 취소 처리 불가 유효한 PO 가 없어야반려처리
      READ TABLE lt_ekpo INTO DATA(LS_EKPo) WITH KEY banfn = ls_data-banfn
                                                                                                bnfpo = ls_data-bnfpo.

      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        SELECT SINGLE a~ebeln, a~ebelp
          FROM ekpo AS a
          INNER JOIN ekko AS b
          ON a~ebeln EQ b~ebeln
           WHERE a~banfn EQ @ls_EKPO-banfn
               AND a~bnfpo EQ @ls_EKPO-bnfpo
                AND b~bsart EQ 'ZIC'
              AND a~elikz EQ @gc_x
          INTO @DATA(ls_zic).

        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

        ELSE.
          lv_msg = TEXT-e32.
          lv_result  = 'E'.
          ls_data-picode = lv_result.
          ls_data-pimsg = lv_msg.
          MODIFY pt_log FROM ls_data TRANSPORTING picode pimsg.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.


*      READ TABLE lt_EBAN INTO DATA(ls_eban) WITH KEY banfn = ls_data-banfn
*                                                 bnfpo = ls_data-bnfpo.
*      IF ls_eban-statu EQ 'B'. "구매오더 생성 지시자
**    구매오더로 전환된 구매요청인 경우 SRM 반려로 취소 불가
*        "2025.04.24 ZIC 관계사 po로 전환 pr의 경우 취소
*        SELECT SINGLE a~ebeln, a~ebelp
*          FROM ekpo AS a
*          INNER JOIN ekko AS b
*          ON a~ebeln EQ b~ebeln
*           WHERE a~banfn EQ @ls_eban-banfn
*               AND a~bnfpo EQ @ls_eban-bnfpo
*                AND b~bsart EQ 'ZIC'
*              AND a~elikz EQ @gc_x
*          INTO @DATA(ls_zic).
*
*        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*
*
*
*        ELSE.
*          lv_msg = TEXT-e32.
*          lv_result  = 'E'.
*          ls_data-picode = lv_result.
*          ls_data-pimsg = lv_msg.
*          MODIFY pt_log FROM ls_data TRANSPORTING picode pimsg.
*          CONTINUE.
*        ENDIF.
**        lv_msg = TEXT-e32.
**        lv_result  = 'E'.
**        ls_data-picode = lv_result.
**        ls_data-pimsg = lv_msg.
**        MODIFY pt_log FROM ls_data TRANSPORTING picode pimsg.
**        CONTINUE.
*      ENDIF.

    ENDLOOP.



    READ TABLE pt_log INTO DATA(ls_log) WITH KEY picode = 'E'.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      pv_result = 'E'.
      pv_msg = ls_log-pimsg.
    ENDIF.


  ELSE.

    "" 리턴 에러 처리.
    pv_result = 'E'.
*    pv_msg = '수신받은 데이터 중 SRM 전송 이력이 있는 데이터가 없습니다'.
    pv_msg = TEXT-e36.

    MODIFY pt_log FROM VALUE #( pimsg  = pv_msg
                                picode = pv_result )
                                                TRANSPORTING pimsg picode
                                                WHERE picode <> pv_result.

  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form BAPI_PR_DELETE&CBO_UPDATE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM bapi_pr_delete_update TABLES pt_log STRUCTURE zmmt0022
                                                  CHANGING ps_out STRUCTURE zsifmsg.

  DATA : lv_number TYPE bapieban-preq_no,
         lt_delete TYPE TABLE OF bapieband  WITH HEADER LINE,
         lt_return TYPE TABLE OF bapireturn WITH HEADER LINE,
         ls_return TYPE bapiret2.

  DATA : BEGIN OF lt_del OCCURS 0,
           banfn LIKE eban-banfn,   " PR No.
           bnfpo LIKE eban-bnfpo,   " PR Item.
         END OF lt_del.

  DATA : lt_0020 LIKE TABLE OF zmmt0020 WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA : lt_0025 LIKE TABLE OF zmmt0025 WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA : ls_0025 LIKE zmmt0025.



  DATA(lt_log) = pt_log[].

  """"""""""MES의 요청으로 인해 생성된 구매요청 취소  후 0090 삭제 업데이트.
  SELECT *
    FROM zmmt0090
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_log
    WHERE banfn EQ @lt_log-banfn
    AND bnfpo EQ @lt_log-bnfpo
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_0090).
  ""SRM 요청 삭제
  SELECT *
    FROM zmmt0150
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_log
    WHERE banfn EQ @lt_log-banfn
    AND bnfpo EQ @lt_log-bnfpo
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_0150).

  SELECT banfn, bnfpo
    FROM zmmt0090
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_log
    WHERE banfn EQ @lt_log-banfn
    AND bnfpo EQ @lt_log-bnfpo
    INTO TABLE @lt_del.

  SELECT *
    FROM zmmt0020
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_log
    WHERE banfn EQ @lt_log-banfn
    AND bnfpo EQ @lt_log-bnfpo
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_0020_old).

  SELECT *
    FROM zmmt0025
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_log
    WHERE banfn EQ @lt_log-banfn
    AND bnfpo EQ @lt_log-bnfpo
    AND zzredate EQ @sy-datum
    AND zzseq EQ ( SELECT  MAX( zzseq ) AS zzseq
                              FROM zmmt0025
                              WHERE banfn EQ @lt_log-banfn
                                  AND bnfpo EQ @lt_log-bnfpo
                                  AND zzredate EQ @sy-datum )
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_0025_old).


*SELECT SINGLE a~banfn, a~bnfpo, a~zzredat, max( a~zzseq ) as zzseq
*    FROM zmmt0025 as a
*    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_log
*    WHERE banfn EQ @lt_log-banfn
*    AND bnfpo EQ @lt_log-bnfpo
*    and zzredate eq @sy-datum
*    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_0025_old).

*  SELECT a~banfn, a~bnfpo, a~zzredat, MAX( a~zzseq ) AS zzseq
*      FROM zmmt0025 AS a
*      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_log
*      WHERE banfn EQ @lt_log-banfn
*      AND bnfpo EQ @lt_log-bnfpo
*      AND zzredate EQ @sy-datum
*
*    GROUP BY a~banfn, a~bnfpo, a~zzredate
*      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_0025_old.
*  .


  IF lt_del[] IS NOT INITIAL. " 반려 전 취소할 요청이 있는 경우

    SORT lt_del BY banfn bnfpo.

    LOOP AT lt_del.

      AT NEW banfn.
        CLEAR : lt_delete, lt_return.
        REFRESH : lt_delete, lt_return.

        "Header.
        lv_number = lt_del-banfn.           " PR Doc.
      ENDAT.

      " Item.
      lt_delete-preq_item  = lt_del-bnfpo.  " PR Item.
      lt_delete-delete_ind = 'X'.          " DEL Indicator.
      APPEND lt_delete. CLEAR lt_delete.

      AT END OF banfn.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_REQUISITION_DELETE'
          EXPORTING
            number                      = lv_number
          TABLES
            requisition_items_to_delete = lt_delete
            return                      = lt_return.

        READ TABLE lt_return WITH KEY code = 'W5041'."구매요청이 변경되었습니다.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
            EXPORTING
              wait = 'X'.

          LOOP AT Lt_0090 INTO DATA(ls_s) WHERE banfn = lv_number.

            CLEAR : ls_s-banfn, ls_s-bnfpo. " 구매요청 삭제 후 0090 테이블 구매요청 클리어


            MODIFY lt_0090 FROM ls_s.
          ENDLOOP.

        ELSE.
          CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.
*          gv_error = 'X'.

        ENDIF.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.


*  MES의 자재 이동 요청에 대한 취소 진행

  LOOP AT pt_log INTO DATA(ls_data).


    READ TABLE lt_0090 INTO DATA(ls_0090) WITH KEY banfn = ls_data-banfn
                                          bnfpo = ls_data-bnfpo.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      IF ls_0090-banfn IS NOT INITIAL  AND ls_0090-bnfpo IS NOT INITIAL. " 구매요청 삭제지시자 bapi 실패로 00090 구매요청이 남아있는 경우 에러처리.
        ls_data-picode = 'E'.
        ls_data-pimsg = TEXT-e31. "자재이동요청으로 생성된 구매요청 취소 중 에러발생
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    IF ls_data-picode NE 'E'. "실패가 없는 경우 전송 이력 테이블 업데이트.

      READ TABLE lt_0020_old INTO DATA(ls_0020_old) WITH KEY banfn = ls_data-banfn
                                                                                           bnfpo = ls_data-bnfpo.

      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        ls_0020_old-status = 'R'.
        ls_0020_old-remeg = ls_data-remeg.
        APPEND ls_0020_old TO lt_0020.

        "  반려 처리 시 스탠다드 업데이트. 추가 요청 사항.
        UPDATE eban SET zzstatus = ls_0020_old-status WHERE banfn = ls_0020_old-banfn
                                                                                               AND bnfpo = ls_0020_old-bnfpo.
        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
          COMMIT WORK.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      ls_0025-bukrs = ls_data-bukrs.
      ls_0025-banfn = ls_data-banfn.
      ls_0025-bnfpo = ls_data-bnfpo.
      ls_0025-zzredate = sy-datum.

      "?수신일자 기준으로 seq 확인.
      SELECT SINGLE MAX( zzseq ) AS seq
        FROM zmmt0025 AS a
        WHERE a~banfn EQ @ls_data-banfn
            AND a~bnfpo EQ @ls_data-bnfpo
            AND a~zzredate EQ @sy-datum
            INTO @DATA(lv_seq).

      IF lv_seq IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_seq = lv_seq + 1.
      ELSE.
        "초기값
        LV_seq = 1.
      ENDIF.

      ls_0025-zzseq = lv_seq.
      ls_0025-remesg = ls_data-remeg.
      ls_0025-ernam = sy-uname.
      ls_0025-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_0025-erzet = sy-uzeit.

      APPEND ls_0025 TO lt_0025.
      CLEAR : ls_0025.

    ENDIF.


    MODIFY pt_log FROM ls_data.
  ENDLOOP.


*--이력 테이블 반려 업데이트, MES 구매요청의 경우 클리어.
  IF lt_0090[] IS NOT INITIAL.
    TRY.
        MODIFY zmmt0090 FROM TABLE lt_0090."클리어 된 이력
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(l_oref).
        DATA(l_text) = l_oref->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDIF.
  IF lt_0020[] IS NOT INITIAL.

    TRY.
        MODIFY zmmt0020 FROM TABLE lt_0020.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lv_oref).
        DATA(lv_text) = lv_oref->get_text( ).
        CONCATENATE l_text lv_text INTO l_text SEPARATED BY '&'.
    ENDTRY.
    TRY.
        MODIFY zmmt0025 FROM TABLE lt_0025.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO lv_oref.
        lv_text = lv_oref->get_text( ).
        CONCATENATE l_text lv_text INTO l_text SEPARATED BY '&'.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDIF.


  IF l_text IS INITIAL.

    COMMIT WORK.

    ps_out-type = 'S'.
*    ps_out-message = '반려 처리가 정상적으로 진행되었습니다'.
    ps_out-message = TEXT-s01.

  ELSE.

    ROLLBACK WORK.

    ps_out-type = 'E'.
*    ps_out-message = '반려 처리 후 DB 저장에 실패했습니다.'.
    ps_out-message = TEXT-e34.



  ENDIF.



ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form READ_TEXT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LS_0021
*&      <-- LV_TEXT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM read_text USING ps_0021 STRUCTURE zmms_pr_sender_to_srm
                CHANGING pv_text.

  DATA : lv_ebanpo TYPE tdobname.
  DATA : lt_line LIKE TABLE OF tline.
  CLEAR : lv_ebanpo, lt_line[].

  lv_ebanpo = |{ ps_0021-banfn }{ ps_0021-bnfpo }|.

  CALL FUNCTION 'READ_TEXT'
    EXPORTING
      client          = sy-mandt
      id              = 'B01'
      language        = sy-langu
      name            = lv_ebanpo
      object          = 'EBAN'
      "HEADER = HTEXT
    TABLES
      lines           = lt_line
    EXCEPTIONS
      id              = 1
      language        = 2
      name            = 3
      not_found       = 4
      object          = 5
      reference_check = 6.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

    LOOP AT lt_line INTO DATA(ls_line).
      CONCATENATE pv_text ls_line-tdline INTO pv_text SEPARATED BY space.
    ENDLOOP.


  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.

FORM datax_pocomponents USING p_field01
                                  p_field02
                                  p_field03
                                  p_field04
                                  p_field05
                                  p_field06
                                  p_field07
                                  p_field08
                        CHANGING ps_datax STRUCTURE bapimepocomponentx
                                 ps_data STRUCTURE bapimepocomponent
                          .


  FIELD-SYMBOLS :<datax>, <cnt>, <val>, <data>.

  CLEAR : ps_datax, fieldname, l_n.

  DO 8 TIMES.
    ADD 1 TO l_n.
    CONCATENATE 'p_field' l_n INTO fieldname.

    ASSIGN (fieldname) TO <val>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF <val> IS NOT INITIAL.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <val> OF STRUCTURE ps_data TO <data>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
***>> ps_data가 존재하면 ps_datax를 설정하기 ***********************************
          IF <data> IS NOT INITIAL.

              ASSIGN COMPONENT <cnt> OF STRUCTURE ps_datax TO <datax>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                <datax> = 'X'.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
***<< ps_data가 존재하면 ps_datax를 설정하기 ***********************************
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDDO.


ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form CURRENCY_CONVSION
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> <FS_HEAD>_WAERS
*&      --> <FS_HEAD>_RMWWR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM currency_convsion USING p_waers
                                          p_amt.

  DATA currency        TYPE tcurc-waers.
  DATA amount_display  TYPE wmto_s-amount.
  DATA amount_internal TYPE wmto_s-amount.

  currency = p_waers.
  amount_display = p_amt.

  CALL FUNCTION 'CURRENCY_AMOUNT_DISPLAY_TO_SAP'
    EXPORTING
      currency        = currency
      amount_display  = amount_display
    IMPORTING
      amount_internal = amount_internal
    EXCEPTIONS
      internal_error  = 1
      OTHERS          = 2.

  p_amt = amount_internal.
ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form IF_HEADER_DATA_VALIDITION_0100
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> OT_ITEMS
*&      --> <FS_HEAD>
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form IF_HEADER_DATA_VALIDITION_0100
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> <FS_HEAD>
*&      <-- LT_OUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form IF_HEADER_DATA_VALIDITION_0100
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> <FS_HEAD>
*&      <-- LT_OUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM if_header_data_validition_0100 USING ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0100
                                     CHANGING ps_out STRUCTURE zmms_iv_create_out.



  CONSTANTS lc_1000(4) TYPE c VALUE '1000'.
  CONSTANTS lc_1001(4) TYPE c VALUE '1001'.
  CONSTANTS lc_1010(4) TYPE c VALUE '1010'.
  CONSTANTS lc_1101(4) TYPE c VALUE '1101'.
  CONSTANTS lc_1102(4) TYPE c VALUE '1102'.



  SELECT SINGLE *
    FROM zmmt0100
    WHERE if_srm_key EQ @ps_head-if_srm_key
        AND if_gubun EQ 'C'
        INTO @DATA(ls_0100).


  IF ps_head-IF_gubun = 'D'. " 인터페이스 취소인 경우.
*--수신 이력 확인
    " 처리 중지로 인해 'D' 삭세 수신 시 정상 처리 이력인 경우 예외 처리.

*-- 정상적으로 수신되어 송장 생성된 이력에 대해 취소 불가
    IF ls_0100 IS INITIAL.

      PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                         'E'
                                         TEXT-m59.
    ELSE.
      IF ls_0100-if_TYPE NE 'E'.

        PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                           'E'
                                           TEXT-m45.

      ENDIF.

      EXIT. " D 취소인 경우 이후 벨리데이션은 체크하지 않음.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE. "일반 처리

    IF ls_0100-if_type EQ 'S'.

      PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                     'E'
                                     TEXT-m06. "이미 전송 성공한 데이터입니다.


    ENDIF.


  ENDIF.

  "전기일 필수
  IF ps_head-budat IS INITIAL.


    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-m66..
  ENDIF.

  "회사코드 필수
  IF ps_head-bukrs IS INITIAL.


    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-m70..
  ENDIF.




  "금액 필수
  IF ps_head-rmwwr IS INITIAL OR ps_head-wrbtr1 IS INITIAL.


    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-m69.
  ENDIF.

  "영세율을 제외한 세금 필수
  IF ps_head-wmwst IS INITIAL.
    IF ps_head-mwskz EQ 'V0' OR  ps_head-mwskz EQ 'V7' OR  ps_head-mwskz EQ 'VZ'.

    ELSE.
      PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                         'E'
                                         TEXT-m96.

    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.



  "금액 필수

  IF ps_head-waers IS INITIAL.

    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-m68..
  ENDIF.




*-- 현재 가능한 Posting Period 인지 확인
  PERFORM budat_period_determine USING ps_head-bukrs
                                                      ps_head-budat
                                                      CHANGING  ps_out.


*-- 공급업체 확인
  SELECT SINGLE mandt INTO sy-mandt
    FROM lfm1
   WHERE lifnr = ps_head-lifnr.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.

    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                           'E'
                                           TEXT-m44.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

*--세금계산서 관련
  "PS_HEAD-MWSKZ " 세금계산서는 우선 재무팀에서 회계문서에 등록하는걸로 협의
  "추후 송장에 기입하는 방향으로 진행될 수 있음. 진행되면 체크 로직 추가 필요.

*--사업장 확인.
  IF ps_head-bupla IS INITIAL.


    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-m46.

  ELSE.

    "회사코드 사업장 체크.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM
      j_1bbranch
      WHERE bukrs = @ps_head-bukrs
          AND branch = @ps_head-BUpla
      INTO @DATA(ls_branch).

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.

      PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                             'E'
                                             TEXT-e35. "회사코드, 사업장이 유효하지 않습니다.
      EXIT.

    ENDIF.


  ENDIF.

  "총액  = 과표 + 세액. 다른 경우 에러
  IF ps_head-rmwwr NE ps_head-wrbtr1 + ps_head-wmwst.

    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-m97.


  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form BUDAT_PERIOD_DETERMINE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PS_HEAD_BUKRS
*&      --> PS_HEAD_BUDAT
*&      <-- PS_OUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM budat_period_determine USING p_bukrs
                                                p_budat
                                      CHANGING ps_out TYPE zmms_iv_create_out.

  DATA: lv_xruej LIKE drseg-xruej,
        lv_xruem LIKE drseg-xruem.

  CALL FUNCTION 'MR_PERIOD_DETERMINE'
    EXPORTING
*     i_bukrs                = '1100'
      i_bukrs                = p_bukrs
      i_budat                = p_budat
    IMPORTING
      e_xruej                = lv_xruej
      e_xruem                = lv_xruem
    EXCEPTIONS
      invalid_posting_period = 1
      marv_no_entry          = 2
      OTHERS                 = 3.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0.

    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                           'E'
                                           TEXT-m43.

*                         '전기기간 오류입니다. 물류마감일자를 확인하여 주세요'.
  ELSE.
    IF lv_xruej EQ 'X' AND
       lv_xruem EQ space.
      PERFORM error_out USING  ps_out
                                              'E'
                                              TEXT-m43.
*                           '전기기간 오류입니다. 물류마감일자를 확인하여 주세요'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form ERROR_OUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PS_T0340
*&      --> PS_OUT
*&      --> P_
*&      --> TEXT_M26
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM error_out USING ps_out
                          pv_type
                          pv_message.

*- CBO테이블 결과값 저장
  ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TYPE' OF STRUCTURE ps_out TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_TYPE>).
  IF <fs_type> IS ASSIGNED.
    <fs_type> = pv_type.
  ENDIF.

  ASSIGN COMPONENT 'MESSAGE' OF STRUCTURE ps_out TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_MSG>).
  IF <fs_msg> IS ASSIGNED.
    <fs_msg> = pv_message.
  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form if_item_check_iv
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_DT
*&      --> LT_OUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM if_item_check_iv TABLES pt_dt STRUCTURE zmmt0105
                                             pt_out STRUCTURE zmms_iv_create_out
                                  USING  ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0100
                                  CHANGING pv_err.

  DATA:
        lv_kposn     TYPE kposn.


  SORT pt_dt BY if_srm_key if_srm_item.

  DATA(lt_data) = pt_dt[].
  DATA : lv_wrbtr TYPE wrbtr.

  ""구매오더 기준 송장 수량 체크
  DATA : BEGIN OF ls_ebeln,
           ebeln TYPE ekpo-ebeln,
           ebelp TYPE ekpo-ebelp,
           menge TYPE ekpo-menge,
         END OF ls_ebeln.
  DATA : lt_ebeln LIKE TABLE OF ls_ebeln.

  SORT lt_data BY ebeln ebelp.

  CLEAR : lt_ebeln.

  TYPES l_ts_dt TYPE zmmt0105.


  LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
    CLEAR : ls_ebeln.

    ls_ebeln-ebeln = ls_data-ebeln.
    ls_ebeln-ebelp = ls_data-ebelp.
    ls_ebeln-menge = ls_data-kmenge.

    COLLECT ls_ebeln INTO lt_ebeln.

  ENDLOOP.



  DATA(lt_DUPLICATED) = pt_dt[].
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_duplicated COMPARING if_srm_key if_srm_item.
  DATA(lv_item_lines) = lines( pt_dt[] ).
  DATA(lv_duplicaed_lines) = lines( lt_duplicated ).

  IF lv_item_lines NE lv_duplicaed_lines.
    MODIFY pt_dt FROM VALUE #( if_type = 'E'
                               if_msg  = TEXT-m85 )             " 중복된 KEY 값이 존재합니다.
                                           TRANSPORTING if_type if_msg WHERE if_type IS INITIAL.

    MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type    = 'E'
                                message = TEXT-m85 )             " 중복된 KEY 값이 존재합니다.
                                           TRANSPORTING type message WHERE type IS INITIAL.
    pv_err = 'X'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT a~ebeln, b~ebelp, b~matnr, b~menge, a~knumv, b~webre, a~bsart, b~bprme, b~retpo
    FROM ekko AS a INNER JOIN ekpo AS b
                           ON a~ebeln = b~ebeln
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @pt_dt
  WHERE a~ebeln = @PT_dt-ebeln
    AND b~ebelp = @PT_dt-ebelp
   INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_po).
  SORT lt_po BY ebeln ebelp.

*-- po & item 없는 경우
  IF lt_po[] IS INITIAL.

    MODIFY pt_dt FROM VALUE #( if_type = 'E'
                               if_msg  = TEXT-m48 )             " 유효한 po 정보가 없습니다.
                                           TRANSPORTING if_type if_msg WHERE if_type IS INITIAL.

    MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type    = 'E'
                                message = TEXT-m48 )             " 유효한 po 정보가 없습니다.
                                           TRANSPORTING type message WHERE type IS INITIAL.
    pv_err = 'X'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  """아이템 체크
  LOOP AT pt_dt ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dt>).

    "IF KEY 확인.
    IF <fs_dt>-if_srm_key NE ps_head-if_srm_key.

      PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                  USING <fs_dt>
                                     'E'
                                    TEXT-m58..
      pv_err ='X'.
      CONTINUE.


    ENDIF.

    "헤더 세금코드와 아이템 세금코드는 동일해야함
    IF <fs_dt>-tax_code NE ps_head-mwskz.


      PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                  USING <fs_dt>
                                     'E'
                                    TEXT-m87..
      pv_err ='X'.
      CONTINUE.


    ENDIF.

    IF <fs_dt>-kmenge IS INITIAL OR <fs_dt>-kwert IS INITIAL.
      PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                  USING <fs_dt>
                                     'E'
                                    TEXT-e69.
      pv_err ='X'.
      CONTINUE.

    ENDIF.


    READ TABLE lt_po INTO DATA(ls_po) WITH KEY ebeln = <fs_dt>-ebeln
                                                                 ebelp = <fs_dt>-ebelp.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      "gr 기준 송장 확인 후 업데이트..해당 데이터로 수입 송장 처리 시 묶음 처리 예정.
      <fs_dt>-webre = ls_po-webre.

*--구매오더 단위meins, 구매오더 가격 단위(bprme) 가 다른 경우..
      " bapi parameter에 입력해야함. " 수입의 경우 다를 수 있음

      <fs_dt>-bprme = ls_po-bprme.

      "반품 송장 처리 시 대변메모 처리 확인.
      IF ls_po-retpo IS NOT INITIAL.
        IF ps_head-invoice_ind IS NOT INITIAL.

*          PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
*                                      USING <fs_dt>
*                                         'E'
*                                        TEXT-m55..
*          pv_err ='X'.
*          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        DATA(ls_non_ret) = VALUE #( lt_PO[
*                                  ebeln = <fs_dt>-ebeln
*                                  ebelp = <fs_dt>-ebelp
                                    retpo = abap_false ] OPTIONAL ).
        IF ls_non_ret IS NOT INITIAL.
          PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                      USING <fs_dt>
                                         'E'
                                        TEXT-m89. "정상입고와 반품은 하나의 송장으로 처리할 수 없습니다.
          pv_err ='X'.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        "일반 송장 처리 시 반품 혼재 시 에러
        DATA(ls_ret) = VALUE #( lt_PO[
*                                    ebeln = <fs_dt>-ebeln
*                                  ebelp = <fs_dt>-ebelp
                                retpo = abap_true ] OPTIONAL ).
        IF ls_ret IS NOT INITIAL.
          PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                      USING <fs_dt>
                                         'E'
                                        TEXT-m89. "정상입고와 반품은 하나의 송장으로 처리할 수 없습니다.
          pv_err ='X'.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.

      ENDIF.


*--내자 외자 공통 체크로직 start
      " 구매오더 유형 자산인 경우 V6 : 10 %, V7 영세율 세금코드만 가능
      IF ls_po-bsart = 'ZAC'.
        IF ps_head-mwskz = 'V6' OR ps_head-mwskz = 'V7'.
        ELSE. "
          PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                      USING <fs_dt>
                                         'E'
                                        TEXT-m55..
          pv_err ='X'.
          CONTINUE.

        ENDIF.
      ELSE. "ZAC 자산 이외의 구매오더는 V0 :영세율, V1 10% 세금코드 처리만 가능
        IF ps_head-mwskz = 'V0' OR ps_head-mwskz = 'V1' OR ps_head-mwskz = 'VZ'.
        ELSE. "
          PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                      USING <fs_dt>
                                         'E'
                                        TEXT-m56..
          pv_err ='X'.
          CONTINUE.


        ENDIF.


      ENDIF.

*--내자 외자 별 체크 로직 start
      CASE ps_head-gubun.

        WHEN '1'. "내자

          IF ls_po-webre IS INITIAL. "내자의 경우 PO GR기준 IV 필수
            " *-- 송장 처리 시 내자 PO인 경우 GR기준 IV 대상만 처리 가능합니다.

            PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                        USING <fs_dt>
                                           'E'
                                          TEXT-m53..
            pv_err ='X'.
            CONTINUE.

          ENDIF.


          IF <fs_dt>-ref_doc IS NOT INITIAL.

            SELECT SINGLE a~ebeln, a~ebelp, a~menge, a~belnr, a~gjahr, a~buzei
              FROM ekbe AS a
              INNER JOIN matdoc AS b
              ON a~belnr EQ b~mblnr
              AND a~gjahr EQ b~mjahr
              AND a~buzei EQ b~zeile
              WHERE a~belnr EQ @<fs_dt>-ref_doc
                  AND a~gjahr EQ @<fs_dt>-ref_doc_year
                  AND a~buzei EQ @<fs_dt>-ref_doc_it
                  AND a~ebeln EQ @<fs_dt>-ebeln
                  AND a~ebelp EQ @<fs_dt>-ebelp
                  AND a~vgabe EQ '1' "입고 이력
                  AND b~cancelled IS INITIAL
                  AND b~cancellation_type IS INITIAL
                 INTO @DATA(ls_ekbe).

            IF ls_ekbe IS INITIAL.
              "해당 구매오더와 연관되지 않은 참조전표입니다.
              PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                          USING <fs_dt>
                                             'E'
                                            TEXT-m91.
              pv_err ='X'.
              CONTINUE.

            ELSE.

              IF ls_ekbe-menge NE <fs_dt>-kmenge.
                "송장 처리 수량과 참조 전표의 입고 수량은 동일해야합니다.
                PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                            USING <fs_dt>
                                               'E'
                                              TEXT-m92.
                pv_err ='X'.
                CONTINUE.

              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.

*-- 송장 처리 시
            IF ( ps_head-invoice_ind = 'X' AND <fs_dt>-de_cre_ind IS INITIAL ) OR "송장 or 대변메모 처리 시 송장 이력 있으면 처리 불가
              ( ps_head-invoice_ind IS INITIAL AND <fs_dt>-de_cre_ind IS INITIAL ).

              "송장 처리 시 차대변 지시자 S로 처리된 이력있는지 확인 대변메모의 경우 반대 지시자로 처리 이력 확인.
              IF ps_head-invoice_ind = 'X' AND <fs_dt>-de_cre_ind IS INITIAL.
                DATA(lv_where) = |C~SHKZG EQ 'S'|.
              ELSEIF ps_head-invoice_ind IS INITIAL AND <fs_dt>-de_cre_ind IS INITIAL.
                lv_where = |C~SHKZG EQ 'H'|.
              ENDIF.

              ""자재문서 참조 전표 처리 시 해당 전표로 참조되어 있는 유효한 송장이 있는 경우 에러 처리.
              SELECT SINGLE a~mandt
                FROM rbkp AS a
                INNER  JOIN rseg AS b
                ON a~belnr EQ b~belnr
               AND a~gjahr EQ b~gjahr
                INNER JOIN  ekbe AS c
                ON b~belnr EQ c~belnr
                AND b~gjahr EQ c~gjahr
                AND b~buzei EQ lpad( c~buzei, 6, '0' )
                WHERE b~lfbnr EQ @<fs_dt>-ref_doc
                    AND b~lfgja EQ @<fs_dt>-ref_doc_year
                    AND b~lfpos EQ @<fs_dt>-ref_doc_it
                    AND c~vgabe EQ '2' " 송장 이력
                    AND (lv_where)
                    AND a~stblg IS INITIAL
                   INTO @DATA(lS_MANDT).

              IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
                PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                            USING <fs_dt>
                                               'E'
                                              TEXT-m88.
                pv_err ='X'.
                CONTINUE.
              ENDIF.


            ENDIF.



          ELSE.

            "차후차대변을 제외한 송장은 내자 송장처리 시 참조 전표 필수.
*           IF <FS_DT>-de_cre_ind IS INITIAL.

            "내자 송장 처리 시 참조 전표는 필수입니다.
            PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                        USING <fs_dt>
                                           'E'
                                          TEXT-m91.
            pv_err ='X'.
            CONTINUE.

*           ENDIF.

          ENDIF.


        WHEN '2'. "Credit Memo 마이너스 세금 계산서.

          IF ls_po-webre IS NOT  INITIAL. "외자의 경우 PO GR기준 IV 미체크 확인
            "          *-- 송장 처리 시 외자 PO인 경우 GR기준 IV 대상은 처리 불가능합니다.
            PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                        USING <fs_dt>
                                           'E'
                                          TEXT-m54..
            pv_err ='X'.
            CONTINUE.

          ENDIF.

          SELECT SINGLE SUM( c~menge ) AS ekbe_sum
            FROM rbkp AS a
            INNER  JOIN rseg AS b
            ON a~belnr EQ b~belnr
           AND a~gjahr EQ b~gjahr
            INNER JOIN  ekbe AS c
            ON b~belnr EQ c~belnr
            AND b~gjahr EQ c~gjahr
*                AND b~buzei EQ c~buzei
            WHERE c~ebeln EQ @<fs_dt>-ebeln
                AND c~ebelp EQ @<fs_dt>-ebelp
                AND c~vgabe EQ '2' " 송장 이력
                AND a~stblg IS INITIAL
               INTO @DATA(lv_ekbesum).


          ""해당 품목의 구매오더,품목으로 송장 진행할 수량을 get
          READ TABLE lt_ebeln INTO ls_ebeln WITH KEY ebeln = <fs_dt>-ebeln
                                                                 ebelp = <fs_dt>-ebelp.

          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
            IF ls_ebeln-menge + lv_ekbesum > ls_po-menge + ls_po-menge * 10 / 100.
              "          *-- 외자 송장 처리 시 IV 수량이 PO 수량 10%를 초과 못 함.
              PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                          USING <fs_dt>
                                             'E'
                                            TEXT-m65..
              pv_err ='X'.
              CONTINUE.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.

          IF <fs_dt>-ref_doc IS NOT INITIAL.
            "          *-- 외자 송장 처리 시 참조 전표 처리는 불가능합니다. (외자 송장 처리 시 참조 전표를 제외해주세요)
            PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                        USING <fs_dt>
                                           'E'
                                          TEXT-m90.
            pv_err ='X'.
            CONTINUE.
          ENDIF.

          "외자 물대 처리 시 PO, B/L 번호로 진행한 송장이 있는 경우 에러 처리
          SELECT SINGLE a~mandt
            FROM zmmt0100 AS a
            INNER JOIN zmmt0105 AS b
            ON a~if_srm_key EQ b~if_srm_key
            INNER JOIN rseg AS c
            ON b~belnr EQ c~belnr
            AND b~gjahr EQ c~gjahr
            INNER JOIN rbkp AS d
            ON c~belnr EQ d~belnr
            AND d~gjahr EQ d~gjahr
            AND d~stblg IS INITIAL
            WHERE b~ebeln EQ @<fs_dt>-ebeln " PO
                AND b~ebelp EQ @<fs_dt>-ebelp "PO ITEM
                AND a~zbl_no EQ @ps_head-zbl_no " B/L
                 INTO @DATA(ls_iv).

          IF ls_iv IS NOT INITIAL.

            PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                         USING <fs_dt>
                            'E'
                           TEXT-e47. "해당 PO, B/L로 처리된 송장이 존재합니다.
            pv_err ='X'.
            CONTINUE.

          ENDIF.



      ENDCASE.
      """차후 차변 처리 시 내외자 공통
      IF <fs_dt>-de_cre_ind IS NOT INITIAL. " 차후 차대변인 경우

        ""자재문서 참조 전표 처리 시 해당 전표로 참조되어 있는 유효한 송장이 있는 경우 에러 처리.
        SELECT SINGLE b~menge
          FROM rbkp AS a
          INNER  JOIN rseg AS b
          ON a~belnr EQ b~belnr
         AND a~gjahr EQ b~gjahr
          INNER JOIN  ekbe AS c
          ON b~belnr EQ c~belnr
          AND b~gjahr EQ c~gjahr
*          AND b~buzei EQ c~buzei
          AND c~vgabe EQ '2' " 송장 이력
          WHERE c~ebeln EQ @<fs_dt>-ebeln
              AND c~ebelp EQ @<fs_dt>-ebelp
              AND a~stblg IS INITIAL
             INTO @DATA(lV_MENGE).

        IF sy-subrc NE 0.
          PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                          USING <fs_dt>
                             'E'
                            TEXT-m93. "차후 차/대변 처리 시 해당 구매오더로 진행된 송장 내역이 존재해야 합니다.

          pv_err ='X'.
          CONTINUE.

        ELSE.


          DATA(ls_non_CHA) = VALUE #( pt_dt[
                                      de_cre_ind = abap_false ] OPTIONAL ).
          IF ls_non_cha IS NOT INITIAL.
            PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                        USING <fs_dt>
                                           'E'
                                          TEXT-m94. "차후 차/대변 처리 시 일반 송장 처리와 혼재하여 처리 불가능합니다.
            pv_err ='X'.
            CONTINUE.
          ENDIF.

          IF lv_menge <  <fs_dt>-kmenge.
            PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                            USING <fs_dt>
                               'E'
                              TEXT-m95. "차후 차/대변 처리 시 기존 송장 수량을 초과할 수 없습니다.

            pv_err ='X'.
            CONTINUE.
          ENDIF.

*          DATA(ls_reduce) = REDUCE l_ts_dt( INIT hs_dt_reduce TYPE l_ts_dt"- 수량(KMENGE), 전표통화(KWERT) 압축해야 함.
*                                          FOR <hs_dt_reduce> IN pt_dt WHERE (     ebeln = <fs_dt>-ebeln
*                                                                                     AND ebelp = <fs_dt>-ebelp )
*                                          NEXT
*                                               hs_dt_reduce-kmenge += <hs_dt_reduce>-kmenge ).

*          IF ls_reduce-kmenge > lv_menge.
*            PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
*                            USING <fs_dt>
*                               'E'
*                              TEXT-m95. "차후 차/대변 처리 시 기존 송장 수량을 초과할 수 없습니다.
*
*            pv_err ='X'.
*            CONTINUE.
*
*
*          ENDIF.

        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
*-- 유효한 po 정보가 아닙니다.

      PERFORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out
                                  USING <fs_dt>
                                     'E'
                                    TEXT-m49.
      pv_err ='X'.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR : lv_where.
    "아이템 과액 확인용
    lv_wrbtr = lv_wrbtr + <fs_dt>-kwert.

  ENDLOOP.


  "에러통과 시 아이템 <-> 헤더 물대 과액 동일한지 비교
  IF pv_err IS INITIAL.

    IF ps_head-wrbtr1 NE lv_wrbtr.
      "헤더의 공급가액과 아이템 공급가액 합산이 다릅니다.
      pv_err = 'X'.
      MODIFY pt_dt FROM VALUE #( if_type = 'E'
                                 if_msg  = TEXT-m98 )
                                               TRANSPORTING if_type if_msg
                                               WHERE if_type IS INITIAL.

      MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type    = 'E'
                                  message = TEXT-m98 )
                                               TRANSPORTING type message
                                               WHERE type IS INITIAL.

    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form invoice_bapi_mm0100
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_DT
*&      --> LT_OUT
*&      --> <FS_HEAD>
*&      --> ELSE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM invoice_bapi_mm0100 TABLES pt_dt STRUCTURE zmmt0105
                                                  pt_out STRUCTURE zmms_iv_create_out
                                                   USING  ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0100.

  " BAPI 변수
  DATA v_doc_item TYPE rblgp.
  DATA: ls_header TYPE zmms0030.
  DATA: lt_item   TYPE TABLE OF zmms0035.
  DATA: ls_item   TYPE zmms0035.
  DATA: lv_menge TYPE ekbe-menge.
  DATA: lv_wrbtr TYPE ekbe-wrbtr. "마감금액
  DATA: lv_wmwst TYPE bseg-wmwst. "세액
  DATA: lv_wrbtr_b TYPE ekbe-wrbtr. "잔액
  DATA: lv_wmwst_b TYPE bseg-wmwst. "잔액세액
  DATA: lv_lifnr TYPE ekko-lifnr.
  DATA: lv_last_group TYPE i.

  "bapi 리턴
  DATA: lv_status  TYPE bapi_mtype.
  DATA: lv_message TYPE bapi_msg.
  DATA: lv_belnr_iv LIKE rseg-belnr.
  DATA: lv_gjahr_iv LIKE rseg-gjahr.
  DATA : lv_bapi_fail TYPE bapibp_xfeld. "- 분할해서 인보이스를 전기할 때 하나라도 실패하면 'X'를 할당해서 전체를 롤백.
  DATA : lv_check TYPE c.

  " 송장 생성 이후 추적용

  DATA: BEGIN OF lt_update OCCURS 0, " 자재문서 생성 이후 품목 추적용
          if_srm_key TYPE zmmt0105-if_srm_key,
          group      TYPE zmmt0105-zgroup,
          belnr_fi   LIKE rseg-belnr,
          belnr_iv   LIKE rseg-belnr,
          buzei      LIKE bseg-buzei,
          Gjahr      LIKE rseg-gjahr,
        END OF lt_update.

  CLEAR : lv_wmwst_b.


  " 송장 처리 시 내.외 구분
  CASE ps_head-gubun.

    WHEN '1'. "내자/

      "아이템에 차후 차대변 체크 시 구매오더 기준으로 하나로 처리하기 위해 축약을 통한 BAPI 처리
      " 이외의 송장 처리는 참조전표(자재문서)를 기준으로 처리


      READ TABLE pt_dt TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY de_cre_ind = 'X'.

      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

        PERFORM invoice_bapi_mm0100_reduce  TABLES   pt_dt
                                                                    pt_out
                                                         USING  ps_head.


      ELSE.

        "송장 처리 그룹핑(300건씩 묶음 처리), 300건 초과로 송장 분할 처리 시 마지막 그룹 번호 리턴

        SORT pt_dt BY if_srm_item ebeln ebelp.
*--송장 분할 처리 : 송장 전표 생성 시 회계전표 등 1000건 넘어갈 우려로 200~300건 넘을 시 분할하여 송장 처리
        PERFORM set_iv_group TABLES pt_dt
                                        CHANGING lv_last_group.

        SORT pt_dt BY if_srm_item ebeln ebelp zgroup.

*-- 수신받은 총 세액  잔액  계산용
        lv_wmwst_b = ps_head-wmwst. "헤더 세액
        lv_wrbtr_b = ps_head-wrbtr1. "헤더 공급가액


        LOOP AT pt_dt INTO DATA(ls_dt)
                         WHERE if_srm_key = ps_head-if_srm_key
                        GROUP BY ls_dt-zgroup
                        INTO DATA(ls_key).

          CLEAR : v_doc_item.

          LOOP AT GROUP ls_key INTO DATA(ls_loop).

            v_doc_item += 10.

*      GV_MENGE = GV_MENGE + GS_INV_ITEM-MENGE.     "수량
            lv_wrbtr = lv_wrbtr + ls_loop-kwert.  "품목별 공급가액

** Item
            PERFORM iv_item TABLES  lt_item
                                      USING ps_head
                                                 ls_loop
                                                 v_doc_item.
          ENDLOOP.

*-- 그룹별 송장 처리 start
          "세액 계산

          PERFORM calculate_tax_from_net_amount USING ps_head-bukrs
                                                      ps_head-mwskz
                                                      ps_head-waers
                                                      lv_wrbtr
                                             CHANGING lV_WMWST.  "세액


          IF lv_last_group > 1 AND ls_loop-zgroup EQ lv_last_group.
            "300건 초과로  송장 분할 처리 시
            "마지막 송장 처리에 계산 세액 말고 수신받은 세액 잔액으로 변환
            lv_wmwst = lv_wmwst_b.
            lv_wrbtr = lv_wrbtr_b.

          ENDIF.

          " 위 계산 로직에의 해 한 번 처리되는 송장의 경우 세액이 계산되는 경우가 있었음
          " if 금액과 일치시키기 위함
          IF lv_last_group = 1.

            lv_wmwst = ps_head-wmwst."IF 세액
            lv_wrbtr = ps_head-wrbtr1. " IF 금액

          ENDIF.

** Header

          PERFORM iv_header  USING ps_head
                                              lv_wrbtr
                                              lv_wmwst
                                CHANGING   ls_header.


* 송장문서 생성 BAPI
          CLEAR: lv_status, lv_message.
          call function 'ZMM_IV_CREATE'
            EXPORTING
              is_header    = ls_header
              iv_cmt_in_fm = abap_false " 전체 건 성공 시 커밋
              iv_text      = ps_head-sgtxt
            IMPORTING
              ev_belnr     = lv_belnr_iv
              ev_gjahr     = lv_gjahr_iv
              ev_status    = lv_status
              ev_message   = lv_message
            TABLES
              it_item      = lt_item.

          IF lv_status = 'S'. "- 성공일 땐 결과를 축적.

* 자재문서 생성 이후 품목 번호 추적 매핑
            lt_update-if_srm_key  = ls_loop-if_srm_key.
            lt_update-group = ls_loop-zgroup.
            lt_update-belnr_iv   = lv_belnr_iv.
            lt_update-gjahr   = lv_gjahr_iv.

            APPEND lt_update.

          ELSE. "- 실패하면 롤백할 것이므로 축적된 결과를 다 지우고 에러 메시지만 입력.

            lv_check = 'X'.
            lv_bapi_fail     = abap_true.
            EXIT. "- LOOP EXIT.
          ENDIF.

          lV_WRBTR_B = lV_WRBTR_B - lV_WRBTR.
          lV_WMWST_B = lV_WMWST_B - lV_WMWST.

          CLEAR: ls_header, lt_item[].
          CLEAR: lv_wrbtr, lv_wmwst.

        ENDLOOP.


        IF lV_BAPI_FAIL = abap_true.


          CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.

          PERFORM error USING  ps_head
                               'E'
                               lv_message.

        ELSE.

          CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
            EXPORTING
              wait = abap_true.

          PERFORM error USING  ps_head
                           'S'
                           TEXT-m57.  "'Success'.

          ""fi문서 get
          SORT lt_update BY group.
          SORT pt_dt BY if_srm_key if_srm_item zgroup.

          LOOP AT lt_update.
            ""fi 문서 get
            PERFORM get_fi_doc USING lt_update-belnr_iv lt_update-gjahr
                            CHANGING lt_update-belnr_fi.

            IF lt_update-belnr_fi IS NOT INITIAL.

              PERFORM get_fi_doc_item USING lt_update-belnr_FI lt_update-gjahr
                              CHANGING lt_update-buzei.

            ENDIF.

            MODIFY lt_update TRANSPORTING belnr_fi buzei.

          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT pt_dt ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).

          <fs_item>-if_type     = ps_head-if_type.
          <fs_item>-if_msg      = ps_head-if_msg.


          IF lv_bapi_fail IS INITIAL.

            READ TABLE lt_update INTO DATA(ls_update) WITH KEY group = <fs_item>-zgroup.

            IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

              <fs_item>-belnr     = ls_update-belnr_iv.
              <fs_item>-gjahr     = ls_update-gjahr.
              <fs_item>-belnr_fi     = ls_update-belnr_fi.
              <fs_item>-buzei     = ls_update-buzei.
            ENDIF.

          ELSE.
            "실패된 데이터

*-- 송장 처리에 성공했지만 동일 KEY 데이터가 실패한 경우 생성되었지만 롤백된 송장번호 삭제
            IF <fs_item>-belnr IS NOT INITIAL.


              CLEAR : <fs_item>-belnr, <fs_item>-gjahr, <fs_item>-belnr_fi, <fs_item>-buzei.
              <fs_item>-gjahr     = abap_false.        <fs_item>-if_msg     = TEXT-m63. " 다른 항목의 에러로 실패.


            ENDIF.



          ENDIF.





          MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type     = ps_head-if_type
                                      message  = ps_head-iF_MSG
                                      belnr_iv = ls_update-belnr_iv
                                      belnr_fi = ls_update-belnr_fi
                                      buzei    = ls_update-buzei
                                      gjahr    = ls_update-gjahr )                                                                                  " 성공 업데이트
                                                  TRANSPORTING type message belnr_iv belnr_fi gjahr buzei
                                                          WHERE if_srm_key EQ <fs_item>-if_srm_key
                                                                AND if_srm_item EQ <fs_item>-if_srm_item.
        ENDLOOP.





      ENDIF.


    WHEN '2'. " 외자인 경우 구분

      " 외자 처리 시 GR/IV  기준이 아님 구매오더를 축약해서 처리해야함.
      " 처리 방식으 인한 차이 떄문에 추가 내용으로 로직 분기
      PERFORM invoice_bapi_mm0100_reduce  TABLES   pt_dt
                                                                  pt_out
                                                       USING  ps_head.


  ENDCASE.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form error_out_item
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PT_OUT
*&      --> PS_OUT
*&      --> P_
*&      --> TEXT_M46
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM error_out_item TABLES pt_out STRUCTURE zmms_iv_create_out
                                                USING ps_dt STRUCTURE  zmmt0105
                                                                                     pv_type
                                                                                pv_message.

*- CBO테이블 결과값 저장
  ASSIGN COMPONENT 'IF_TYPE' OF STRUCTURE PS_dt TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_if_type>).
  IF <fs_if_type> IS ASSIGNED.
    <fs_if_type> = pv_type.
  ENDIF.

*- CBO테이블 결과값 저장
  ASSIGN COMPONENT 'IF_MSG' OF STRUCTURE PS_dt TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS_IF_msg>).
  IF <fs_if_msg> IS ASSIGNED.
    <fs_if_msg> = pv_message.
  ENDIF.

  """output data
  MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type    = pv_type
                              message = pv_message )             " 유효한 po 정보가 아닙니다.
                                         TRANSPORTING type message WHERE if_srm_key = ps_dt-if_srm_key
                                                                                 AND if_srm_item = ps_dt-if_srm_item.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form DATAX_POSCHEDULE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM datax_poschedule USING p_field01
                              p_field02
                      CHANGING ps_datax STRUCTURE bapimeposchedulx
                               ps_data STRUCTURE bapimeposchedule
                        .

  FIELD-SYMBOLS :<datax>, <cnt>, <val>, <data>.
  DATA : l_n TYPE n LENGTH 2.
  DATA : fieldname(30).
  CLEAR : ps_datax, fieldname, l_n.

  DO 2 TIMES.
    ADD 1 TO l_n.
    CONCATENATE 'p_field' l_n INTO fieldname.
    ASSIGN (fieldname) TO <cnt>.
    ASSIGN (fieldname) TO <val>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF <val> IS NOT INITIAL.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <val> OF STRUCTURE ps_data TO <data>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
***>> ps_data가 존재하면 ps_datax를 설정하기 ***********************************
          IF <data> IS NOT INITIAL.
            IF <cnt> IS NOT INITIAL.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT <cnt> OF STRUCTURE ps_datax TO <datax>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                <datax> = 'X'.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
***<< ps_data가 존재하면 ps_datax를 설정하기 ***********************************
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDDO.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form SET_IV_GROUP
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& -->  p1        text
*& <--  p2        text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_iv_group TABLES pt_dt STRUCTURE zmmt0105
                                  CHANGING pv_last_group.


  DATA : lv_cnt_group TYPE i VALUE '230'.
  DATA : lv_group TYPE sy-index  VALUE 1,
         lv_cnt   TYPE i.

  CLEAR : lv_cnt.


  ""내자 송장 처리 시 아이템이 900건이 넘어갈 수 있어 분할 처리( 회계문서 항목 999으로 인해)
  "분할 처리 시 가격 단차 발생으로 인해  다음 로직에 단차 방지 로직 추가
  " 그룹핑된 아이템이 10개 이하인 경우 이전 그룹에 포함하여 처리.


  LOOP AT pt_dt INTO DATA(ls_dt).
    ls_dt-zgroup = lv_group.
    lv_cnt = lv_cnt + 1.

    IF lv_cnt = lv_cnt_group.
      lv_group = lv_group + 1.
      CLEAR lv_cnt.
    ENDIF.

    MODIFY pt_dt FROM ls_dt TRANSPORTING zgroup.
  ENDLOOP.


  ""요청사항으로 300번 씩 그룹핑했지만 마지막 그룹의 대상 아이템이 수가 적은 경우
  "
  DATA(lv_lines) = lines( pt_dt ).

  IF lv_lines > lv_cnt_group. " 300건 넘어 가는 경우

    ""처리 후 마지막 그룹 번호 확인.
    DATA(lt_last_group) = pt_dt[].
    SORT lt_last_group BY zgroup.
    DELETE  lt_last_group WHERE zgroup NE lv_group.

    DATA(lv_lines_last) = lines( lt_last_group ).

*    IF  lv_lines_last > 0 AND lv_lines_last <= 10. " 마지막 라인의 처리 수량이 1~10이면 이전 그룹과 같이 처리
*
*      MODIFY pt_dt FROM VALUE #( zgroup = lv_group - 1 )
*                                             TRANSPORTING zgroup WHERE zgroup EQ lv_group.
*
*    ENDIF.


  ENDIF.


  pv_last_group = lv_group. "마지막 그룹번호 리턴




ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form IV_ITEM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_ITEM
*&      --> PS_HEAD
*&      --> LS_VALUE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM iv_item TABLES pt_item STRUCTURE zmms0035
                    USING    ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0100
                              ps_loop STRUCTURE zmmt0105
                              pv_doc_item.

  DATA: lv_dmbtr TYPE dmbtr.
  DATA: ls_item TYPE zmms0035.

  CLEAR ls_item.
  ls_item-buzei = pv_doc_item.                  "송장 문서의 문서 항목
  ls_item-ebeln = ps_loop-ebeln.         "구매 오더 번호
  ls_item-ebelp = ps_loop-ebelp.         "구매 문서 품목 번호
  ls_item-menge = abs( ps_loop-kmenge ).  "수량
  ls_item-meins = ps_loop-meins.         "오더 단위
  ls_item-mwskz = ps_loop-tax_code.         "오더 단위
  ls_item-bprme = ps_loop-bprme.         "오더 단위
  ls_item-tbtkz = ps_loop-de_cre_ind.         "item indicator

  IF ps_head-gubun = '1'. " 내자인 경우 자재문서 참조 처리.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      ls_item-lfbnr = ps_loop-ref_doc.   "참조 문서의 문서 번호
      ls_item-lfgja = ps_loop-ref_doc_year.      "현재 기간의 회계연도
      ls_item-lfpos = ps_loop-ref_doc_it.      "참조 전표 품목
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

* 전표통화금액 = 마감금액
  CLEAR: lv_dmbtr.
  lv_dmbtr = ps_loop-kwert.

  PERFORM bapi_currency_conv_to_external USING ps_head-waers
                                               lv_dmbtr
                                      CHANGING ls_item-wrbtr.
  IF lv_dmbtr < 0.
    ls_item-wrbtr = abs( ls_item-wrbtr ).
  ENDIF.

  APPEND ls_item TO pt_item. CLEAR ls_item.



ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form bapi_currency_conv_to_external
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PS_LOOP_WAERS
*&      --> LV_DMBTR
*&      <-- LS_ITEM_WRBTR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM bapi_currency_conv_to_external USING pv_waers TYPE tcurc-waers
                                              pv_amount_int TYPE any
                                     CHANGING pv_amount_ext TYPE any.

  CHECK NOT pv_waers IS INITIAL AND NOT pv_amount_int IS INITIAL.

  CLEAR: pv_amount_ext.
  CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_CURRENCY_CONV_TO_EXTERNAL'
    EXPORTING
      currency        = pv_waers
      amount_internal = pv_amount_int
    IMPORTING
      amount_external = pv_amount_ext.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form IV_HEADER
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PS_HEAD
*&      <-- LS_HEADER
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM iv_header USING ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0100
                                  pv_wrbtr
                                  pv_wmwst
                CHANGING ps_header STRUCTURE zmms0030.

  DATA: lv_dmbtr TYPE dmbtr.
  CLEAR ps_header.
*
*  IF ps_head-gubun = '1'. "내자인 경우 인보이스 인디케이터 체크
*    ps_header-xrech = 'X'. "INVOICE INDICATOR
*  ELSE.
*    ps_header-xrech = abap_off. "INVOICE INDICATOR
*  ENDIF.

  ps_header-blart = 'RE'.            "전표 유형
  ps_header-bldat = ps_head-bldat. "전표 증빙일
  ps_header-budat = ps_head-budat. "전표의 전기일
  ps_header-bukrs = ps_head-bukrs.    "회사 코드
  ps_header-bupla = ps_head-bupla. " 사업장
  ps_header-waers = ps_head-waers.   "통화 키
  ps_header-mwskz = ps_head-mwskz.  "세금코드
  ps_header-xrech = ps_head-invoice_ind. "송장 처리 지시자.
  ps_header-bvtyp = ps_head-bvtyp. "파트너은행유형 - srm 처리 시 계좌지정에 대한 내용
  ps_header-zlsch = ps_head-zlsch. "지급방법
  ps_header-zbl_no = COND #( WHEN ps_head-gubun = gc_2 THEN ps_head-zbl_no ). "송장 처리 지시자. " 외자인 경우 b/l 번호 기입



  ps_header-lifre = ps_head-lifnr.  "발행처
  ps_header-bktxt = ps_head-bktxt.   "전자 세금계산서 번호
  ps_header-zterm = ps_head-zterm.   "지급조건
  ps_header-kursf = ps_head-exch_rate. " 환율

  CLEAR lv_dmbtr.
  lv_dmbtr = pv_wrbtr + pv_wmwst. "총액

  PERFORM bapi_currency_conv_to_external USING ps_head-waers
                                               lv_dmbtr
                                      CHANGING ps_header-wrbtr. "총액

  PERFORM bapi_currency_conv_to_external USING ps_head-waers
                                             pv_wmwst
                                    CHANGING ps_header-wmwst. "세액


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form calculate_tax_from_net_amount
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PS_HEAD_BUKRS
*&      --> PS_HEAD_MWSKZ
*&      --> PS_HEAD_WAERS
*&      --> LV_WRBTR
*&      <-- LV_WMWST
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM calculate_tax_from_net_amount USING pv_bukrs TYPE bseg-bukrs
                                         pv_mwskz    TYPE ekpo-mwskz
                                         pv_waers    TYPE bkpf-waers
                                         pv_wrbtr_gr TYPE ekbe-wrbtr
                                CHANGING pv_wmwst.

  DATA: lt_mwdat  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF rtax1u15.
  DATA: lv_wrbtr TYPE bseg-wrbtr.
  DATA: lv_fwste TYPE bset-fwste.

  CLEAR: pv_wmwst.
  CHECK: pv_bukrs IS NOT INITIAL AND
         pv_mwskz IS NOT INITIAL AND
         pv_waers IS NOT INITIAL.

  lv_wrbtr = pv_wrbtr_gr.

  m_clear: lt_mwdat.
  CALL FUNCTION 'CALCULATE_TAX_FROM_NET_AMOUNT'
    EXPORTING
      i_bukrs           = pv_bukrs
      i_mwskz           = pv_mwskz
      i_waers           = pv_waers
      i_wrbtr           = lv_wrbtr
    IMPORTING
      e_fwste           = lv_fwste
    TABLES
      t_mwdat           = lt_mwdat
    EXCEPTIONS
      bukrs_not_found   = 1
      country_not_found = 2
      mwskz_not_defined = 3
      mwskz_not_valid   = 4
      ktosl_not_found   = 5
      kalsm_not_found   = 6
      parameter_error   = 7
      knumh_not_found   = 8
      kschl_not_found   = 9
      unknown_error     = 10
      account_not_found = 11
      txjcd_not_valid   = 12
      OTHERS            = 13.

  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    READ TABLE lt_mwdat INTO DATA(ls_mwdat) INDEX 1.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      pv_wmwst = ls_mwdat-wmwst.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form GET_FI_DOC
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_UPDATE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_fi_doc USING p_invoice p_gjahr
                CHANGING p_fidoc.

  DATA(lv_zwkey) = p_invoice && p_gjahr.

  DO 2 TIMES.
*-- FI DOC 회계전표
    SELECT SINGLE belnr INTO @DATA(lv_fidoc)
      FROM bkpf
     WHERE awtyp = 'RMRP'
       AND awkey = @lv_zwkey
      AND xsecondary EQ @abap_false."자산 후속 회계문서 제외용
    "회계문서 추출 시 자산 경우 후속 원장이 생김
    "기존은 1대1이지만 자산의 경우 송장 회계문서 1 : N 임


    IF lv_fidoc IS INITIAL.
      WAIT  UP TO 1 SECONDS.
    ELSE.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDDO.

  p_fidoc = lv_fidoc.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form ERROR_IV_CANC_001
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_SAVE
*&      --> ES_OUT
*&      --> P_
*&      --> TEXT_M13
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM error_iv_canc_001 USING ps_cbo
                  ps_output
                  pv_type
                  pv_message.

*- CBO테이블 결과값 저장
  ASSIGN COMPONENT 'IF_TYPE' OF STRUCTURE ps_cbo TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_if_type>).
  IF <fs_if_type> IS ASSIGNED.
    <fs_if_type> = pv_type.
  ENDIF.

  ASSIGN COMPONENT 'IF_MSG' OF STRUCTURE ps_cbo TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_if_msg>).
  IF <fs_if_msg> IS ASSIGNED.
    <fs_if_msg> = pv_message.
  ENDIF.

*- IS OUT 아이템구조 결과값
  ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TYPE' OF STRUCTURE ps_output TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_type>).
  IF <fs_type> IS ASSIGNED.
    <fs_type> = pv_type.
  ENDIF.

  ASSIGN COMPONENT 'MESSAGE' OF STRUCTURE ps_output TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_message>).
  IF <fs_message> IS ASSIGNED.
    <fs_message> = pv_message.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form IF_DATA_VALIDATION_IV_CANC
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_ITEMS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM if_data_valid_iv_canc TABLES pt_list STRUCTURE zmmt0110.



ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form if_data_vaild_iv_canc
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_LIST[]
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM if_data_vaild_iv_canc TABLES pt_key STRUCTURE zmmt0110
                                                pt_list STRUCTURE zmmt0110.


  SORT pt_key BY if_srm_key.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM pt_key[] COMPARING if_srm_key.

*-- IF KEY 송장 수신 이력.
  SELECT *
    FROM zmmt0105
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @pt_key[]
    WHERE if_srm_key = @pt_key-if_srm_key
        AND if_type = 'S'
        AND belnr IS NOT INITIAL
       INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_0105).

  SORT lt_0105 BY if_srm_key belnr.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_0105 COMPARING belnr. " 처리된 송장 중복 제거


  " IF KEY에 진행된 송장 수량을 취소시 동일한 수량으로 받아야함.
  LOOP AT pt_key INTO DATA(ls_key).

    "송장 처리 이력
    DATA(lv_old) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR wa IN lt_0105 WHERE ( if_srm_key = ls_key-if_srm_key )
                                         NEXT sum = sum + 1 ).

    "신규 취소 처리 요청
    DATA(lv_new) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR wa2 IN pt_list WHERE ( if_srm_key = ls_key-if_srm_key )
                                         NEXT sum = sum + 1 ).

*-- KEY 별 신규 취소 요청과 기존 송장 이력 카운트 차이 시 에러.

    IF lv_new NE lv_old.
*      DATA(lv_msg) = |{({ lv_new })과 기존 송장 이력 수량({ lv_old })이 다릅니다.|.
      MESSAGE s042(zmmm10) WITH lv_old lv_new INTO DATA(lv_msg).
      ls_key-if_msg = lv_msg.
      ls_key-if_type = 'E'.
      MODIFY pt_key FROM ls_key TRANSPORTING if_msg if_type.
    ENDIF.


  ENDLOOP.



ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form bapi_iv_cancel
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LS_LIST_BELNR
*&      --> LS_LIST_GJAHR
*&      --> LV_LAST
*&      <-- ES_OUT_IF_STATUS
*&      <-- ES_OUT_ZMESSAGE
*&      <-- LS_RETURN_BELNR_IV
*&      <-- LS_RETURN_BELNR_FI
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM bapi_iv_cancel USING p_belnr
                          p_gjahr
                          p_budat
                          p_budat_old
                          p_commit
                 CHANGING  p_if_status
                           p_zmessage
                           p_belnr_iv
                           p_belnr_fi
                           p_re_gjahr
                          p_key_err.

  DATA: lv_invoicedocnumber          LIKE  bapi_incinv_fld-inv_doc_no,
        lv_fiscalyear                LIKE  bapi_incinv_fld-fisc_year,
        lv_reasonreversal            LIKE  bapi_incinv_fld-reason_rev VALUE '03',
        lv_invoicedocnumber_reversal LIKE  bapi_incinv_fld-inv_doc_no,
        lv_fiscalyear_reversal       LIKE  bapi_incinv_fld-fisc_year,
        lv_posting_date              LIKE bapi_incinv_fld-pstng_date,
        lt_return                    TYPE  TABLE OF bapiret2.

  lv_invoicedocnumber  = p_belnr.
  lv_fiscalyear = p_gjahr.

*--취소 사유는 기본 03이지만
*-- 기존 송장과 전기일이 다르게 전기해야하는 경우 취소 유형 04로 변경 후 입력 받은 취소일로 취소
*--기본은 기존 송장 전기일로 취소..

  IF p_budat IS NOT INITIAL.
    lv_reasonreversal  = '04'.
    lv_posting_date = p_budat.
  ELSE.
    lv_posting_date = p_budat_old.
  ENDIF.
*--


  CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_INCOMINGINVOICE_CANCEL'
    EXPORTING
      invoicedocnumber          = lv_invoicedocnumber
      fiscalyear                = lv_fiscalyear
      reasonreversal            = lv_reasonreversal
*     POSTINGDATE               =
    IMPORTING
      invoicedocnumber_reversal = lv_invoicedocnumber_reversal
      fiscalyear_reversal       = lv_fiscalyear_reversal
    TABLES
      return                    = lt_return.

  READ TABLE lt_return INTO DATA(ls_return) WITH KEY type = 'E'.
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    PERFORM bapi_rollback(zmmr0000).

    p_if_status = ls_return-type.
    p_zmessage  = ls_return-message.
    p_key_err = gc_x.
  ELSE.

    IF p_commit = abap_on.

      PERFORM bapi_commit(zmmr0000).

      p_if_status = 'S'.
      p_zmessage  = TEXT-m29. "'Success'.
      p_belnr_iv  = lv_invoicedocnumber_reversal.
      p_re_gjahr = lv_fiscalyear_reversal.
      PERFORM get_fi_doc USING lv_invoicedocnumber_reversal lv_fiscalyear_reversal
                      CHANGING p_belnr_fi.
    ELSE.
      p_belnr_iv  = lv_invoicedocnumber_reversal.
      p_re_gjahr = lv_fiscalyear_reversal.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form DATAX_POCOND
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM datax_pocond USING p_field01
                          p_field02
                          p_field03
                CHANGING ps_datax STRUCTURE bapimepocondx
                         ps_data STRUCTURE bapimepocond
                  .


  FIELD-SYMBOLS :<datax>, <cnt>, <val>, <data>.
  DATA : l_n TYPE n LENGTH 2.
  DATA : fieldname(30).
  CLEAR : ps_datax, fieldname, l_n.

  DO 3 TIMES.
    ADD 1 TO l_n.
    CONCATENATE 'p_field' l_n INTO fieldname.
    ASSIGN (fieldname) TO <cnt>.
    ASSIGN (fieldname) TO <val>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF <val> IS NOT INITIAL.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <val> OF STRUCTURE ps_data TO <data>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
***>> ps_data가 존재하면 ps_datax를 설정하기 ***********************************
          IF <data> IS NOT INITIAL.
            IF <cnt> IS NOT INITIAL.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT <cnt> OF STRUCTURE ps_datax TO <datax>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                <datax> = 'X'.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
***<< ps_data가 존재하면 ps_datax를 설정하기 ***********************************
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDDO.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form conv_json_str
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> ET_RDATA
*&      --> LV_RJSON
*&      --> I_TYPE
*&      <-- EV_RTN_CD
*&      <-- EV_RTN_MSG
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM conv_json_str TABLES pt_rdata TYPE STANDARD TABLE
                       USING    pv_rjson pv_type pv_tabhname pv_tabname
                    CHANGING pv_rtn_cd

                             pv_rtn_msg.
*  DATA: LR_DATA  TYPE REF TO DATA,
*        LR_TABLE TYPE REF TO DATA,
*        LR_STR   TYPE REF TO DATA.
*
*  DATA LV_NUM TYPE I.
*
*  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <FS_DATA>       TYPE DATA,
*                 <FS_TABLE>      TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
*                 <FS_STR>        TYPE ANY,
*                 <FS_FIELD>      TYPE ANY,
*                 <FS_RETURN>     TYPE ANY,
*                 <FS_STRUCTURE>  TYPE ANY,
*                 <FS_STRUCTURE2> TYPE ANY,
*                 <FS_STRUCTURE3> TYPE ANY,
*                 <FS_HEADER>     TYPE ANY,
*                 <FS_HEADER2>    TYPE ANY,
*                 <FS_ITEM>       TYPE ANY,
*                 <FS_ITEM2>      TYPE ANY TABLE.
*
*  CHECK pV_rJSON IS NOT INITIAL.
*
*  CREATE DATA: LR_TABLE type STANDARD TABLE of table,
*               LR_STR   LIKE LINE OF ET_RETURN[].
*
*  ASSIGN: LR_TABLE->* TO <FS_TABLE>,
*          LR_STR->*   TO <FS_STR>.
*
*  /UI2/CL_JSON=>DESERIALIZE(
*    EXPORTING
*      JSON      = pV_rjSON
*    CHANGING
*      DATA      = LR_DATA
*  ).
*
*  TRY.
*
*      CL_SALV_TABLE=>FACTORY( IMPORTING R_SALV_TABLE = DATA(LO_SALV_TABLE)
*                              CHANGING  T_TABLE      = ET_RETURN[] ).
*
*    CATCH CX_SALV_MSG INTO DATA(LV_MSG).
*      MESSAGE LV_MSG TYPE 'E'.
*
*  ENDTRY.
*
*  DATA(LT_COLUMNS) = LO_SALV_TABLE->GET_COLUMNS( )->GET( ).
*
*  IF LR_DATA IS BOUND.
*    ASSIGN LR_DATA->* TO <FS_DATA>.
*    CHECK <FS_DATA> IS ASSIGNED.
*
*    ASSIGN COMPONENT pv_tabhname OF STRUCTURE <FS_DATA> TO <FS_HEADER>.
*    CHECK <FS_HEADER> IS ASSIGNED.
*
*    ASSIGN <FS_HEADER>->* TO <FS_HEADER2>.
*    CHECK <FS_HEADER2> IS ASSIGNED.
*
*    ASSIGN COMPONENT pv_tabname OF STRUCTURE <FS_HEADER2> TO <FS_ITEM>.
*    CHECK <FS_ITEM> IS ASSIGNED.
*
*    ASSIGN <FS_ITEM>->* TO <FS_ITEM2>.
*    CHECK <FS_ITEM2> IS ASSIGNED.
*
*    LOOP AT <FS_ITEM2> ASSIGNING <FS_STRUCTURE2>.
*      CHECK <FS_STRUCTURE2> IS ASSIGNED.
*      ASSIGN <FS_STRUCTURE2>->* TO <FS_STRUCTURE3>.
*      CHECK <FS_STRUCTURE3> IS ASSIGNED.
*
*      LOOP AT LT_COLUMNS INTO DATA(LS_COLUMNS).
*        ASSIGN COMPONENT LS_COLUMNS-COLUMNNAME OF STRUCTURE <FS_STRUCTURE3> TO <FS_FIELD>.
*        ASSIGN COMPONENT LS_COLUMNS-COLUMNNAME OF STRUCTURE <FS_STR> TO <FS_RETURN>.
*        IF <FS_FIELD> IS ASSIGNED AND <FS_RETURN> IS ASSIGNED AND
*           <FS_FIELD> IS NOT INITIAL.
*          <FS_RETURN> = <FS_FIELD>->*.
*          CLEAR <FS_FIELD>.
*        ENDIF.
*      ENDLOOP.
*
*      APPEND <FS_STR> TO <FS_TABLE>.
*    ENDLOOP.
*
*    ET_RETURN[] = <FS_TABLE>.
*  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form conv_str_json
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> IT_SDATA
*&      <-- LV_SJSON
*&      <-- EV_RTN_CD
*&      <-- EV_RTN_MSG
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM conv_str_json USING pt_sdata
                                        pv_headhname
                                        pv_tabhname
                                        pv_tabname
                    CHANGING pv_sjson
                             pv_rtn_cd
                             pv_rtn_msg.

  DATA : lv_sjson TYPE String.
  DATA : lv_sjson2 TYPE String.


  lv_sjson = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
    EXPORTING
      data        = pt_sdata
  ).

  DATA(lv_sjson_len) = strlen( lv_sjson ) - 2.
*  lv_sjson = '{"ET_RETURN":{"item":' && lv_sjson && '}}'.
*  lv_sjson = lv_sjson.
  lv_sjson = substring( val = lv_sjson off = 1 len = lv_sjson_len ).

  "5MB -> 5,242,880 B
*  IF strlen( lv_sjson ) > 5242880.

  IF strlen( lv_sjson ) > 5000000.

    pv_rtn_cd = 'E'.
    pv_rtn_msg = TEXT-e69 .
    RETURN.

  ENDIF.

  IF pv_tabname IS NOT  INITIAL. "ex ) pv_tabname  = item[]

*    CONCATENATE '{"' pv_tabname '"  : [' INTO pv_sjson .

    CONCATENATE '{"'pv_tabname'" : [ 'lv_sjson' ]}' INTO pv_sjson.

    IF pv_tabhname IS NOT  INITIAL. " ex) pv_tabhanem =   pv_tabhanme(passing 상위)   / pv_tabname passing 하위

      CONCATENATE '{"'pv_tabhname'" :'pv_sjson   '}'  INTO pv_sjson.

    ENDIF.


  ENDIF.



ENDFORM.
