*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_validation
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LS_LIST
*&      <-- LS_RETURN
*&      <-- LV_ERR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_obligatory_REQ_SRM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LS_LIST
*&      <-- LS_RETURN
*&      <-- LV_ERR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_obligatory_REQ_SRM USING ps_list STRUCTURE zmms_req_move_srm_to_sap_in
                               CHANGING ps_return STRUCTURE zsifmsg
                                             pv_err.

  IF ps_list-if_srm_key IS INITIAL.
*--if_key는 필수입니다.
    ps_return = VALUE #( type = 'E' errcode = '001' message = ps_list-if_srm_key &&'/'&& ps_list-if_srm_item && TEXT-m07 ).
    pv_err = 'X'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  IF ps_list-if_srm_item IS INITIAL.
*--if_item은 필수입니다.
    ps_return = VALUE #( type = 'E' errcode = '001' message = ps_list-if_srm_key &&'/'&& ps_list-if_srm_item && TEXT-m08 ).
    pv_err = 'X'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_validation_REQ_SRM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LS_LIST
*&      <-- LS_RETURN
*&      <-- LV_ERR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_validation_REQ_SRM USING ps_list STRUCTURE zmms_req_move_srm_to_sap_in
                               CHANGING ps_return STRUCTURE zsifmsg
                                             pv_err.



  IF ps_list-if_gubun NE gc_c AND ps_list-if_gubun NE gc_d.
    "요청 시 지시자는 C(입고), D(취소)만 가능합니다.
    ps_return = VALUE #( type = 'E' errcode = '001' message = ps_list-if_srm_key &&'/'&& ps_list-if_srm_item && TEXT-e53 ).
    "수신 완료한 데이터입니다.
    pv_err = 'X'.
    EXIT.

  ENDIF.


  SELECT SINGLE *
    FROM zmmt0150
    INTO @DATA(ls_0150)
    WHERE if_srm_key = @ps_list-if_srm_key
        AND if_srm_item = @ps_list-if_srm_item
        AND if_gubun = @ps_list-if_gubun
        AND werks = @ps_list-werks.

  " 기처리 이력 확인.
  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    IF ls_0150-if_type = 'S'.
      ps_return = VALUE #( type = 'E' errcode = '006' message = ps_list-if_srm_key &&'/'&& ps_list-if_srm_item && TEXT-m06 ).
      "수신 완료한 데이터입니다.
      pv_err = 'X'.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

*-- 공급업체 확인
  SELECT SINGLE mandt INTO @sy-mandt
    FROM lfm1
   WHERE lifnr = @ps_list-lifnr.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    ps_return = VALUE #( type = 'E' errcode = '044' message = ps_list-if_srm_key &&'/'&& ps_list-if_srm_item && TEXT-m44 ).
    pv_err = 'X'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

*-- 자재번호 플랜트
  SELECT SINGLE mandt INTO @sy-mandt
    FROM marc
   WHERE werks = @ps_list-werks
       AND matnr = @ps_list-matnr.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    ps_return = VALUE #( type = 'E' errcode = '018' message = ps_list-if_srm_key &&'/'&& ps_list-if_srm_item && TEXT-m18 ).
    pv_err = 'X'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.


  "입고 / 취소 시 벨리데이션
  CASE ps_list-if_gubun.

    WHEN gc_c.

    WHEN gc_d.

      "취소 시 기처리 이력 확인.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM
        zmmt0150
        WHERE if_srm_key EQ @ps_list-if_srm_key
            AND if_srm_item EQ @ps_list-if_srm_item
            AND werks EQ @ps_list-werks
        INTO @DATA(lS_0150_old).

      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

        "STATUS 이미 처리된 경우 취소 불가 , 처리 전 데이터만 취소 가능./
        IF ls_0150_old-status IS NOT INITIAL.
          "  재고전기 완료된 데이터는 취소할 수 없습니다.
          ps_return = VALUE #( type = 'E' errcode = '018' message = ps_list-if_srm_key &&'/'&& ps_list-if_srm_item && TEXT-e54 ).
          pv_err = 'X'.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.

      ELSE.

        "  해당 키로 처리된 데이터가 없습니다.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          ps_return = VALUE #( type = 'E' errcode = '018' message = ps_list-if_srm_key &&'/'&& ps_list-if_srm_item && TEXT-m34 ).
          pv_err = 'X'.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.


      ENDIF.





  ENDCASE.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form BAP_BATCH_CLASS_CHANGE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_101
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM bapi_batch_class_change TABLES pt_101 STRUCTURE zmmt0050.

*--배치 데이터 수신 시  입고 성공 데이터에 HSDAT(제조일) ,LICHA(공급업체 배치 입력)

  DATA : lv_float TYPE cawn-atflv.
  DATA : lv_float2 TYPE cawn-atflv.
  DATA : lv_indate TYPE cawn-atwrt.
  DATA : lv_licha TYPE cawn-atwrt.
  DATA : lv_matnr TYPE matnr.

  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_tmp,
          matnr(18),
          charg     TYPE charg_d,
        END OF ls_tmp.
  DATA: lv_tmp TYPE bapi1003_key-object.

  DATA lv_object      TYPE bapi1003_key-object.

  DATA lt_numnew  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapi1003_alloc_values_num.
  DATA lt_charnew TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapi1003_alloc_values_char.
  DATA: ls_allocvaluesnum TYPE bapi1003_alloc_values_num .
  DATA lt_currnew TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapi1003_alloc_values_curr.
  DATA lt_return            TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapiret2.

  SELECT *
    FROM marc
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_marc)
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @pt_101
    WHERE matnr EQ @pt_101-matnr
         AND werks EQ @pt_101-werks.


  SORT pt_101 BY matnr werks charg.
  SORT lt_marc BY matnr werks.


  LOOP AT pt_101 INTO DATA(ls_101) WHERE matnr IS NOT INITIAL AND charg IS NOT INITIAL. " 자재코드, 배치번호가 있는 대상만

    CLEAR : lv_float, lv_float2 , lv_object, lv_indate,lv_licha, lv_tmp, ls_tmp, lt_numnew, lt_charnew, lt_currnew.

    "데이터는 수신 받았지만 해당 데이터가 배치 미관리대상인 경우 제외
    READ TABLE lt_marc INTO DATA(ls_marc) WITH KEY matnr = ls_101-matnr
                                                                             werks = ls_101-werks.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      IF ls_marc-xchpf IS INITIAL.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    "배치클래스 제조일이 없는 경우 전기일로 기입.
    lv_indate = COND #( WHEN ls_101-hsdat IS INITIAL THEN ls_101-budat ELSE ls_101-hsdat ).
    ls_tmp-matnr = ls_101-matnr.
    ls_tmp-charg = ls_101-charg.
    "자재번호 + 배치에 대한 변수 자리 수 때문인지 해당 변수 타입으로 해야 인식
    lv_tmp = ls_tmp.

    " 제조일 플로팅 ausp에 입력 시 날짜 타입 플로팅 변환
    CALL FUNCTION 'CTCV_CONVERT_DATE_TO_FLOAT'
      EXPORTING
        date  = lv_indate
      IMPORTING
        float = lv_float.


    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_OBJCL_GETDETAIL'
      EXPORTING
        objectkey       = lv_tmp                  " Object Key, Concatenated
        objecttable     = 'MCH1'                 " Classification BAPI - Key Fields
        classnum        = 'Z_PP_BAT'                  " Class Number
        classtype       = '023'                 " Class Type
      TABLES
        allocvaluesnum  = lt_numnew  "LT_GET_VALUE_NUM
        allocvalueschar = lt_charnew "LT_GET_VALUE_CHAR
        allocvaluescurr = lt_currnew
        return          = lt_return.

    READ TABLE lt_numnew INTO DATA(ls_numnew) WITH KEY charact = 'ZHSDAT'.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0. "기존 값있는 경우
      ls_numnew-value_from = lv_float.
      MODIFY lt_numnew FROM ls_numnew  INDEX sy-tabix
                TRANSPORTING value_from.
    ELSE.
      ls_numnew-charact = 'ZHSDAT'.
      ls_numnew-value_from = lv_float.
      APPEND ls_numnew TO lt_numnew.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_charnew INTO DATA(ls_charnew) WITH KEY charact = 'ZBATNO'.
*
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0. "기존 값있는 경우
      ls_charnew-value_neutral = ls_101-licha.
      ls_charnew-value_neutral_long = ls_101-licha.

      MODIFY lt_charnew FROM ls_charnew  INDEX sy-tabix
                TRANSPORTING value_neutral value_neutral_long.
    ELSE.
      ls_charnew-charact = 'ZBATNO'.
      "I/F 공급업체 배치가 없는 경우 SAP 배치 기입
      ls_charnew-value_neutral = COND #( WHEN ls_101-licha IS INITIAL THEN ls_101-charg
                                                   ELSE ls_101-licha ) .
      ls_charnew-value_neutral_long = COND #( WHEN ls_101-licha IS INITIAL THEN ls_101-charg
                                                   ELSE ls_101-licha ) .
      APPEND ls_charnew TO lt_charnew.
    ENDIF.

    REFRESH lt_return.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_OBJCL_CHANGE'
      EXPORTING
        objectkey          = lv_tmp
        objecttable        = 'MCH1'
        classnum           = 'Z_PP_BAT'
        classtype          = '023'
*       STATUS             = '1'
*       STANDARDCLASS      = STANDARDCLASS
*       CHANGENUMBER       = CHANGENUMBER
*       KEYDATE            = SY-DATUM
*       NO_DEFAULT_VALUES  = ' '
*       KEEP_SAME_DEFAULTS = ' '
*       OBJECTKEY_LONG     = OBJECTKEY_LONG
* IMPORTING
*       CLASSIF_STATUS     = CLASSIF_STATUS
      TABLES
        allocvaluesnumnew  = lt_numnew
        allocvaluescharnew = lt_charnew
        allocvaluescurrnew = lt_currnew
        return             = lt_return.

    READ TABLE lt_return INTO DATA(ls_return) WITH KEY type = 'S'.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
        EXPORTING
          wait = abap_true.

    ELSE.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.




ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form DATAX_POITEMIC
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM datax_poitemic USING p_field01
                          p_field02
                          p_field03
                          p_field04
                          p_field05
                          p_field06
                          p_field07
                          p_field08
                          p_field09
                          p_field10
                          p_field11
                          p_field12
                          p_field13
                          p_field14
                          p_field15
                          p_field16
                          p_field17
                   CHANGING ps_datax STRUCTURE bapimepoitemx
                            ps_data STRUCTURE bapimepoitem
                     .

  FIELD-SYMBOLS :<datax>, <cnt>, <val>, <data>.
  DATA : l_n TYPE n LENGTH 2.
  DATA : fieldname(30).
  CLEAR : ps_datax, fieldname, l_n.

  DO 17 TIMES.
    ADD 1 TO l_n.
    CONCATENATE 'p_field' l_n INTO fieldname.
    ASSIGN (fieldname) TO <cnt>.
    ASSIGN (fieldname) TO <val>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF <val> IS NOT INITIAL.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <val> OF STRUCTURE ps_data TO <data>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
***>> ps_data가 존재하면 ps_datax를 설정하기 ***********************************
          IF <data> IS NOT INITIAL.
            IF <cnt> IS NOT INITIAL.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT <cnt> OF STRUCTURE ps_datax TO <datax>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                <datax> = 'X'.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
***<< ps_data가 존재하면 ps_datax를 설정하기 ***********************************
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDDO.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form get_fi_doc_item
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_UPDATE_BELNR_FI
*&      --> LT_UPDATE_GJAHR
*&      <-- LT_UPDATE_BELNR_FI
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM get_fi_doc_item USING p_fidoc p_gjahr
                CHANGING p_buzei.


  DO 2 TIMES.
*-- FI DOC 회계전표 공급업체 AP 전표 추적
    SELECT SINGLE buzei INTO @DATA(lv_buzei)
      FROM bseg
     WHERE belnr = @p_fidoc
         AND gjahr = @p_gjahr
          AND bschl IN ( '21', '31' ) " 21대변 메모, 31 일반 송장
            AND koart EQ 'K'.

    IF lv_BUZEI IS INITIAL.
      WAIT  UP TO 1 SECONDS.
    ELSE.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDDO.

  p_buzei = lv_buzei.

ENDFORM.

***5. MRO 구매오더 데이터 점검
*5.1. 조건 : BSART(구매 문서 유형) = 'ZMR'
*5.1. 점검 데이터 : G/L 계정(SAKTO), 코스트센터(KOSTL) 데이터가 없으면 에러 "G/L 계정 또는 코스트센터 정보를 확인 바랍니다."

***6. 자산 구매오더 데이터 점검
*6.1. 조건 : BSART(구매 문서 유형) = 'ZAC'
*6.1. 점검 데이터 : 자산코드(ANLN1), 투자번호(AUFNR) 데이터가 없으면 에러 "자산번호 또는 투자번호 정보를 확인 바랍니다."

    IF ls_header-bsart EQ 'ZMR'.
      IF ls_item-sakto IS INITIAL AND ls_item-kostl IS INITIAL.
        IF lv_emessage IS INITIAL.
          lv_emessage = TEXT-e01.
        ELSE.
          CONCATENATE lv_emessage TEXT-e01 INTO lv_emessage SEPARATED BY space.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ELSEIF ls_header-bsart EQ 'ZAC'.
      IF ls_item-anln1 IS INITIAL AND ls_item-aufnr IS INITIAL.
        IF lv_emessage IS INITIAL.
          lv_emessage = TEXT-e02.
        ELSE.
          CONCATENATE lv_emessage TEXT-e02 INTO lv_emessage SEPARATED BY space.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF ls_header-change_ind NE c_i.
      CONCATENATE lv_emessage TEXT-e03 INTO lv_emessage SEPARATED BY space.
    ENDIF.

    IF ls_item-epstp EQ gc_l OR ls_header-bsart EQ 'ZSC'.
      ls_item-matnr = |{ ls_item-matnr ALPHA = IN WIDTH = 18 }|.
      ls_item-banfn = |{ ls_item-banfn ALPHA = IN  }|.
      ls_item-bnfpo = |{ ls_item-bnfpo ALPHA = IN  }|.

      SELECT a~rsnum, a~rspos, a~posnr, a~ebeln, a~ebelp, a~werks, a~matnr, a~dumps,
             a~lgort, a~lifnr, a~bdmng, a~charg, a~meins, a~posnr AS zposnr
        FROM resb AS a
       WHERE a~banfn = @ls_item-banfn
         AND a~bnfpo = @ls_item-bnfpo
         AND a~postp NOT IN ('N', 'T')
         AND a~baugr = @ls_item-matnr
        ORDER BY a~posnr ASCENDING, a~matnr
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_resb.

      SELECT a~*

***>> BAPI_PO_CREATE1 ******************************************
  IF  lv_temessage IS INITIAL.
    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_PO_CREATE1'
      EXPORTING
        poheader         = ls_pohead
        poheaderx        = ls_poheadx
        testrun          = ' '
      IMPORTING
        exppurchaseorder = lv_po_number
      TABLES
        return           = lt_return
        poitem           = lt_poitem       "구매오더 품목별 정보
        poitemx          = lt_poitemx
        poaccount        = lt_poaccount    "구매오더 계정지정필드
        poaccountx       = lt_poaccountx
        poschedule       = lt_posched       "구매오더 납품일정라인 정보
        poschedulex      = lt_poschedx
        pocomponents     = lt_pocomponents
        pocomponentsx    = lt_pocomponentsx
        pocond           = lt_pocond
        pocondx          = lt_pocondx.

    IF lv_po_number IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_emessage IS INITIAL.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
        EXPORTING
          wait = 'X'.

      WAIT UP TO '0.5' SECONDS.

      CLEAR lt_resb.
      SELECT a~rsnum, a~rspos, a~posnr, a~ebeln, a~ebelp, a~werks, a~matnr,
             a~lgort, a~lifnr, a~bdmng, a~charg, a~meins
        FROM resb AS a
       WHERE a~ebeln = @lv_po_number
         AND a~postp NOT IN ('N', 'T')
         AND a~dumps IS INITIAL " 가상품목은 확인하지 않는다 2025.05.13
        ORDER BY a~ebeln, a~ebelp, a~matnr, a~posnr
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_resb.

      CLEAR ls_response.
      READ TABLE lt_return INTO ls_return WITH KEY type = 'S' .
      LOOP AT lt_response ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_succ>).
        <ls_succ>-ebeln = lv_po_number.
        <ls_succ>-type = ls_return-type.

*--2025.05.26 PO 생성 이후 임가공품목 반영 확인

        IF <ls_succ>-component IS NOT INITIAL.
          _matn1 'I' <ls_succ>-component lv_matnr.
          READ TABLE lt_resb INTO DATA(ls_PORESB) WITH KEY ebeln = <ls_succ>-ebeln
                                                                                                              ebelp = <ls_succ>-ebelp
                                                                                                              matnr = lv_matnr.
          IF sy-subrc NE 0.
            <ls_succ>-type = gc_e.
            <ls_succ>-message = TEXT-e74.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR : lv_matnr.
      ENDLOOP.

      CLEAR lt_resb[].
    ELSE.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.

      "ERROR 처리방안
      LOOP AT lt_item INTO DATA(lv_item).
        lv_i = sy-tabix.
        LOOP AT lt_response ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_error>) WHERE srmpo = ls_item-srmpo
                                                                  AND srmpo_item = ls_item-srmpo_item.
          CLEAR ls_response.
          READ TABLE lt_return INTO ls_return WITH KEY type = 'E' .
          LOOP AT lt_return INTO ls_return WHERE type EQ 'E' AND row EQ lv_i.
            IF ls_response-errcode IS INITIAL.
              ls_response-type = ls_return-type.
              lv_string3 = ls_return-number.
              ls_response-errcode = lv_string3.
              CONCATENATE ls_return-parameter ls_return-message INTO ls_response-message SEPARATED BY space.
            ELSE.
              TRY.
                  CONCATENATE ls_response-message '&' ls_return-parameter ls_return-message INTO ls_response-message SEPARATED BY space.
                CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
              ENDTRY.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.

          <ls_error>-type = ls_response-type.
          <ls_error>-message = ls_response-message.
          <ls_error>-errcode = ls_response-errcode.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.
***<< BAPI_PO_CREATE1 **********************************************

***>>> zmmt0070 작성 **************************************************************
  "기생성된 이력확인
  SELECT *
   FROM zmmt0070
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_send
    WHERE ebeln = @lv_po_number
      AND ebelp = @lt_send-ebelp
      AND ebeln IS NOT INITIAL
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_0070_old).

  SORT lt_0070_old BY ebeln ebelp.

  LOOP AT lt_send INTO DATA(ls_send).
    READ TABLE lt_0070_old INTO DATA(ls_0070_old) WITH KEY ebeln = lv_po_number
                                                           ebelp = ls_send-ebelp BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_0070_old TO ls_0070.
      ls_0070-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_0070-aenam = sy-uname.
      ls_0070-aezet = sy-timlo.

      IF ls_header-change_ind EQ c_u.
        ls_0070-status = c_u.
      ELSEIF ls_header-change_ind EQ c_d.
        ls_0070-status = c_d.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.  "신규 전송.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_send TO ls_0070.
      ls_0070-status = gc_i.
      IF lv_po_number IS NOT INITIAL.
        ls_0070-ebeln = lv_po_number.
        ls_0070-bsart = ls_header-bsart.
        ls_0070-bukrs = lv_bukrs.

        ls_0070-banfn = |{ ls_send-banfn ALPHA = IN }|.
        ls_0070-bnfpo = |{ ls_send-bnfpo ALPHA = IN }|.
      ENDIF.
      ls_0070-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_0070-ernam = sy-uname.
      ls_0070-erzet = sy-timlo.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_0070 TO lt_0070.
  ENDLOOP.

  TRY.
      MODIFY zmmt0070 FROM TABLE lt_0070.
      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
        COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
      ENDIF.
    CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lv_oref).
      DATA(lv_text) = lv_oref->get_text( ).
  ENDTRY.

*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* ZMMT0330 EBELN, EBELP 업데이트
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
  DATA: lt_save_330 TYPE TABLE OF zmmt0330.
  DATA: lt_save_350 TYPE TABLE OF zmmt0350.

  SELECT a~*,
         @sy-datlo AS aedat,
         @sy-timlo AS aezet,
         @sy-uname AS aenam,
         d~ebeln,
         d~ebelp
    FROM zmmt0330 AS a INNER JOIN @lt_item AS b
                               ON lpad( b~banfn, 10, '0' ) = a~banfn
                              AND lpad( b~bnfpo, 5, '0' ) = a~bnfpo
                       INNER JOIN zmmt0070 AS d
                               ON d~ebeln = @lv_po_number
                              AND d~banfn = lpad( b~banfn, 10, '0' )
                              AND d~bnfpo = lpad( b~bnfpo, 5, '0' )
   WHERE a~ebeln IS INITIAL
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_save_330.

  IF lt_save_330 IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zmmt0330 FROM TABLE lt_save_330.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT a~*,
         @sy-datlo AS aedat,
         @sy-timlo AS aezet,
         @sy-uname AS aenam,
         d~ebeln,
         d~ebelp,
         'P' AS mm_stat
    FROM zmmt0350 AS a INNER JOIN @lt_item AS b
                               ON lpad( b~banfn, 10, '0' ) = a~banfn
                              AND lpad( b~bnfpo, 5, '0' ) = a~bnfpo
                       INNER JOIN zmmt0070 AS d
                               ON d~ebeln = @lv_po_number
                              AND d~banfn = lpad( b~banfn, 10, '0' )
                              AND d~bnfpo = lpad( b~bnfpo, 5, '0' )
   WHERE a~ebeln IS INITIAL
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_save_350.

  IF lt_save_350 IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY zmmt0350 FROM TABLE lt_save_350.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
  ENDIF.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM
  bapi_po_create2  USING   pv_header TYPE zmms_po_create_header
                              pv_item TYPE ANY TABLE
                              pv_itemall TYPE ANY TABLE
                              pv_result TYPE ANY TABLE.

  DATA : ls_header  TYPE zmms_po_create_header,
         lt_item    LIKE TABLE OF zmms_po_create_items,
         lt_itemall LIKE TABLE OF zmms_po_create_items.

  DATA : lv_emessage  TYPE bapiret2-message,
         lv_temessage TYPE bapiret2-message.
  DATA : lt_0070 TYPE TABLE OF zmmt0070 WITH HEADER LINE. "sap srm if cbo.
  DATA : ls_0070 TYPE zmmt0070.
  DATA : lt_send TYPE TABLE OF zmmt0070 WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA : lc_error    TYPE REF TO cx_sy_open_sql_db, "open sql error
         lvLlog_info TYPE zcas_0050,
         lv_msg      TYPE string,
         lv_i        TYPE i.
  DATA : lv_num     TYPE int8,
         lv_num2    TYPE int8,
         lv_rnum    TYPE int8,
         lv_string3 TYPE char4.
  DATA : ls_response TYPE zmms_po_create_return,
         lt_response LIKE TABLE OF zmms_po_create_return.
  DATA  : ls_pohead  TYPE bapimepoheader.
  DATA  : ls_poheadx TYPE bapimepoheaderx.
  DATA  : ls_head TYPE bapimepoheader.
  DATA  : lt_return TYPE TABLE OF bapiret2 WITH HEADER LINE,
          ls_return TYPE bapiret2.
  DATA  : lt_poitem  TYPE TABLE OF bapimepoitem WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA  : lt_poitemx TYPE TABLE OF bapimepoitemx WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA  : lt_poaccount  TYPE TABLE OF bapimepoaccount WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA  : lt_poaccountx TYPE TABLE OF bapimepoaccountx WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA  : lt_pocomponents  TYPE TABLE OF bapimepocomponent WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA  : lt_pocomponentsx TYPE TABLE OF bapimepocomponentx WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA  : lt_posched  TYPE TABLE OF bapimeposchedule WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA  : lt_poschedx TYPE TABLE OF bapimeposchedulx WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA  : lt_pocond  TYPE TABLE OF bapimepocond WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA  : lt_pocondx TYPE TABLE OF bapimepocondx WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA  : lv_po_number TYPE bapimepoheader-po_number.
  DATA  : ls_purchaseorder  TYPE bapimepoheader-po_number.
  DATA  : ls_poheader  TYPE bapimepoheader.
  DATA  : ls_poheaderx  TYPE bapimepoheaderx.
  DATA  : lt_eban TYPE TABLE OF eban WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA : BEGIN OF ls_resb ,
           rsnum  TYPE rsnum,
           rspos  TYPE rspos,
           posnr  TYPE aposn,   "bom posnr
           zposnr TYPE aposn,   "bom posnr  공백 제거
           rposnr TYPE aposn,   "bom posnr insert 시 "E" -> "I" 순차적 증가 10,20,30,...
           ebeln  TYPE ebeln,
           ebelp  TYPE ebelp,
           matnr  TYPE matnr,
           lgort  TYPE lgort_d,
           lifnr  TYPE lifnr,
           bdmng  TYPE bdmng,
           charg  TYPE CHARG_d,
           meins  TYPE meins,
           werks  TYPE werks_d,
           dumps  TYPE dumps,
           flag   TYPE char4,
         END OF ls_resb,
         lt_resb LIKE TABLE OF ls_resb.

  CONSTANTS : c_a VALUE 'A',
              c_d VALUE 'D',
              c_i VALUE 'I',
              c_l VALUE 'L',
              c_k VALUE 'K',
              c_u VALUE 'U',
              c_x VALUE 'X'
              .
  DATA: del_date TYPE sy-datum.
  DATA : lv_change TYPE char1.

*  data : lt_0070_h type table of zmmt0070_h with header line. "sap srm if cbo.
*  data : lt_0070_d type table of zmmt0070_d with header line. "sap srm if cbo.
*  data : lt_0070_r type table of zmmt0070_r with header line. "sap srm if cbo.
*  ls_header = pv_header.
  ls_header = CORRESPONDING #( pv_header ).
  lt_item[] = CORRESPONDING #( pv_item[] ).
  lt_itemall[] = CORRESPONDING #( pv_itemall[] ).
  lt_response[] = CORRESPONDING #( pv_result[] ).

  SORT lt_item BY srmpo srmpo_item.
*  READ TABLE lt_header INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lv_header).

  READ TABLE lt_item INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_item).

*  clear
  CLEAR ls_0070.
  CLEAR : ls_pohead, ls_poheadx.

* Header Level Data
  SELECT SINGLE bukrs
    FROM t001k
    WHERE bwkey EQ @ls_item-werks
    INTO @DATA(lv_bukrs).

  SELECT a~banfn, a~bnfpo, a~pstyp
    FROM eban AS a
   WHERE a~banfn EQ @ls_item-banfn
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_eban.

***>> POHEADER **********************************************
  ls_pohead-comp_code = lv_bukrs.           "company
  ls_pohead-doc_type   = ls_header-bsart .  "오더유형 (구매)
  ls_pohead-doc_type = |{ ls_pohead-doc_type ALPHA = IN }|.
  ls_pohead-item_intvl = '00010'. "default
  ls_pohead-vendor = ls_header-lifnr.       "공급업체
  ls_pohead-vendor = |{ ls_pohead-vendor ALPHA = IN }|.
  ls_pohead-purch_org = ls_header-ekorg.    "구매조직
  ls_pohead-currency = ls_header-waers.     "가격단위
  ls_pohead-pur_group = ls_header-ekgrp.    "구매그룹
  ls_pohead-pmnttrms = ls_header-zterm.    "지급조건
  ls_pohead-incoterms1 = ls_header-inco1.    "인도조건
  ls_pohead-incoterms2l = '.'.            "인도장소
  ls_pohead-langu      = sy-langu.
*  ls_pohead-creat_date = sy-datum .
  ls_pohead-doc_date   = sy-datum.

*  ls_poheader = VALUE #( comp_code = lv_bukrs
*                        doc_type   = ls_header-bsart
*                        item_intvl = '00010'
*                        vendor = |{ ls_pohead-vendor ALPHA = IN }|
*                        purch_org = ls_header-ekorg
*                        currency = ls_header-waers
*                        pur_group = ls_header-ekgrp
*                        langu      = sy-langu
*                        doc_date   = sy-datum
*                       ).
***<< POHEADER **********************************************
***>> POHEADERX **********************************************
  ls_poheadx-comp_code  = abap_true.
  ls_poheadx-doc_type   = abap_true.
  ls_poheadx-item_intvl     = abap_true.
  ls_poheadx-vendor     = abap_true.
  ls_poheadx-purch_org  = abap_true.
  ls_poheadx-currency  = abap_true.
  ls_poheadx-pur_group  = abap_true.
  IF ls_header-zterm IS NOT INITIAL.
    ls_poheadx-pmnttrms   = abap_true.
  ENDIF.
  IF ls_header-inco1 IS NOT INITIAL.
    ls_poheadx-incoterms1   = abap_true.
  ENDIF.
  IF ls_pohead-incoterms2l IS NOT INITIAL.
    ls_poheadx-incoterms2l = abap_true.
  ENDIF.
  ls_poheadx-langu      = abap_true.
*  ls_poheadx-creat_date = abap_true.
  ls_poheadx-doc_date   = abap_true.

*  ls_poheaderx = VALUE #(
*                          comp_code  = abap_true
*                          doc_type   = abap_true
*                          item_intvl     = abap_true
*                          vendor     = abap_true
*                          purch_org  = abap_true
*                          currency  = abap_true
*                          pur_group  = abap_true
*                          langu      = abap_true
*                          doc_date   = abap_true
*                        ).
***<< POHEADERX **********************************************

* Item Level Data
  CLEAR: ls_item.
  lv_num = lv_num2 = lv_rnum = 0.

  LOOP AT lt_item INTO ls_item.
    CLEAR lv_emessage.
    CLEAR : lt_poitem, lt_poitemx, lt_poaccount, lt_poaccountx,
            lt_pocomponents, lt_pocomponentsx, lt_posched, lt_poschedx, lt_pocond, lt_pocondx.

*****>> DATA CONVERSION ******************************************************************
    REPLACE '-' WITH '' INTO ls_item-eeind.        "10자리 '-' 제거.
*****<< DATA CONVERSION ******************************************************************

***>> 구매오더 생성 ****************************************************************************
    ADD 10 TO lv_num.
    lv_num2 = 0.

    ls_item-ebelp = lv_num.

***>> POITEM **********************************************
*    READ TABLE lt_eban INTO DATA(ls_eban) WITH KEY banfn = ls_item-banfn.
*    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*      SELECT SINGLE epstp
*        FROM t163x
*        WHERE pstyp = @ls_eban-pstyp
*           AND spras = @sy-langu
*        INTO @DATA(lv_epstp).
*      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
**        lt_poitem-item_cat = ls_epstp.
*      ENDIF.
*    ENDIF.
    lt_poitem-po_item  = lv_num.                    "품목번호 (10 ~ 10단위 증가)
    lt_poitem-acctasscat = ls_item-knttp.   "ACC
*    IF ls_item-epstp IS NOT INITIAL.
*      IF lv_epstp NE ls_item-epstp.
*        lt_poitem-item_cat = lv_epstp.
*      ELSE.
*        lt_poitem-item_cat = ls_item-epstp.
*      ENDIF.
*    ENDIF.
    lt_poitem-item_cat = ls_item-epstp.
    lt_poitem-material = ls_item-matnr.     "자재번호
    lt_poitem-material = |{ lt_poitem-material ALPHA = IN WIDTH = 18 }|.
    lt_poitem-short_text = ls_item-maktx.  "내역
    lt_poitem-quantity = ls_item-menge.     "구매 오더 수량
    lt_poitem-po_unit = ls_item-meins.      "구매 오더 단위
    lt_poitem-net_price = ls_item-netpr.    "BAPI에 대한 통화 금액(9 소수 자릿수)
    lt_poitem-price_unit = 1.               "가격단위-default.
    IF ls_item-peinh IS NOT INITIAL.
      lt_poitem-price_unit = ls_item-peinh.   "가격단위
    ENDIF.
    lt_poitem-po_price = 1.                    "가격 채택: 1 = 총액, 2 = 단가
    lt_poitem-matl_group = ls_item-matkl.      "자재그룹
    lt_poitem-plant    = ls_item-werks.        "플랜트
    lt_poitem-stge_loc = ls_item-lgort.        "저장위치
    lt_poitem-batch = ls_item-charg.           "배치번호
    lt_poitem-preq_name = ls_item-afnam.       "요청자
*    lt_poitem-ret_item = space.               "반품품목-defalut.
    IF ls_item-retpo IS NOT INITIAL.
      lt_poitem-ret_item = ls_item-retpo.      "반품품목
    ELSE.
      CLEAR lt_poitem-batch.
    ENDIF.
    lt_poitem-preq_no = ls_item-banfn.         "구매요청
    lt_poitem-preq_no = |{ lt_poitem-preq_no ALPHA = IN }|.
    lt_poitem-preq_item = ls_item-bnfpo.       "구매요청 품목
    lt_poitem-preq_item = |{ lt_poitem-preq_item ALPHA = IN }|.
    lt_poitem-tax_code = ls_item-mwskz.        "부가세코드

    TRANSLATE ls_item-meins TO UPPER CASE.    "단위를 대문자로 변경하여 단위값 체크
    TRANSLATE ls_header-bsart TO UPPER CASE.  "오더 유형
*    "***>> 단위체크: EA, KG 단위만// 구매오더유형: ZMR, ZAC, ZIC 제외// 100 EA 이하, 30 KG 이하
*    IF ls_item-meins IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_item-meins EQ 'EA' OR ls_item-meins EQ 'KG'.
*      IF ls_header-bsart IS NOT INITIAL AND ls_header-bsart NE 'ZMR' AND ls_header-bsart NE 'ZAC' AND ls_header-bsart NE 'ZIC'.
*        IF ls_item-menge LE 99.
*          IF ls_item-menge GT 66.               "초과 납품 한도 50 % 등록 (OVER_DLV_TOL = 50)
*            lt_poitem-over_dlv_tol = 50.          "초과납품 한도
*          ELSE.                                  "66 이하 문제한 지시자 체크 (UNLIMITED_DLV = 'X')
*            lt_poitem-unlimited_dlv = abap_true.  "무제한 초과 납품
*          ENDIF.
*        ENDIF.
*      ENDIF.
*    ENDIF.
*    IF ls_header-ekorg EQ '1000'.
*      lt_poitem-gr_basediv = abap_true.     "지시자: 입고 기준 송장 검증
*    ENDIF.
    "**********************************************************
    APPEND lt_poitem.
    "**********************************************************
***<< POITEM **********************************************
***>> POITEMX **********************************************
    PERFORM datax_poitem USING  'ACCTASSCAT'
                                'ITEM_CAT'
                                'MATERIAL'
                                'SHORT_TEXT'
                                'QUANTITY'
                                'PO_UNIT'
                                'NET_PRICE'
                                'PRICE_UNIT'
                                'PO_PRICE'
                                'MATL_GROUP'
                                'PLANT'
                                'STGE_LOC'
                                'BATCH'
                                'PREQ_NAME'
                                'RET_ITEM'
                                'PREQ_NO'
                                'PREQ_ITEM'
                                'TAX_CODE'
                                'UNLIMITED_DLV'
                                'GR_BASEDIV'
                                'OVER_DLV_TOL'
                          CHANGING lt_poitemx
                                   lt_poitem
                            .
    lt_poitemx-po_itemx = 'X'.
    lt_poitemx-po_item    = lv_num.
    "**********************************************************
    APPEND lt_poitemx.
    "**********************************************************
    LOOP AT lt_response ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_item_num>) WHERE srmpo = ls_item-srmpo
                                                                AND srmpo_item = ls_item-srmpo_item.
      <ls_item_num>-ebelp = lv_num.
      IF ls_item-menge > 0.
      ELSE.
        <ls_item_num>-type = gc_e.
        <ls_item_num>-errcode = '001'.
        <ls_item_num>-message = TEXT-e57.
        lv_temessage = TEXT-e57.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
***<< POITEMX *************************************************

***5. MRO 구매오더 데이터 점검
*5.1. 조건 : BSART(구매 문서 유형) = 'ZMR'
*5.1. 점검 데이터 : G/L 계정(SAKTO), 코스트센터(KOSTL) 데이터가 없으면 에러 "G/L 계정 또는 코스트센터 정보를 확인 바랍니다."

***6. 자산 구매오더 데이터 점검
*6.1. 조건 : BSART(구매 문서 유형) = 'ZAC'
*6.1. 점검 데이터 : 자산코드(ANLN1), 투자번호(AUFNR) 데이터가 없으면 에러 "자산번호 또는 투자번호 정보를 확인 바랍니다."

    IF ls_header-bsart EQ 'ZMR'.
      IF ls_item-sakto IS INITIAL AND ls_item-kostl IS INITIAL.
        IF lv_emessage IS INITIAL.
          lv_emessage = TEXT-e01.
        ELSE.
          CONCATENATE lv_emessage TEXT-e01 INTO lv_emessage SEPARATED BY space.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ELSEIF ls_header-bsart EQ 'ZAC'.
      IF ls_item-anln1 IS INITIAL AND ls_item-aufnr IS INITIAL.
        IF lv_emessage IS INITIAL.
          lv_emessage = TEXT-e02.
        ELSE.
          CONCATENATE lv_emessage TEXT-e02 INTO lv_emessage SEPARATED BY space.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF ls_header-change_ind NE c_i.
      CONCATENATE lv_emessage TEXT-e03 INTO lv_emessage SEPARATED BY space.
    ENDIF.

***>> POACCOUNT **********************************************
    lt_poaccount-po_item  = lv_num.  "구매오더 품목번호
    IF ls_item-knttp IS NOT INITIAL.
      lt_poaccount-serial_no  = gc_1.          "계정지정순번
      lt_poaccount-serial_no = |{ lt_poaccount-serial_no ALPHA = IN }|.
      lt_poaccount-quantity = ls_item-menge.      "구매요청수량
*      lt_poaccount-creat_date = SY-DATUM.      "생성일
    ENDIF.

    IF ls_item-knttp EQ c_k.
      lt_poaccount-gl_account = ls_item-sakto.    "G/L 계정
      lt_poaccount-costcenter = ls_item-kostl.    "코스트센터
      lt_poaccount-gl_account = |{ lt_poaccount-gl_account ALPHA = IN }|.
      lt_poaccount-costcenter = |{ lt_poaccount-costcenter ALPHA = IN }|.
    ENDIF.
    IF ls_item-knttp EQ c_a.
      lt_poaccount-gl_account = ls_item-sakto.    "G/L 계정
      lt_poaccount-gl_account = |{ lt_poaccount-gl_account ALPHA = IN }|.
      lt_poaccount-asset_no = ls_item-anln1.      "자산코드
      lt_poaccount-asset_no = |{ lt_poaccount-asset_no ALPHA = IN }|.
      lt_poaccount-orderid = ls_item-aufnr.       "오더번호
      lt_poaccount-orderid = |{ lt_poaccount-orderid ALPHA = IN }|.
    ENDIF.
    "**********************************************************
    APPEND lt_poaccount.
    "**********************************************************
***<< POACCOUNT **********************************************
***>> POACCOUNTX *********************************************
    PERFORM datax_poaccount USING 'SERIAL_NO'
                                  'QUANTITY'
                                  'GL_ACCOUNT'
                                  'COSTCENTER'
                                  'ASSET_NO'
                                  'ORDERID'
                          CHANGING lt_poaccountx
                                   lt_poaccount
                                    .
    lt_poaccountx-po_item = lv_num.  "구매오더 품목번호
    lt_poaccountx-serial_no = gc_1. "계정지정순번
    lt_poaccountx-po_itemx = abap_true.
    lt_poaccountx-serial_nox = abap_true.
    "**********************************************************
    APPEND lt_poaccountx.
    "**********************************************************
***>> POSCHEDULE **********************************************
    lt_posched-po_item = lv_num.        "품목번호
    lt_posched-sched_line  = gc_1.              "계정지정순번
    lt_posched-del_datcat_ext  = c_d.              "납품일 범주

*
*

*
*      "ERROR 처리방안
*      LOOP AT lt_item INTO DATA(lv_item).

*              lv_string3 = ls_return-number.

*            ELSE.

*              ENDTRY.
*            ENDIF.

*          <ls_error>-type = ls_response-type.

*        ENDLOOP.
*      ENDLOOP.
*    ENDIF.
*
*  ENDIF.

***>>> ZMMT0030 작성 **************************************************************
  "기생성된 이력확인
  SELECT *
   FROM zmmt0070
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_send
    WHERE ebeln = @ls_header-ebeln
      AND ebelp = @lt_send-ebelp
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_0070_OLD).

  SORT lt_0070_old BY ebeln ebelp.

  LOOP AT lt_send INTO DATA(ls_send).
    READ TABLE lt_0070_old INTO DATA(ls_0070_old)
                           WITH KEY ebeln = ls_header-ebeln
                                    ebelp = ls_send-ebelp
                           BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_0070_old TO ls_0070.
      ls_0070-aedat = sy-datum.
      ls_0070-aenam = sy-uname.
      ls_0070-aezet = sy-timlo.

    ELSE.  "신규 전송.
      ls_0070-ebeln = ls_header-ebeln.
      ls_0070-ebelp = ls_send-ebelp.

      ls_0070-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_0070-ernam = sy-uname.
      ls_0070-erzet = sy-timlo.
    ENDIF.

    IF ls_item-change_ind EQ c_u.
      ls_0070-status = c_u.
    ELSEIF ls_item-change_ind EQ c_d.
      ls_0070-status = c_d.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_0070 TO lt_0070.
  ENDLOOP.

  TRY.
      MODIFY zmmt0070 FROM TABLE lt_0070.
    CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lv_oref).
      DATA(lv_text) = lv_oref->get_text( ).
  ENDTRY.
***>> Log 작성 ********************************************************************

  pv_result[] = CORRESPONDING #( lt_response[] ).

ENDFORM.

              c_i        VALUE 'I',
              c_l        VALUE 'L',
              c_o        VALUE 'O',
              c_s        VALUE 'S',
              c_k        VALUE 'K',
              c_u        VALUE 'U',
              c_x        VALUE 'X',
              gc_ea(2)   TYPE c VALUE 'EA',
              gc_kg(2)   TYPE c VALUE 'KG',
              gc_10(2)   TYPE c VALUE '10',
              gc_zic(3)  TYPE c VALUE 'ZIC',
              gc_zmr(3)  TYPE c VALUE 'ZMR',
              gc_zac(3)  TYPE c VALUE 'ZAC',
              gc_1000(4) TYPE c VALUE '1000',
              gc4_01(4)  TYPE c VALUE '0001',
              gc5_10(5)  TYPE c VALUE '00010'
              .

  ls_header = CORRESPONDING #( pv_header ).
  lt_item[] = CORRESPONDING #( pv_item[] ).

  SORT lt_item BY srmpo srmpo_item.
  READ TABLE lt_item INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_item).

  CLEAR : lt_eban[], lt_eban, lv_podate.

  lv_podate = sy-datum.

  IF ls_item-banfn IS NOT INITIAL.
    SELECT banfn, bnfpo, zzgwlink
      FROM eban
      WHERE banfn = @ls_item-banfn
        AND bnfpo = @ls_item-bnfpo
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_eban.
  ENDIF.

* Header Level Data
  SELECT SINGLE bukrs
    FROM t001k
    WHERE bwkey EQ @ls_item-werks
    INTO @DATA(lv_bukrs).

  IF ls_header-change_ind EQ c_i.
***>> POHEADER **********************************************
    ls_pohead-comp_code = lv_bukrs.           "company
    ls_pohead-doc_type   = ls_header-bsart .  "오더유형 (구매)
    ls_pohead-item_intvl = gc5_10. "default
    ls_pohead-vendor = ls_header-lifnr.       "공급업체
    ls_pohead-vendor = |{ ls_pohead-vendor ALPHA = IN }|.
    ls_pohead-purch_org = ls_header-ekorg.    "구매조직
    ls_pohead-currency = ls_header-waers.     "가격단위
    ls_pohead-pur_group = ls_header-ekgrp.    "구매그룹

    ls_pohead-langu      = sy-langu.
*  ls_pohead-creat_date = sy-datum .
    ls_pohead-doc_date   = lv_podate.
***<< POHEADER **********************************************
***>> POHEADERX **********************************************
    ls_poheadx-comp_code  = abap_true.
    ls_poheadx-doc_type   = abap_true.
    ls_poheadx-item_intvl     = abap_true.
    ls_poheadx-vendor     = abap_true.
    ls_poheadx-purch_org  = abap_true.
    ls_poheadx-currency  = abap_true.
    ls_poheadx-pur_group  = abap_true.

    ls_poheadx-langu      = abap_true.
*  ls_poheadx-creat_date = abap_true.
    ls_poheadx-doc_date   = abap_true.
***<< POHEADERX **********************************************

    IF ls_header-bsart NE gc_zic.
      CONCATENATE ls_emessage TEXT-e03 INTO ls_emessage SEPARATED BY space.
    ENDIF.

* Item Level Data
    CLEAR: ls_item.
    ls_num = 0.
    ls_num2 = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_item INTO ls_item.

*****>> DATA CONVERSION ******************************************************************
      REPLACE '-' WITH '' INTO ls_item-eeind.        "10자리 '-' 제거.
*****<< DATA CONVERSION ******************************************************************

***>> 구매오더 생성 ****************************************************************************
      ADD 10 TO ls_num.
      ADD 1 TO ls_num2.

      ls_item-ebelp = ls_num.
      ls_item-matnr = |{ ls_item-matnr ALPHA = IN WIDTH = 18 }|.
      _matn1 'I' ls_item-matnr ls_item-matnr. "convert 자재코드
***>> POITEM **********************************************
      lt_poitem-po_item  = ls_num.                    "품목번호 (10 ~ 10단위 증가)
      lt_poitem-acctasscat = ls_item-knttp.   "ACC
      lt_poitem-material = ls_item-matnr.     "자재번호
      SELECT SINGLE ZZmaktx AS maktx FROM makt
                          WHERE matnr EQ @ls_item-matnr AND spras = @sy-langu
      INTO @lt_poitem-short_text.             "내역
      lt_poitem-quantity = ls_item-menge.     "구매 오더 수량
      lt_poitem-po_unit = ls_item-meins.      "구매 오더 단위
      lt_poitem-net_price = ls_item-netpr.    "BAPI에 대한 통화 금액(9 소수 자릿수)
      lt_poitem-price_unit = 1.               "가격단위-default.
      IF ls_item-peinh IS NOT INITIAL.
        lt_poitem-price_unit = ls_item-peinh.   "가격단위
      ENDIF.
      lt_poitem-po_price = 1.                    "가격 채택: 1 = 총액, 2 = 단가
      lt_poitem-matl_group = ls_item-matkl.      "자재그룹
      lt_poitem-plant    = ls_item-werks.        "플랜트
      lt_poitem-stge_loc = ls_item-lgort.        "저장위치
*--2025.05.09"반품인 경우에만 srm의 배치를 넣는다
      IF ls_item-retpo IS NOT INITIAL.
        lt_poitem-batch = ls_item-charg.           "배치번호
      ENDIF.
      lt_poitem-preq_name = ls_item-afnam.       "요청자
*    lt_poitem-ret_item = space.               "반품품목-defalut.
      IF ls_item-retpo IS NOT INITIAL.
        lt_poitem-ret_item = ls_item-retpo.      "반품품목
        ls_retpo = gc_x.
      ENDIF.
      lt_poitem-preq_no = ls_item-banfn.         "구매요청
      lt_poitem-preq_no = |{ lt_poitem-preq_no ALPHA = IN }|.
      lt_poitem-preq_item = ls_item-bnfpo.       "구매요청 품목
      lt_poitem-preq_item = |{ lt_poitem-preq_item ALPHA = IN }|.
      lt_poitem-tax_code = ls_item-mwskz.        "부가세코드
      "**********************************************************
      APPEND lt_poitem.
      "**********************************************************

                                  'MATERIAL'

                                  'QUANTITY'

                                  'TAX_CODE'
                            CHANGING lt_poitemx
                                     lt_poitem
                              .
      lt_poitemx-po_itemx = abap_true.
      lt_poitemx-po_item  = ls_num.

      "**********************************************************
***<< POITEMX *************************************************

***>> POSCHEDULE **********************************************
      lt_posched-po_item = ls_num.        "품목번호
      lt_posched-sched_line  = gc_1.              "계정지정순번
      lt_posched-del_datcat_ext  = c_d.              "납품일 범주
      lt_posched-delivery_date  = ls_item-eeind.     "납품일
      lt_posched-quantity = ls_item-menge.           "예정수량
      "**********************************************************

                                      'DEL_DATCAT_EXT'
                                      'QUANTITY'
                               CHANGING lt_poschedx
                                        lt_posched
                                 .
      lt_poschedx-po_item = ls_num.        "품목번호
      lt_poschedx-sched_line  = gc_1.              "계정지정순번
      lt_poschedx-po_itemx = abap_true.
      lt_poschedx-sched_linex = abap_true.
      lt_poschedx-delivery_date  = ls_item-eeind.     "납품일

***>> Response ************************************************
      CLEAR: ls_response.
      ls_response-srmpo = ls_item-srmpo.
      ls_response-srmpo_item = ls_item-srmpo_item.
      ls_response-ebelp = lt_poitem-po_item.            "순차적 생성
      IF ls_item-menge > 0.
      ELSE.
        ls_response-type = gc_e.
        ls_response-errcode = '001'.
        ls_response-message = TEXT-e57.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_emessage IS NOT INITIAL OR ls_response-message IS NOT INITIAL.
        CONCATENATE ls_emessage ls_response-message INTO ls_response-message SEPARATED BY '&'.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_emessage IS NOT INITIAL.
        ls_response-type = c_e.
      ENDIF.

    ENDLOOP.
***<< 구매오더 생성 ****************************************************************************
***>> BAPI_PO_CREATE1 ******************************************
    IF ls_emessage IS INITIAL.
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_PO_CREATE1'
        EXPORTING
          poheader         = ls_pohead
          poheaderx        = ls_poheadx
          testrun          = ' '
        IMPORTING
          exppurchaseorder = ls_po_number
*         expheader        = ls_head
        TABLES
          return           = lt_return
          poitem           = lt_poitem       "구매오더 품목별 정보
          poitemx          = lt_poitemx
          poschedule       = lt_posched       "구매오더 납품일정라인 정보
          poschedulex      = lt_poschedx.

      IF ls_po_number IS NOT INITIAL.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
          EXPORTING
            wait = c_x.

        CLEAR ls_response.

        READ TABLE lt_return INTO ls_return WITH KEY type = c_s.

        SELECT SINGLE zztrns
          FROM eban
          WHERE ebeln = @ls_po_number
          INTO @DATA(lv_zztrns).

        "2024.04.03 관계사 구매오더 생성 시 구매요청 누락으로 인한 로직 보완
        SELECT a~ebeln, a~ebelp, a~banfn, a~bnfpo
          FROM ekpo  AS a
          WHERE a~ebeln EQ @ls_po_number
           ORDER BY ebeln, ebelp
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_banfn).

        LOOP AT lt_response INTO ls_response.
          ls_response-ebeln = ls_po_number.
          ls_response-type = ls_return-type.

          MODIFY lt_response FROM ls_response INDEX sy-tabix TRANSPORTING ebeln type.



          MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_response TO lt_send.    "ebeln, ebelp
          ""2024.04.03 PR 누락 보완
          READ TABLE lt_banfn INTO DATA(ls_banfn) WITH KEY ebeln = ls_response-ebeln
                                                                                                         ebelp = ls_response-ebelp
                                                                                                         BINARY SEARCH.
          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
            lt_send-banfn = ls_banfn-banfn.
            lt_send-bnfpo = ls_banfn-bnfpo.
          ENDIF.


          APPEND lt_send.
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_response TO lt_send0170.    "ebeln, ebelp

          lt_send0170-zzgubun = lv_zztrns.

          "2025.04.24 배치 누락으로 인한 수정
          READ TABLE lt_item INTO DATA(ls_recv) WITH KEY srmpo = ls_response-srmpo
                                                                                             srmpo_item = ls_response-srmpo_item.

          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
            lt_send0170-charg = ls_recv-charg.
          ENDIF.


          DATA(lv_cnt) = lines( lt_eban[] ).
          IF lv_cnt IS NOT INITIAL.
            "HTTP 변환된 주소...
            SELECT SINGLE a~zzgwlink
             FROM @lt_eban AS a
             INTO @DATA(lv_zzgwlink).
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              lt_send0170-zgw_doc_addr = lv_zzgwlink.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND lt_send0170.

        ENDLOOP.
      ELSE.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.

        "ERROR 처리방안
        LOOP AT lt_response INTO ls_response.
          ls_i = sy-tabix.
          LOOP AT lt_return INTO ls_return WHERE type EQ c_e AND row EQ ls_i.
            IF ls_response-errcode IS INITIAL.
              ls_response-type = ls_return-type.
              ls_string3 = ls_return-number.
              ls_response-errcode = ls_string3.
              CONCATENATE ls_return-parameter ls_return-message INTO ls_response-message SEPARATED BY space.
            ELSE.
              TRY.
                  CONCATENATE ls_response-message '&' ls_return-parameter ls_return-message INTO ls_response-message SEPARATED BY space.
                CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
              ENDTRY.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          MODIFY lt_response FROM ls_response INDEX sy-tabix TRANSPORTING type errcode message.
*           lt_ca2000-rtmsg =  ls_response-message.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ELSEIF ls_header-change_ind EQ c_d.

    IF ls_header-bsart NE gc_zic.
      CONCATENATE ls_emessage TEXT-e03 INTO ls_emessage SEPARATED BY space.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_item INTO ls_item.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_item TO lt_send.
      APPEND lt_send.

      ls_item-ebeln = |{ ls_item-ebeln ALPHA = IN }|.

***>> PURCHASEORDER **********************************************
      ls_purchaseorder = ls_item-ebeln.       "구매오더번호
***<< PURCHASEORDER **********************************************
***>> POHEAD  **********************************************
      ls_pohead-po_number  = ls_item-ebeln.   "구매오더번호
*      ls_pohead-delete_ind = c_x.             "삭제 지시자
      "**********************************************************
      APPEND ls_pohead.
      "**********************************************************
***>> POITEMX **********************************************
      ls_poheadx-po_number = ls_item-ebeln.     "구매오더번호
      "**********************************************************
      APPEND ls_poheadx.
      "**********************************************************
      PERFORM datax_pohead USING 'DELETE_IND'
                            CHANGING ls_poheadx
                                     ls_pohead
                              .
***<< POITEMX *********************************************
***>> POITEM  **********************************************
      lt_poitem-po_item  = ls_item-ebelp.     "구매오더품목번호
      lt_poitem-delete_ind = c_x.             "삭제 지시자
      "**********************************************************
      APPEND lt_poitem.
      "**********************************************************
***<< POITEM  **********************************************
***>> POITEMX **********************************************
      lt_poitemx-po_item  = ls_item-ebelp.     "구매오더품목번호
      "**********************************************************
      APPEND lt_poitemx.
      "**********************************************************
      PERFORM datax_poitemd USING 'DELETE_IND'
                            CHANGING lt_poitemx
                                     lt_poitem
                              .
***>> Response ************************************************
      CLEAR: ls_response.
      ls_response-srmpo = ls_item-srmpo.
      ls_response-srmpo_item = ls_item-srmpo_item.
      ls_response-ebeln = ls_item-ebeln.            "구매오더
      ls_response-ebelp = ls_item-ebelp.            "구매오더 품목번호
      ls_response-message = ls_emessage.
      IF ls_emessage IS NOT INITIAL.
        ls_response-type = c_e.
      ENDIF.
***<< Response ************************************************
      "**********************************************************
      APPEND ls_response TO lt_response.
      "**********************************************************


****<< POACCOUNTX **********************************************
      IF ls_emessage IS INITIAL.
        CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_PO_CHANGE'
          EXPORTING
            purchaseorder = ls_purchaseorder
            poheader      = ls_pohead
            poheaderx     = ls_poheadx
          TABLES
            return        = lt_return
            poitem        = lt_poitem
            poitemx       = lt_poitemx
*           poschedule    = lt_posched       "구매오더 납품일정라인 정보
*           poschedulex   = lt_poschedx
          .

        READ TABLE lt_return INTO ls_return WITH KEY type = c_s.

        IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND
          ( ls_return-number EQ '022' OR ls_return-number EQ '023' ).

          CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
            EXPORTING
              wait = c_x.

*        ls_response-type = ls_return-type.    " 'S'.
          CLEAR ls_response.
          LOOP AT lt_response INTO ls_response.
            ls_response-type = ls_return-type.
            MODIFY lt_response FROM ls_response INDEX sy-tabix TRANSPORTING type.

            MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_response TO lt_send.
            APPEND lt_send.
            MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_response TO lt_send0170.
            APPEND lt_send0170.
          ENDLOOP.

        ELSE.
          CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.

          "ERROR 처리방안
          LOOP AT lt_response INTO ls_response.
            ls_i = sy-tabix.
            LOOP AT lt_return INTO ls_return WHERE type EQ 'E' AND row EQ ls_i.
              IF ls_response-errcode IS INITIAL.
                ls_response-type = ls_return-type.
                ls_string3 = ls_return-number.
                ls_response-errcode = ls_string3.
                CONCATENATE ls_return-parameter ls_return-message INTO ls_response-message SEPARATED BY space.
              ELSE.
                TRY.
                    CONCATENATE ls_response-message '&' ls_return-parameter ls_return-message INTO ls_response-message SEPARATED BY space.
                  CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
                ENDTRY.
              ENDIF.
            ENDLOOP.

            MODIFY lt_response FROM ls_response INDEX sy-tabix TRANSPORTING type errcode message.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
***<< 구매오더 취소 ****************************************************************************
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.

    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_0070_old).

    READ TABLE lt_0070_old INTO DATA(ls_0070_old) WITH KEY ebeln = ls_send-ebeln
                                                           ebelp = ls_send-ebelp BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_0070_old TO ls_0070.
      ls_0070-aedat = sy-datum.

      IF ls_header-change_ind EQ c_u.
        ls_0070-status = c_u.
      ELSEIF ls_header-change_ind EQ c_d.
        ls_0070-status = c_d.

    ELSE.  "신규 전송.

        ls_0070-banfn = |{ ls_send-banfn ALPHA = IN }|.
        ls_0070-bnfpo = |{ ls_send-bnfpo ALPHA = IN }|.
        ls_0070-bsart = 'ZIC'.
      ENDIF.
      ls_0070-status = gc_i.
      ls_0070-erdat = sy-datum.
      ls_0070-ernam = sy-uname.
      ls_0070-erzet = sy-timlo.
      ls_0070-bukrs = lv_bukrs.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND ls_0070 TO lt_0070.
  ENDLOOP.

  TRY.

    CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lv_oref).

    DATA: lt_save_330 TYPE TABLE OF zmmt0330.
    DATA: lt_save_350 TYPE TABLE OF zmmt0350.

    SELECT a~*,

                         INNER JOIN zmmt0070 AS d
                                 ON d~ebeln = @ls_po_number
                                AND d~banfn = lpad( b~banfn, 10, '0' )
                                AND d~bnfpo = lpad( b~bnfpo, 10, '0' )
     WHERE a~ebeln IS INITIAL
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_save_330.

    IF lt_save_330 IS NOT INITIAL.
      MODIFY zmmt0330 FROM TABLE lt_save_330.
      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT a~*,

     WHERE a~ebeln IS INITIAL

  ENDIF.

  pv_result[] = CORRESPONDING #( lt_response[] ).

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form invoice_bapi_mm0100_IM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PT_DT
*&      --> PT_OUT
*&      --> PS_HEAD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM invoice_bapi_mm0100_reduce TABLES pt_dt STRUCTURE zmmt0105
                                                  pt_out STRUCTURE zmms_iv_create_out
                                                   USING  ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0100.

  " BAPI 변수
  DATA v_doc_item TYPE rblgp.
  DATA: ls_header TYPE zmms0030.
  DATA: lt_item   TYPE TABLE OF zmms0035.
  DATA: ls_item   TYPE zmms0035.
  DATA: lv_menge TYPE ekbe-menge.
  DATA: lv_wrbtr TYPE ekbe-wrbtr. "마감금액
  DATA: lv_wmwst TYPE bseg-wmwst. "세액
  DATA: lv_wrbtr_b TYPE ekbe-wrbtr. "잔액
  DATA: lv_wmwst_b TYPE bseg-wmwst. "잔액세액
  DATA: lv_lifnr TYPE ekko-lifnr.
  DATA: lv_last_group TYPE i.

  "bapi 리턴
  DATA: lv_status  TYPE bapi_mtype.
  DATA: lv_message TYPE bapi_msg.
  DATA: lv_belnr_iv LIKE rseg-belnr.
  DATA: lv_gjahr_iv LIKE rseg-gjahr.
  DATA : lv_bapi_fail TYPE bapibp_xfeld. "- 분할해서 인보이스를 전기할 때 하나라도 실패하면 'X'를 할당해서 전체를 롤백.
  DATA : lv_check TYPE c.

  " 송장 생성 이후 추적용

  DATA: BEGIN OF lt_update OCCURS 0, " 자재문서 생성 이후 품목 추적용
          if_srm_key TYPE zmmt0105-if_srm_key,
          group      TYPE zmmt0105-zgroup,
          belnr_fi   LIKE rseg-belnr,
          belnr_iv   LIKE rseg-belnr,
          buzei      LIKE bseg-buzei,
          Gjahr      LIKE rseg-gjahr,
        END OF lt_update.

  CLEAR : lv_wmwst_b.

  DATA(lt_dt) = pt_dt[]. " 처리 데이터 이전 처리 후 업데이트 예정.

  DATA : lt_reduce TYPE TABLE OF zmmt0105.
  lt_reduce = CORRESPONDING #( pt_dt[] ). " 축약용 원본데이터 복사.
  SORT lt_reduce BY ebeln ebeln.
  SORT lt_dt BY ebeln ebeln.

  TYPES l_ts_zmmt0105 TYPE zmmt0105.

  DELETE  ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_dt COMPARING ebeln ebelp.


  "'구매오더 중복 제거 후 진행
  PERFORM set_iv_group TABLES lt_dt
                                  CHANGING lv_last_group.

  SORT lt_dt BY if_srm_item ebeln ebelp zgroup.

*-- 수신받은 총 세액  잔액  계산용
  lv_wmwst_b = ps_head-wmwst. "헤더 세액
  lv_wrbtr_b = ps_head-wrbtr1. "헤더 공급가액


  "차후 차대변 확인 아이템에 지시자가 찍힌 걸로 구분
  "송장 처리 시 아이템 인디케이터는 NULL
  " 차후차/대변은 체크

  READ TABLE lt_dt TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY de_cre_ind = 'X'.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

    DATA(lv_cha) = 'X'.

  ENDIF.


  LOOP AT lt_dt INTO DATA(ls_dt)
                   WHERE if_srm_key = ps_head-if_srm_key
                  GROUP BY ls_dt-zgroup
                  INTO DATA(ls_key).

    CLEAR : v_doc_item.

    LOOP AT GROUP ls_key INTO DATA(ls_loop).

      v_doc_item += 10.

      " 외자인 경우 GR/IV 기준 송장을 하지 않음 . GR/IV 체크 시 입고 문서가 여러 개인 경우 동일한 구매오더 품목에 대해서
      " 송장 처리가 가능하지만 GR/IV 미체크 송장은 IV 처리 시 구매오더,품목은 단일 값으로 입력해야함
      " 위 이유로 외자 송장 처리 시 구매오더품목 축약하여 하나의 송장 품목으로 처리한다.

      "--* 축약 *---------------------------------------------------------

      DATA(ls_reduce) = REDUCE l_ts_zmmt0105( INIT hs_dt_reduce TYPE l_ts_zmmt0105 "- 수량(KMENGE), 전표통화(KWERT) 압축해야 함.
                                                FOR <hs_dt_reduce> IN lt_reduce WHERE (     ebeln = ls_loop-ebeln
                                                                                           AND ebelp = ls_loop-ebelp )
                                                NEXT hs_dt_reduce-kwert += <hs_dt_reduce>-kwert
                                                     hs_dt_reduce-kmenge += <hs_dt_reduce>-kmenge ).


      "--* 축약 *---------------------------------------------------------
      "중복 제거된 구매오더에 축약된 수량, 금액을 넣어준다.
      ls_loop-kwert = ls_reduce-kwert.

      IF LV_cHA IS INITIAL. "차후 차대변 처리 시 합산 수량말고 기존 수량을 넣어준다.
        ls_loop-kmenge = ls_reduce-kmenge.
      ENDIF.


      lv_wrbtr = lv_wrbtr + ls_loop-kwert.  "품목별 공급가액

* Item
      PERFORM iv_item TABLES  lt_item
                                USING ps_head
                                           ls_loop
                                           v_doc_item.



    ENDLOOP.
*-- 그룹별 송장 처리 start
    "세액 계산

    PERFORM calculate_tax_from_net_amount USING ps_head-bukrs
                                                ps_head-mwskz
                                                ps_head-waers
                                                lv_wrbtr
                                       CHANGING lV_WMWST.  "세액

    IF lv_last_group > 1 AND ls_loop-zgroup EQ lv_last_group.
      "300건 초과로  송장 분할 처리 시
      "마지막 송장 처리에 계산 세액 말고 수신받은 세액 잔액으로 변환
      lv_wmwst = lv_wmwst_b.
      lv_wrbtr = lv_wrbtr_b.
    ENDIF.

    " 위 계산 로직에의 해 한 번 처리되는 송장의 경우 세액이 계산되는 경우가 있었음
    " if 금액과 일치시키기 위함
    IF lv_last_group = 1.

      lv_wmwst = ps_head-wmwst.

    ENDIF.

** Header
    PERFORM iv_header  USING ps_head
                                        lv_wrbtr
                                        lv_wmwst
                          CHANGING   ls_header.


* 송장문서 생성 BAPI
    CLEAR: lv_status, lv_message.
    call function 'ZMM_IV_CREATE'
      EXPORTING
        is_header    = ls_header
        iv_cmt_in_fm = abap_false " 전체 건 성공 시 커밋
        iv_text      = ps_head-sgtxt
      IMPORTING
        ev_belnr     = lv_belnr_iv
        ev_gjahr     = lv_gjahr_iv
        ev_status    = lv_status
        ev_message   = lv_message
      TABLES
        it_item      = lt_item.


    IF lv_status = 'S'. "- 성공일 땐 결과를 축적.

* 자재문서 생성 이후 품목 번호 추적 매핑
      lt_update-if_srm_key  = ls_loop-if_srm_key.
      lt_update-group = ls_loop-zgroup.
      lt_update-belnr_iv   = lv_belnr_iv.
      lt_update-gjahr   = lv_gjahr_iv.

      APPEND lt_update.

    ELSE. "- 실패하면 롤백할 것이므로 축적된 결과를 다 지우고 에러 메시지만 입력.

      lv_check = 'X'.
      lv_bapi_fail     = abap_true.
      EXIT. "- LOOP EXIT.
    ENDIF.

    lV_WRBTR_B = lV_WRBTR_B - lV_WRBTR.
    lV_WMWST_B = lV_WMWST_B - lV_WMWST.

    CLEAR: ls_header, lt_item[].
    CLEAR: lv_wrbtr, lv_wmwst.
  ENDLOOP  .



  IF lV_BAPI_FAIL = abap_true.


    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.

    PERFORM error USING  ps_head
                         'E'
                         lv_message.

  ELSE.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
      EXPORTING
        wait = abap_true.

    PERFORM error USING  ps_head
                     'S'
                     TEXT-m57.  "'Success'.

    ""fi문서 get
    SORT lt_update BY group.
    SORT pt_dt BY if_srm_key if_srm_item zgroup.

    LOOP AT lt_update.
      ""fi 문서 get
      PERFORM get_fi_doc USING lt_update-belnr_iv lt_update-gjahr
                      CHANGING lt_update-belnr_fi.

      IF lt_update-belnr_fi IS NOT INITIAL.

        PERFORM get_fi_doc_item USING lt_update-belnr_FI lt_update-gjahr
                        CHANGING lt_update-buzei.

      ENDIF.

      MODIFY lt_update TRANSPORTING belnr_fi buzei.

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDIF.

  "PO 축약해서 처리한 내역 추출 - > 추출 후 그룹핑 내역
  SORT lt_dt BY if_srm_key ebeln ebelp zgroup.

  LOOP AT pt_dt ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).

    <fs_item>-if_type     = ps_head-if_type.
    <fs_item>-if_msg      = ps_head-if_msg.

*-라인에 정렬 후 po 기준으로 축약해서 처리한 그룹번호 매핑 후 송장 처리 내역 매핑
    READ TABLE lt_dt INTO DATA(ls_dt_done) WITH KEY if_srm_key = <fs_item>-if_srm_key
                                                                                                    ebeln = <fs_item>-ebeln
                                                                                                   ebelp = <fs_item>-ebelp
                                                                                                  BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      <fs_item>-zgroup = ls_dt_done-zgroup.
    ENDIF.


    IF lv_bapi_fail IS INITIAL.

      READ TABLE lt_update INTO DATA(ls_update) WITH KEY group = <fs_item>-zgroup.

      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

        <fs_item>-belnr     = ls_update-belnr_iv.
        <fs_item>-belnr_fi     = ls_update-belnr_fi.
        <fs_item>-gjahr     = ls_update-gjahr.
        <fs_item>-buzei     = ls_update-buzei.
      ENDIF.

    ELSE.
      "실패된 데이터

*-- 송장 처리에 성공했지만 동일 KEY 데이터가 실패한 경우 생성되었지만 롤백된 송장번호 삭제
      IF <fs_item>-belnr IS NOT INITIAL.


        CLEAR : <fs_item>-belnr, <fs_item>-gjahr, <fs_item>-buzei, <fs_item>-belnr_fi.
        <fs_item>-gjahr     = abap_false.        <fs_item>-if_msg     = TEXT-m63. " 다른 항목의 에러로 실패.


      ENDIF.



    ENDIF.

    MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type     = ps_head-if_type
                                message  = ps_head-iF_MSG
                                belnr_iv = ls_update-belnr_iv
                                belnr_fi = ls_update-belnr_fi
                                gjahr    = ls_update-gjahr )                                                                                  " 성공 업데이트
                                            TRANSPORTING type message belnr_iv belnr_fi gjahr
                                                    WHERE if_srm_key EQ <fs_item>-if_srm_key
                                                          AND if_srm_item EQ <fs_item>-if_srm_item.

  ENDLOOP.

  ""위 로직까지는 내자와 동일.
  "아래 로직부터 축약으로 생략된 수신 내용에 대한 로직 처리.

*  UNASSIGN <fs_item>.
*  CLEAR : ls_dt, ls_update.

*  " 축약된 데이터의 경우 송장 그루핍대상에서 제외되었음, 제외된 데이터에 대한 로직 처리.
*  LOOP AT pt_dt ASSIGNING <fs_item> WHERE zgroup IS INITIAL.
*
*    <fs_item>-if_type     = ps_head-if_type.
*    <fs_item>-if_msg      = ps_head-if_msg.
*
*
*
*    IF lv_bapi_fail IS INITIAL.
*      "송장 처리된 경우 같은 구매오더의 이력으로 처리 이력 남김
*      "송장이 실패된 경우는 실패 시에는 전체 이력을 업데이트하기 떄문에 성공한 경우에만 축약 데이터 업데이트
*
*      "축약 구매오더의 같은 구매오더번호로 송장 처리된 이력 확인.
*      ls_dt = VALUE #( lt_dt[ ebeln = <fs_item>-ebeln
*                              ebelp = <fs_item>-ebelp ] OPTIONAL ).
*
*      IF ls_dt IS NOT INITIAL.
*        ls_update = VALUE #( lt_update[ group = ls_dt-zgroup ] OPTIONAL ).
*
*        IF ls_update IS NOT INITIAL.
*          <fs_item>-belnr     = ls_update-belnr_iv.
*          <fs_item>-belnr_fi     = ls_update-belnr_fi.
*          <fs_item>-gjahr     = ls_update-gjahr.
*          <fs_item>-buzei     = ls_update-buzei.
*        ELSE.
*          CONTINUE.
*        ENDIF.
*      ELSE.
*        CONTINUE.
*      ENDIF.
*
*      MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type     = ps_head-if_type
*                                  message  = ps_head-iF_MSG
*                                  belnr_iv = ls_update-belnr_iv
*                                  belnr_fi = ls_update-belnr_fi
*                                  gjahr    = ls_update-gjahr
*                                  buzei    = ls_update-buzei )                                                                            " 성공 업데이트
*                                             TRANSPORTING type message belnr_iv belnr_fi gjahr buzei
*                                                     WHERE if_srm_key EQ <fs_item>-if_srm_key
*                                                           AND if_srm_item EQ <fs_item>-if_srm_item.
*    ENDIF.
*
*  ENDLOOP.




ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM invalid_check USING ps_data STRUCTURE zmms_po_gr_zic_canc_receive.

FORM obligatroy_CHECK USING ps_list STRUCTURE zmms_po_gr_zic_canc_header.


*  IF ps_list-mblnr IS INITIAL OR ps_list-mjahr IS INITIAL OR ps_list-zeile IS INITIAL.
*
*    PERFORM error_out USING ps_list
*                                       'E'
*                                       TEXT-e11. "취소 시 자재문서(항목, 문서번호, 연도)는 필수입니다!
*
*  ENDIF.
*
*
*  IF ps_list-ebeln IS INITIAL OR ps_list-ebelp IS INITIAL.

*                                       'E'
