*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form GOODS_CANCEL
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_LIST
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM goods_cancel USING ps_list STRUCTURE zmms_po_gr_zic_canc_header
                                     PS_out STRUCTURE zmms_po_gr_zic_canc_return.


  DATA: ls_head   TYPE bapi2017_gm_head_02,
        lt_item   TYPE TABLE OF bapi2017_gm_item_04 WITH HEADER LINE,
        ls_cancel TYPE bapi2017_gm_head_ret,  " 취소문서
        lv_mjahr  TYPE bapi2017_gm_head_02-doc_year,
        lt_return TYPE TABLE OF bapiret2 WITH HEADER LINE.
*
*  DATA : lv_msg TYPE bapi_msg.
*
  DATA(ls_list) = ps_list.
*
*  READ TABLE lt_list INTO DATA(ls_list) INDEX 1.
*
  ls_head-mat_doc  = ls_list-mblnr.
  ls_head-doc_date = ls_list-budat.
  ls_head-doc_year = ls_list-mjahr.
*
  CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_GOODSMVT_CANCEL'
    EXPORTING
      materialdocument    = ls_head-mat_doc
      matdocumentyear     = ls_head-doc_year
      goodsmvt_pstng_date = ls_head-doc_date
    IMPORTING
      goodsmvt_headret    = ls_cancel
    TABLES
      return              = lt_return.
*
  READ TABLE lt_return WITH KEY type = 'E'.
*
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
*
    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.

    ps_out-type = gc_e.
    ps_out-errcode = 'E19'.
    ps_out-message   =  lt_return-message.

  ELSE.
*
*
    UPDATE zmmt0180 SET smbln = @ls_cancel-mat_doc,
                                 sjahr = @ls_cancel-doc_year,
                                 db_type = @gc_x
                                WHERE mblnr EQ @ls_list-mblnr
                                AND mjahr EQ @ls_list-mjahr.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
        EXPORTING
          wait = 'X'.

      "결과 리턴
      ps_out-smbln = ls_cancel-mat_doc.
      ps_out-sjahr = ls_cancel-doc_year.
      ps_out-type = gc_s.
      MESSAGE s050 WITH ls_list-mblnr ls_cancel-mat_doc  INTO ps_out-message.

* "PO/SO 매핑 확인 -> 매핑 확인 시 MM/SD 350 DB UPDATE 및 SD 가용성점검 실행.
*          CALL FUNCTION 'ZMM_SD_MM_0350_DB'
*            EXPORTING
*              iv_mblnr       = ls_cancel-mat_doc
*              iv_mjahr       = ls_cancel-doc_year.

    ELSE.
*
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.
      ps_out-type = gc_e.
      ps_out-errcode = 'E19'.
      ps_out-message   = TEXT-e19.

    ENDIF.
*
  ENDIF.

*  LOOP AT pt_list INTO ls_list.
*
*    IF lt_return-type NE 'E'.
*
*      SELECT SINGLE  mjahr, mblnr, zeile
*        FROM matdoc
*        WHERE smbln EQ @ls_list-mblnr
*          AND smblp EQ @ls_list-zeile
*          AND sjahr EQ @ls_list-mjahr
*          AND xauto EQ @space
*        INTO (@ls_list-sjahr, @ls_list-smbln, @ls_list-smblp).
*
*      ls_list-message = TEXT-m61.
*      ls_list-type = 'S'.
*
*    ELSE.
*
*      ls_list-message = lv_message.
*      ls_list-type = 'E'.
*
*    ENDIF.
*    MODIFY pt_list FROM ls_list TRANSPORTING type message smbln smblp sjahr.
*  ENDLOOP.

*  IF ls_cancel IS NOT INITIAL.
*
*    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
*
*    UPDATE zmmt0180 SET smbln = ls_cancel-mat_doc
*                                     sjahr = ls_cancel-doc_year
*                                     db_type = @gc_x
*                                    WHERE mblnr EQ ls_list-mblnr
*                                    AND mjahr EQ ls_list-mjahr.

*    "bapi 성공 후 db update
*    SELECT * FROM
*      zmmt0180
*      WHERE mblnr EQ @ls_head-mat_doc
*            AND mjahr EQ @ls_head-doc_year
*      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_0180_old).
*
*    IF lt_0180_old[] IS NOT INITIAL.
*
*      LOOP AT lt_0180_old INTO DATA(ls_0180_old).
*
*        READ TABLE pt_list INTO ls_list WITH KEY mblnr = ls_0180_old-mblnr
*                                                          mjahr = ls_0180_old-mjahr
*                                                          zeile = ls_0180_old-zeile.
*
*        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
*          ls_0180_old-smbln = ls_list-smbln.
*          ls_0180_old-sjahr = ls_list-sjahr.
*          ls_0180_old-smblp = ls_list-smblp.
*          ls_0180_old-db_type = gc_x.
*          MODIFY lt_0180_old FROM ls_0180_old TRANSPORTING smbln sjahr smblp db_type.
*        ENDIF.
*
*      ENDLOOP.
*
*      TRY .
*          MODIFY zmmt0180 FROM TABLE lt_0180_old.
*        CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db.
*          lv_msg = TEXT-e19.
*          "취소 문서 생성 이후 DB 저장 중 에러가 발생했습니다.
*      ENDTRY.
*
*      ""아웃풋데이터
*      pt_out[] = CORRESPONDING #( pt_list[] ).
*
*
*      "바피 처리 후 db 업데이트 내용 확인.
*      IF lv_msg IS INITIAL.
*        MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type = 'S'
*                                                       errcode = '000'
*                                                        message = TEXT-m61 ) TRANSPORTING type errcode message WHERE type IS INITIAL.
*
*      ELSE.
*        MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type = 'E'
*                                                       errcode = '000' " db 저장 실패 에러
*                                                        message = TEXT-e19 ) TRANSPORTING type errcode message WHERE type IS INITIAL.
*
*      ENDIF.
*
*    ENDIF.
*
*  ELSE. "바피 실패 시
*
*    pt_out[] = CORRESPONDING #( pt_list[] ).
*    MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type = 'E'
*                                               errcode = '000'
*                                                message = lv_message ) TRANSPORTING type errcode message WHERE type IS INITIAL.
*  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form invoice_bapi_mm0200
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_DT
*&      --> LT_OUT
*&      --> <FS_HEAD>
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM invoice_bapi_mm0200 TABLES pt_dt STRUCTURE zmmt0205
                                                  pt_out STRUCTURE zmms_iv_create_out
                                                   USING  ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0200.



  " BAPI 변수
  DATA v_doc_item TYPE rblgp.
  DATA: ls_header TYPE zmms0030.
  DATA: lt_item   TYPE TABLE OF zmms0035.
  DATA: ls_item   TYPE zmms0035.
  DATA: lv_menge TYPE ekbe-menge.
  DATA: lv_wrbtr TYPE ekbe-wrbtr. "마감금액
  DATA: lv_wmwst TYPE bseg-wmwst. "세액
  DATA: lv_wrbtr_b TYPE ekbe-wrbtr. "잔액
  DATA: lv_wmwst_b TYPE bseg-wmwst. "잔액세액
  DATA: lv_lifnr TYPE ekko-lifnr.
  DATA: lv_last_group TYPE i.

  "bapi 리턴
  DATA: lv_status  TYPE bapi_mtype.
  DATA: lv_message TYPE bapi_msg.
  DATA: lv_belnr_iv LIKE rseg-belnr.
  DATA: lv_gjahr_iv LIKE rseg-gjahr.
  DATA : lv_bapi_fail TYPE bapibp_xfeld. "- 분할해서 인보이스를 전기할 때 하나라도 실패하면 'X'를 할당해서 전체를 롤백.
  DATA : lv_check TYPE c.
  DATA : lt_reduce TYPE TABLE OF zmmt0205.
  TYPES l_ts_zmmt0205 TYPE zmmt0205.
  " 송장 생성 이후 추적용

  DATA: BEGIN OF lt_update OCCURS 0, " 자재문서 생성 이후 품목 추적용
          if_srm_key TYPE zmmt0105-if_srm_key,
          group      TYPE zmmt0105-zgroup,
          belnr_fi   LIKE rseg-belnr,
          belnr_iv   LIKE rseg-belnr,
          buzei      LIKE bseg-buzei,
          Gjahr      LIKE rseg-gjahr,
        END OF lt_update.

  CLEAR : lv_wmwst_b.

  DATA(lt_dt) = pt_dt[].

  SORT lt_dt BY if_srm_key if_srm_item ebeln ebelp.

*-- 수신받은 총 세액  잔액  계산용
  lv_wmwst_b = ps_head-wmwst. "헤더 세액
  lv_wrbtr_b = ps_head-wrbtr1. "헤더 공급가액

  "차후 차대변 확인 아이템에 지시자가 찍힌 걸로 구분

  READ TABLE lt_dt TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY de_cre_ind = 'X'.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

    DATA(lv_cha) = 'X'.

  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT lt_dt INTO DATA(ls_data) GROUP BY ls_data-if_srm_key.
    CLEAR : v_doc_item.

    LOOP AT GROUP ls_data INTO DATA(ls_loop).

      v_doc_item += 10.

      " 외자인 경우 GR/IV 기준 송장을 하지 않음 . GR/IV 체크 시 입고 문서가 여러 개인 경우 동일한 구매오더 품목에 대해서
      " 송장 처리가 가능하지만 GR/IV 미체크 송장은 IV 처리 시 구매오더,품목은 단일 값으로 입력해야함
      " 위 이유로 외자 송장 처리 시 구매오더품목 축약하여 하나의 송장 품목으로 처리한다.

      "--* 축약 *---------------------------------------------------------

      DATA(ls_reduce) = REDUCE l_ts_zmmt0205( INIT hs_dt_reduce TYPE l_ts_zmmt0205 "- 수량(KMENGE), 전표통화(KWERT) 압축해야 함.
                                                FOR <hs_dt_reduce> IN lt_reduce WHERE (     ebeln = ls_loop-ebeln
                                                                                           AND ebelp = ls_loop-ebelp )
                                                NEXT hs_dt_reduce-kwert += <hs_dt_reduce>-kwert
                                                     hs_dt_reduce-kmenge += <hs_dt_reduce>-kmenge ).


      "--* 축약 *---------------------------------------------------------
      "중복 제거된 구매오더에 축약된 수량, 금액을 넣어준다.
      ls_loop-kwert = ls_reduce-kwert.

      IF LV_cHA IS INITIAL. "차후 차대변 처리 시 합산 수량말고 기존 수량을 넣어준다.
        ls_loop-kmenge = ls_reduce-kmenge.
      ENDIF.


* Item
      PERFORM iv_item_0200 TABLES  lt_item
                                USING ps_head
                                           ls_loop
                                           v_doc_item.



    ENDLOOP.


    PERFORM calculate_tax_from_net_amount USING ps_head-bukrs
                                                  ps_head-mwskz
                                                  ps_head-waers
                                                  lv_wrbtr
                                         CHANGING lV_WMWST.  "세액



  ENDLOOP.





ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form if_header_data_validition_0200
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> <FS_HEAD>
*&      <-- LS_OUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM if_header_data_validition_0200 USING ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0200
                                     CHANGING ps_out STRUCTURE zmms_iv_create_out.

  CONSTANTS lc_1000(4) TYPE c VALUE '1000'.
  CONSTANTS lc_1001(4) TYPE c VALUE '1001'.
  CONSTANTS lc_1010(4) TYPE c VALUE '1010'.
  CONSTANTS lc_1101(4) TYPE c VALUE '1101'.
  CONSTANTS lc_1102(4) TYPE c VALUE '1102'.

  SELECT SINGLE *
    FROM zmmt0200
    WHERE if_srm_key EQ @ps_head-if_srm_key
        AND if_gubun EQ 'C'
        INTO @DATA(ls_0100).
  IF ps_head-IF_gubun = 'D'. " 인터페이스 취소인 경우.
*--수신 이력 확인
    " 처리 중지로 인해 'D' 삭세 수신 시 정상 처리 이력인 경우 예외 처리.

*-- 정상적으로 수신되어 송장 생성된 이력에 대해 취소 불가
    IF ls_0100 IS INITIAL.

      PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                         'E'
                                         TEXT-m59.
    ELSE.
      IF ls_0100-if_TYPE NE 'E'.

        PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                           'E'
                                           TEXT-m45.

      ENDIF.

      EXIT. " D 취소인 경우 이후 벨리데이션은 체크하지 않음.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE. "일반 처리

    IF ls_0100-if_type EQ 'S'.

      PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                     'E'
                                     TEXT-m06. "이미 전송 성공한 데이터입니다.


    ENDIF.


  ENDIF.

  "전기일 필수
  IF ps_head-budat IS INITIAL.


    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-m66..
  ENDIF.

  "회사코드 필수
  IF ps_head-bukrs IS INITIAL.


    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-m70.

  ENDIF.

  "금액 필수
  IF ps_head-rmwwr IS INITIAL OR ps_head-wrbtr1 IS INITIAL.


    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-m69.
  ENDIF.

  "영세율을 제외한 세금 필수(V0, VZ, V7 )
  IF ps_head-wmwst IS INITIAL.
    IF ps_head-mwskz EQ 'V0' OR  ps_head-mwskz EQ 'V7'
      OR ps_head-mwskz EQ 'VZ'.
    ELSE.
      PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                         'E'
                                         TEXT-m96.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.



  "금액 필수

  IF ps_head-waers IS INITIAL.

    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-m68..
  ENDIF.




*-- 현재 가능한 Posting Period 인지 확인
  PERFORM budat_period_determine USING ps_head-bukrs
                                                      ps_head-budat
                                                      CHANGING  ps_out.


*-- 공급업체 확인
  SELECT SINGLE mandt INTO sy-mandt
    FROM lfa1
   WHERE lifnr = ps_head-lifnr.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.

    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                           'E'
                                           TEXT-m44.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

*--세금계산서 관련
  "PS_HEAD-MWSKZ " 세금계산서는 우선 재무팀에서 회계문서에 등록하는걸로 협의
  "추후 송장에 기입하는 방향으로 진행될 수 있음. 진행되면 체크 로직 추가 필요.

*--사업장 확인.
  IF ps_head-bupla IS INITIAL.


    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-m46.
  ELSE.

    "회사코드 사업장 체크.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM
      j_1bbranch
      WHERE bukrs = @ps_head-bukrs
          AND branch = @ps_head-BUpla
      INTO @DATA(ls_branch).

    IF sy-subrc NE 0.

      PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                             'E'
                                             TEXT-e35. "회사코드, 사업장이 유효하지 않습니다.
      EXIT.

    ENDIF.


  ENDIF.


  "총액  = 과표 + 세액. 다른 경우 에러
  IF ps_head-rmwwr NE ps_head-wrbtr1 + ps_head-wmwst.

    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-m97.


  ENDIF.


  " 수입부대비 처리 시 송장 유형 2' 만 처리 가능
  IF ps_head-gubun NE gc_2.
    "수입 관련 처리만 가능합니다.
    PERFORM error_out USING ps_out
                                       'E'
                                       TEXT-e18.
  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form iv_item_0200
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_ITEM
*&      --> PS_HEAD
*&      --> LS_LOOP
*&      --> V_DOC_ITEM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM iv_item_0200 TABLES pt_item STRUCTURE zmms0035
                    USING    ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0200
                              ps_loop STRUCTURE zmmt0205
                              pv_doc_item.

  DATA: lv_dmbtr TYPE dmbtr.
  DATA: ls_item TYPE zmms0035.

  CLEAR ls_item.
  ls_item-buzei = pv_doc_item.                  "송장 문서의 문서 항목
  ls_item-ebeln = ps_loop-ebeln.         "구매 오더 번호
  ls_item-ebelp = ps_loop-ebelp.         "구매 문서 품목 번호
  ls_item-menge = abs( ps_loop-kmenge ).  "수량
  ls_item-meins = ps_loop-meins.         "오더 단위
  ls_item-bprme = ps_loop-bprme.         "오더 단위
  ls_item-tbtkz = ps_loop-de_cre_ind.         "item indicator
  ls_item-kschl = ps_loop-kschl. "조건유형
  ls_item-mwskz = ps_loop-tax_code.
  IF ps_head-gubun = '1'. " 내자인 경우 자재문서 참조 처리.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      ls_item-lfbnr = ps_loop-ref_doc.   "참조 문서의 문서 번호
      ls_item-lfgja = ps_loop-ref_doc_year.      "현재 기간의 회계연도
      ls_item-lfpos = ps_loop-ref_doc_it.      "참조 전표 품목
    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

* 전표통화금액 = 마감금액
  CLEAR: lv_dmbtr.
  lv_dmbtr = ps_loop-kwert.

  PERFORM bapi_currency_conv_to_external USING ps_head-waers
                                               lv_dmbtr
                                      CHANGING ls_item-wrbtr.
  IF lv_dmbtr < 0.
    ls_item-wrbtr = abs( ls_item-wrbtr ).
  ENDIF.

  APPEND ls_item TO pt_item. CLEAR ls_item.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form if_item_check_iv_0200
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_DT
*&      --> LT_OUT
*&      --> <FS_HEAD>
*&      <-- LV_ERR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM if_item_check_iv_0200 TABLES pt_dt STRUCTURE zmmt0205
                                                   pt_out STRUCTURE zmms_iv_create_out
                                          USING  ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0200
                                          CHANGING pv_err.

  DATA:
        lv_kposn     TYPE kposn.


  SORT pt_dt BY if_srm_key if_srm_item.

  DATA(lt_data) = pt_dt[].
  DATA : lv_wrbtr TYPE wrbtr.

  ""구매오더 기준 송장 수량 체크
  DATA : BEGIN OF ls_ebeln,
*           kschl TYPE ekbz-kschl,
           zimbl TYPE zmmt0205-zimbl,
           ebeln TYPE ekpo-ebeln,
           ebelp TYPE ekpo-ebelp,
           menge TYPE ekpo-menge,
         END OF ls_ebeln.
  DATA : lt_ebeln LIKE TABLE OF ls_ebeln.

  " BL/PO 단위로 수량 검증
  SORT lt_data BY zimbl ebeln ebelp.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_data COMPARING zimbl ebeln ebelp.

  CLEAR : lt_ebeln.

  TYPES l_ts_dt TYPE zmmt0205.



*
  "b/l 중복제거 후 bl 단위로 차후차대변 수량합산
  LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
    CLEAR : ls_ebeln.

    ls_ebeln-ebeln = ls_data-ebeln.
    ls_ebeln-ebelp = ls_data-ebelp.
    ls_ebeln-menge = ls_data-kmenge.

    COLLECT ls_ebeln INTO lt_ebeln.

  ENDLOOP.


  SORT lt_data BY ebeln ebelp.

  ""키중복 체크
  DATA(lt_DUPLICATED) = pt_dt[].
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_duplicated COMPARING if_srm_key if_srm_item.

  DATA(lv_item_lines) = lines( pt_dt[] ).
  DATA(lv_duplicaed_lines) = lines( lt_duplicated ).

  IF lv_item_lines NE lv_duplicaed_lines.
    MODIFY pt_dt FROM VALUE #( if_type = 'E'
                               if_msg  = TEXT-m85 )             " 중복된 KEY 값이 존재합니다.
                                           TRANSPORTING if_type if_msg WHERE if_type IS INITIAL.

    MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type    = 'E'

      IF <fs_dt>-de_cre_ind IS NOT INITIAL. " 차후 차대변인 경우

      ELSE.
        "부대비 처리 시 무조건 차후차대변으로 진행. 지시자 필수체크
        "          *--부대비 처리 시 차후차대변 처리만 가능합니다!.
        " -> 변경 해당 I/F 무조건 차후차대변으로 처리
*--
        <fs_dt>-de_cre_ind = gc_x.  " 차후차대변 처리.
*            PERFORM error_out_item_0200 TABLES pt_out
*                                        USING <fs_dt>
*                                           'E'
*                                          TEXT-e46.
*            pv_err ='X'.
*            CONTINUE.



*        ""자재문서 참조 전표 처리 시 해당 전표로 참조되어 있는 유효한 송장이 있는 경우 에러 처리.
*        SELECT SINGLE b~menge
*          FROM rbkp AS a
*          INNER  JOIN rseg AS b
*          ON a~belnr EQ b~belnr
*         AND a~gjahr EQ b~gjahr
*          INNER JOIN  ekbz AS c
*          ON b~belnr EQ c~belnr
*          AND b~gjahr EQ c~gjahr
**          AND b~buzei EQ c~buzei
*          AND c~vgabe EQ '2' " 송장 이력
*          WHERE c~ebeln EQ @<fs_dt>-ebeln
*              AND c~ebelp EQ @<fs_dt>-ebelp
*              AND c~kschl EQ @<fs_dt>-kschl
*              AND a~stblg IS INITIAL
*             INTO @DATA(lV_MENGE).
*
*        IF sy-subrc NE 0.
*          PERFORM error_out_item_0200 TABLES pt_out
*                          USING <fs_dt>
*                             'E'
*                            TEXT-m93. "차후 차/대변 처리 시 해당 구매오더로 진행된 송장 내역이 존재해야 합니다.
*
*          pv_err ='X'.
*          CONTINUE.
*
*        ELSE.
*
*
*          DATA(ls_non_CHA) = VALUE #( pt_dt[
*                                    de_cre_ind = abap_false                         ] OPTIONAL ).
*          IF ls_non_cha IS NOT INITIAL.
*            PERFORM error_out_item_0200 TABLES pt_out
*                                        USING <fs_dt>
*                                           'E'
*                                          TEXT-m94. "차후 차/대변 처리 시 일반 송장 처리와 혼재하여 처리 불가능합니다.
*            pv_err ='X'.
*            CONTINUE.
*          ENDIF.
*
*          IF lv_menge <  <fs_dt>-kmenge.
*            PERFORM error_out_item_0200 TABLES pt_out
*                            USING <fs_dt>
*                               'E'
*                              TEXT-m95. "차후 차/대변 처리 시 기존 송장 수량을 초과할 수 없습니다.
*
*            pv_err ='X'.
*            CONTINUE.
*          ENDIF.
*
*
*        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
*-- 유효한 po 정보가 아닙니다.

      PERFORM error_out_item_0200 TABLES pt_out
                                  USING <fs_dt>
                                     'E'
                                    TEXT-m49.
      pv_err ='X'.
      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.
    "아이템 과액 확인용
    lv_wrbtr = lv_wrbtr + <fs_dt>-kwert.

  ENDLOOP.


  "에러통과 시 아이템 <-> 헤더 물대 과액 동일한지 비교
  IF pv_err IS INITIAL.

    IF ps_head-wrbtr1 NE lv_wrbtr.
      "헤더의 공급가액과 아이템 공급가액 합산이 다릅니다.
      pv_err = 'X'.
      MODIFY pt_dt FROM VALUE #( if_type = 'E'
                                 if_msg  = TEXT-m98 )
                                               TRANSPORTING if_type if_msg
                                               WHERE if_type IS INITIAL.

      MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type    = 'E'
                                  message = TEXT-m98 )
                                               TRANSPORTING type message
                                               WHERE type IS INITIAL.

    ENDIF.

  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form invoice_bapi_mm_0200
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_DT
*&      --> LT_OUT
*&      --> <FS_HEAD>
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM invoice_bapi_mm_0200 TABLES pt_dt STRUCTURE zmmt0205
                                                  pt_out STRUCTURE zmms_iv_create_out
                                                   USING  ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0200.

  " BAPI 변수
  DATA v_doc_item TYPE rblgp.
  DATA: ls_header TYPE zmms0030.
  DATA: lt_item   TYPE TABLE OF zmms0035.
  DATA: ls_item   TYPE zmms0035.
  DATA: lv_menge TYPE ekbe-menge.
  DATA: lv_wrbtr TYPE ekbe-wrbtr. "마감금액
  DATA: lv_wmwst TYPE bseg-wmwst. "세액
  DATA: lv_wrbtr_b TYPE ekbe-wrbtr. "잔액
  DATA: lv_wmwst_b TYPE bseg-wmwst. "잔액세액
  DATA: lv_lifnr TYPE ekko-lifnr.
  DATA: lv_last_group TYPE i.

  "bapi 리턴
  DATA: lv_status  TYPE bapi_mtype.
  DATA: lv_message TYPE bapi_msg.
  DATA: lv_belnr_iv LIKE rseg-belnr.
  DATA: lv_gjahr_iv LIKE rseg-gjahr.
  DATA : lv_bapi_fail TYPE bapibp_xfeld. "- 분할해서 인보이스를 전기할 때 하나라도 실패하면 'X'를 할당해서 전체를 롤백.
  DATA : lv_check TYPE c.
  DATA : lt_reduce TYPE TABLE OF zmmt0205.
  DATA  : lv_belnr_fi TYPE bseg-belnr.
  DATA  : lv_buzei TYPE buzei.
  TYPES l_ts_zmmt0205 TYPE zmmt0205.
  TYPES l_ts_zmmt0205_MENGE TYPE zmmt0205.
  " 송장 생성 이후 추적용


  DATA: BEGIN OF lt_update OCCURS 0, " 자재문서 생성 이후 품목 추적용
          if_srm_key TYPE zmmt0105-if_srm_key,
          group      TYPE zmmt0105-zgroup,
          belnr_fi   LIKE rseg-belnr,
          belnr_iv   LIKE rseg-belnr,
          buzei      LIKE bseg-buzei,
          Gjahr      LIKE rseg-gjahr,
        END OF lt_update.

  CLEAR : lv_wmwst_b.

  DATA(lt_dt) = pt_dt[].


  lt_reduce = CORRESPONDING #( pt_dt[] ). " 축약용 원본데이터 복사.
  DATA(lt_reduce_menge) = pt_dt[]."수량 축약용


  ""금액은 po 기준 , 수량은 bl,po 기준
  SORT lt_reduce BY ebeln ebelp zimbl.
  SORT lt_reduce BY ebeln ebelp zimbl.
  SORT lt_reduce_menge  BY zimbl ebeln ebelp.
  SORT lt_dt BY ebeln ebelp kschl.
  DELETE  ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_dt COMPARING ebeln ebelp.
  "수량 축약 시 구매오더, 지급조건, b/l 이 같은 건 동일 수량으로 간주한다.
  "bl, po 기준으로 sort 후 축약
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_reduce_menge COMPARING zimbl ebeln ebelp.

  SORT lt_dt BY if_srm_key if_srm_item ebeln ebelp.

  "'구매오더 중복 제거 후 진행
  PERFORM set_iv_group_0200 TABLES lt_dt
                                  CHANGING lv_last_group.

  SORT lt_dt BY if_srm_key if_srm_item ebeln ebelp zgroup.

*-- 수신받은 총 세액  잔액  계산용
  lv_wmwst_b = ps_head-wmwst. "헤더 세액
  lv_wrbtr_b = ps_head-wrbtr1. "헤더 공급가액


  LOOP AT lt_dt INTO DATA(ls_dt)
                   WHERE if_srm_key = ps_head-if_srm_key
                  GROUP BY ls_dt-zgroup
                  INTO DATA(ls_key).

    CLEAR : v_doc_item.

    LOOP AT GROUP ls_key INTO DATA(ls_loop).

      v_doc_item += 10.

      "--* 축약 *---------------------------------------------------------

      "송장 금액의 경우 지급조건, 구매오더 기준으로 축약
      "수량의 경우 지급조건 구매오더 B/L 기준으로 요약  위 8536 구문  중복제거에서 동일 B/L 지급조건은 송장 처리 시 동일 수량으로 간주

      DATA(ls_reduce) = REDUCE l_ts_zmmt0205( INIT hs_dt_reduce TYPE l_ts_zmmt0205 "-전표통화(KWERT) 압축해야 함.
                                                FOR <hs_dt_reduce> IN lt_reduce WHERE (     ebeln = ls_loop-ebeln
                                                                                           AND ebelp = ls_loop-ebelp
                                                                                             )
                                                NEXT hs_dt_reduce-kwert += <hs_dt_reduce>-kwert
                                                     hs_dt_reduce-kmenge += <hs_dt_reduce>-kmenge ).


      DATA(ls_reduce2) = REDUCE l_ts_zmmt0205_menge( INIT hs_dt_reduce_menge TYPE l_ts_zmmt0205_menge "- 수량(KMENGE),
                                                FOR <hs_dt_reduce_menge> IN lt_reduce_menge WHERE (     ebeln = ls_loop-ebeln
                                                                                           AND ebelp = ls_loop-ebelp

                                                                                           )
                                                NEXT hs_dt_reduce_menge-kwert += <hs_dt_reduce_menge>-kwert
                                                     hs_dt_reduce_menge-kmenge += <hs_dt_reduce_menge>-kmenge ).

      "--* 축약 *---------------------------------------------------------
      "중복 제거된 구매오더에 축약된 수량, 금액을 넣어준다.
      ls_loop-kwert = ls_reduce-kwert.

      "부대비 처리 시 수량은 B/L 구매오더 단위로 축약.
      Ls_loop-kmenge = ls_reduce2-kmenge.
      lv_wrbtr = lv_wrbtr + ls_loop-kwert.  "품목별 공급가액
      " ENDIF.

* Item
      PERFORM iv_item_0200 TABLES  lt_item
                                USING ps_head
                                           ls_loop
                                           v_doc_item.
    ENDLOOP.
    "*-- 그룹별 송장 처리 start
    "세액 계산

    PERFORM calculate_tax_from_net_amount USING ps_head-bukrs
                                                ps_head-mwskz
                                                ps_head-waers
                                                lv_wrbtr
                                       CHANGING lV_WMWST.  "세액

    IF lv_last_group > 1 AND ls_loop-zgroup EQ lv_last_group.
      "300건 초과로  송장 분할 처리 시
      "마지막 송장 처리에 계산 세액 말고 수신받은 세액 잔액으로 변환
      lv_wmwst = lv_wmwst_b.
      lv_wrbtr = lv_wrbtr_b.
    ENDIF.

    " 위 계산 로직에의 해 한 번 처리되는 송장의 경우 세액이 계산되는 경우가 있었음
    " if 금액과 일치시키기 위함
    IF lv_last_group = 1.

      lv_wmwst = ps_head-wmwst.
      lv_wrbtr = ps_head-wrbtr1. " IF 금액
    ENDIF.

** Header
    PERFORM iv_header_0200  USING ps_head
                                        lv_wrbtr " 수신 과액
                                        lv_wmwst " 수신 세액
                          CHANGING   ls_header.

* 송장문서 생성 BAPI
    CLEAR: lv_status, lv_message.
    call function 'ZMM_IV_CREATE'
      EXPORTING
        is_header    = ls_header
        iv_cmt_in_fm = abap_false " 전체 건 성공 시 커밋
        iv_text      = ps_head-sgtxt
        iv_import    = 'X' " 수입부대비
      IMPORTING
        ev_belnr     = lv_belnr_iv
        ev_gjahr     = lv_gjahr_iv
        ev_status    = lv_status
        ev_message   = lv_message
      TABLES
        it_item      = lt_item.

    IF lv_status = 'S'. "- 성공일 땐 결과를 축적.

* 자재문서 생성 이후 품목 번호 추적 매핑
      lt_update-if_srm_key  = ls_loop-if_srm_key.
      lt_update-group = ls_loop-zgroup.
      lt_update-belnr_iv   = lv_belnr_iv.
      lt_update-gjahr   = lv_gjahr_iv.

      APPEND lt_update.

    ELSE. "- 실패하면 롤백할 것이므로 축적된 결과를 다 지우고 에러 메시지만 입력.

      lv_check = 'X'.
      lv_bapi_fail     = abap_true.
      EXIT. "- LOOP EXIT.
    ENDIF.

    lV_WRBTR_B = lV_WRBTR_B - lV_WRBTR. "마지막 잔액 기입을 위함
    lV_WMWST_B = lV_WMWST_B - lV_WMWST. " 마지막 그룹 처리 시 잔액 기입을 위함

    CLEAR: ls_header, lt_item[].
    CLEAR: lv_wrbtr, lv_wmwst.

  ENDLOOP.

  IF lV_BAPI_FAIL = abap_true.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.

    PERFORM error USING  ps_head
                         'E'
                         lv_message.

  ELSE.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
      EXPORTING
        wait = abap_true.

    PERFORM error USING  ps_head
                     'S'
                     TEXT-m57.  "'Success'.

    ""fi문서 get
    SORT lt_update BY group.
    SORT pt_dt BY if_srm_key if_srm_item zgroup.

    LOOP AT lt_update.
      ""fi 문서 get
      PERFORM get_fi_doc USING lt_update-belnr_iv lt_update-gjahr
                      CHANGING lt_update-belnr_fi.

      IF lt_update-belnr_fi IS NOT INITIAL.

        PERFORM get_fi_doc_item USING lt_update-belnr_FI lt_update-gjahr
                        CHANGING lt_update-buzei.

      ENDIF.

      MODIFY lt_update TRANSPORTING belnr_fi buzei.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.

  "PO 축약해서 처리한 내역 추출 - > 추출 후 그룹핑 내역
  SORT lt_dt BY if_srm_key ebeln ebelp zgroup.

  LOOP AT pt_dt ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).

    <fs_item>-if_type     = ps_head-if_type.
    <fs_item>-if_msg      = ps_head-if_msg.

*--11080 라인에 정렬 후 po 기준으로 축약해서 처리한 그룹번호 매핑 후 송장 처리 내역 매핑
    READ TABLE lt_dt INTO DATA(ls_dt_done) WITH KEY if_srm_key = <fs_item>-if_srm_key
                                                                                                    ebeln = <fs_item>-ebeln
                                                                                                   ebelp = <fs_item>-ebelp
                                                                                                  BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      <fs_item>-zgroup = ls_dt_done-zgroup.
    ENDIF.


    IF lv_bapi_fail IS INITIAL.

      READ TABLE lt_update INTO DATA(ls_update) WITH KEY group = <fs_item>-zgroup.

      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

        <fs_item>-belnr     = ls_update-belnr_iv.
        <fs_item>-gjahr     = ls_update-gjahr.
        <fs_item>-belnr_fi     = ls_update-belnr_fi.
        <fs_item>-buzei     = ls_update-buzei.
      ENDIF.

    ELSE.
      "실패된 데이터

*-- 송장 처리에 성공했지만 동일 KEY 데이터가 실패한 경우 생성되었지만 롤백된 송장번호 삭제
      IF <fs_item>-belnr IS NOT INITIAL.


        CLEAR : <fs_item>-belnr, <fs_item>-gjahr, <fs_item>-belnr_fi, <fs_item>-buzei.
        <fs_item>-gjahr     = abap_false.        <fs_item>-if_msg     = TEXT-m63. " 다른 항목의 에러로 실패.


      ENDIF.



    ENDIF.

    MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type     = ps_head-if_type
                                message  = ps_head-iF_MSG
                                belnr_iv = ls_update-belnr_iv
                                belnr_fi = ls_update-belnr_fi
                                buzei    = ls_update-buzei
                                gjahr    = ls_update-gjahr )                                                                                  " 성공 업데이트
                                            TRANSPORTING type message belnr_iv belnr_fi gjahr buzei
                                                    WHERE if_srm_key EQ <fs_item>-if_srm_key
                                                          AND if_srm_item EQ <fs_item>-if_srm_item.
  ENDLOOP.


*-- 송장 그룹핑 수정으로 인한 2025.05.22 OLD LOGIC

*  IF lv_status = 'S'. "- 성공
*
*    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
*      EXPORTING
*        wait = abap_true.
*
*    PERFORM error USING  ps_head
*                     'S'
*                     TEXT-m57.  "'Success'.
*    "fi 회계문서 get
*    PERFORM get_fi_doc USING lv_belnr_iv lv_gjahr_iv
*                    CHANGING lv_belnr_fi.
*
*    IF lv_belnr_fi IS NOT INITIAL.
*
*      PERFORM get_fi_doc_item USING lv_belnr_FI lv_gjahr_iv
*                      CHANGING lv_buzei.
*
*    ENDIF.
*
*
*  ELSE. "- 실패하면 롤백할 것이므로 축적된 결과를 다 지우고 에러 메시지만 입력.
*
*    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.
*
*    PERFORM error USING  ps_head
*                         'E'
*                         lv_message.
*
*  ENDIF.

*  LOOP AT pt_dt ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).
*
*    <fs_item>-if_type     = ps_head-if_type.
*    <fs_item>-if_msg      = ps_head-if_msg.
*
*
*    IF lv_bapi_fail IS INITIAL.
*
*      <fs_item>-belnr     = lv_belnr_iv.
*      <fs_item>-belnr_fi     = lv_belnr_fi.
*      <fs_item>-gjahr     = lv_gjahr_iv.
*      <fs_item>-buzei     = lv_buzei.
*
*    ELSE.
*      "실패된 데이터
*
*
*
*    ENDIF.
*
*    MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type     = ps_head-if_type
*                                message  = ps_head-iF_MSG
*                                belnr_iv = lv_belnr_iv
*                                belnr_fi = lv_belnr_fi
*                                gjahr    = lv_gjahr_iv
*                                buzei    = lv_buzei )                                                                  " 성공 업데이트
*                                            TRANSPORTING type message belnr_iv belnr_fi gjahr buzei
*                                                    WHERE if_srm_key EQ <fs_item>-if_srm_key
*                                                          AND if_srm_item EQ <fs_item>-if_srm_item.
*
*  ENDLOOP.





ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form iv_header_0200
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PS_HEAD
*&      --> LV_WRBTR
*&      --> LV_WMWST
*&      <-- LS_HEADER
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM iv_header_0200 USING ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0200
                                  pv_wrbtr
                                  pv_wmwst
                CHANGING ps_header STRUCTURE zmms0030.

  DATA: lv_dmbtr TYPE dmbtr.
  CLEAR ps_header.
*
*  IF ps_head-gubun = '1'. "내자인 경우 인보이스 인디케이터 체크
*    ps_header-xrech = 'X'. "INVOICE INDICATOR
*  ELSE.
*    ps_header-xrech = abap_off. "INVOICE INDICATOR
*  ENDIF.

  ps_header-blart = 'RE'.            "전표 유형
  ps_header-bldat = ps_head-bldat. "전표 증빙일
  ps_header-budat = ps_head-budat. "전표의 전기일
  ps_header-bukrs = ps_head-bukrs.    "회사 코드
  ps_header-bupla = ps_head-bupla. " 사업장
  ps_header-waers = ps_head-waers.   "통화 키
  ps_header-bvtyp = ps_head-bvtyp.   "은행유형 - srm 지급계좌내용 * 2024.02.20
  ps_header-zlsch = ps_head-zlsch.   "지급방법 2025.03.06
  ps_header-mwskz = ps_head-mwskz.  "세금코드
  ps_header-xrech = ps_head-invoice_ind. "송장 처리 지시자.

  ps_header-lifre = ps_head-lifnr.  "발행처
  ps_header-bktxt = ps_head-bktxt.   "전자 세금계산서 번호
  ps_header-zterm = ps_head-zterm.   "지급조건
  ps_header-kursf = ps_head-exch_rate. " 환율

  CLEAR lv_dmbtr.
  lv_dmbtr = pv_wrbtr + pv_wmwst. "총액

  PERFORM bapi_currency_conv_to_external USING ps_head-waers
                                               lv_dmbtr
                                      CHANGING ps_header-wrbtr. "총액

  PERFORM bapi_currency_conv_to_external USING ps_head-waers
                                             pv_wmwst
                                    CHANGING ps_header-wmwst. "세액


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form if_data_vaild_iv_canc_IM
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_LIST_KEY[]
*&      --> LT_SAVE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM if_data_vaild_iv_canc_IM TABLES pt_key STRUCTURE zmmt0210
                                                pt_list STRUCTURE zmmt0210.


  SORT pt_key BY if_srm_key.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM pt_key[] COMPARING if_srm_key.

*-- IF KEY 송장 수신 이력.
  SELECT *
    FROM zmmt0205
    FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @pt_key[]
    WHERE if_srm_key = @pt_key-if_srm_key
        AND if_type = 'S'
        AND belnr IS NOT INITIAL
       INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_0205).

  SORT lt_0205 BY if_srm_key belnr.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_0205 COMPARING belnr. " 처리된 송장 중복 제거


  " IF KEY에 진행된 송장 수량을 취소시 동일한 수량으로 받아야함.
  LOOP AT pt_key INTO DATA(ls_key).

    "송장 처리 이력
    DATA(lv_old) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR wa IN lt_0205 WHERE ( if_srm_key = ls_key-if_srm_key )
                                         NEXT sum = sum + 1 ).

    "신규 취소 처리 요청
    DATA(lv_new) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR wa2 IN pt_list WHERE ( if_srm_key = ls_key-if_srm_key )
                                         NEXT sum = sum + 1 ).

*-- KEY 별 신규 취소 요청과 기존 송장 이력 카운트 차이 시 에러.

    IF lv_new NE lv_old.
*      DATA(lv_msg) = |{({ lv_new })과 기존 송장 이력 수량({ lv_old })이 다릅니다.|.
      MESSAGE s042(zmmm10) WITH lv_old lv_new INTO DATA(lv_msg).
      ls_key-if_msg = lv_msg.
      ls_key-if_type = 'E'.
      MODIFY pt_key FROM ls_key TRANSPORTING if_msg if_type.
    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form error_out_item_0200
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> PT_OUT
*&      --> <FS_DT>
*&      --> P_
*&      --> TEXT_M58
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM error_out_item_0200 TABLES pt_out STRUCTURE zmms_iv_create_out
                                                USING ps_dt STRUCTURE  zmmt0205
                                                                                     pv_type
                                                                                pv_message.

*- CBO테이블 결과값 저장
  ASSIGN COMPONENT 'IF_TYPE' OF STRUCTURE PS_dt TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_if_type>).
  IF <fs_if_type> IS ASSIGNED.
    <fs_if_type> = pv_type.
  ENDIF.

*- CBO테이블 결과값 저장
  ASSIGN COMPONENT 'IF_MSG' OF STRUCTURE PS_dt TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS_IF_msg>).
  IF <fs_if_msg> IS ASSIGNED.
    <fs_if_msg> = pv_message.
  ENDIF.

  """output data
  MODIFY pt_out FROM VALUE #( type    = pv_type
                              message = pv_message )             " 유효한 po 정보가 아닙니다.
                                         TRANSPORTING type message WHERE if_srm_key = ps_dt-if_srm_key
                                                                                 AND if_srm_item = ps_dt-if_srm_item.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form iv_or_subsequent_debit
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_DT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM iv_or_subsequent_debit TABLES pt_dt STRUCTURE zmmt0205
                                                   pt_out STRUCTURE zmms_iv_create_out
                                          USING  ps_head STRUCTURE zmmt0200
                                          CHANGING pv_err.



  "B/L 번호 기준 처음 입력 시 송장. 기처리내역  존재 시  차후차변
  DATA : ls_check LIKE zmmt0205.
  DATA : lv_indi TYPE char1.
  LOOP AT pt_dt INTO DATA(ls_dt).

    SELECT SINGLE a~mandt
      FROM zmmt0200 AS a
      INNER JOIN zmmt0205 AS b
      ON a~if_srm_key EQ b~if_srm_key
      INNER JOIN rseg AS c
      ON b~belnr EQ c~belnr
      AND b~gjahr EQ c~gjahr
      INNER JOIN rbkp AS d
      ON c~belnr EQ d~belnr
      AND d~gjahr EQ d~gjahr
      AND d~stblg IS INITIAL
      WHERE b~ebeln EQ @ls_dt-ebeln " PO
          AND b~ebelp EQ @ls_dt-ebelp "PO ITEM
          AND b~zimbl EQ @ls_dt-zimbl " B/L
*          AND b~kschl EQ @ls_dt-kschl A " 조건 유형 별 확인하는 로직은 부대비 처리시 수신받지 않는 것으로 변경되어서 주석처리.
           INTO @DATA(ls_iv).

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
      "해당 B/L + PO로 진행된 송장이력이 있으면 차후 차변 없으면 송장.
      ls_dt-de_cre_ind = 'X'.
      MODIFY pt_dt FROM ls_dt TRANSPORTING de_cre_ind.
    ELSE.

    ENDIF.

  ENDLOOP.

  "위 로직으로 B/L 기처리 내역을 확인하여 송장 처리 대상인지 차후차변 대상인지 구분되었음.
  "송장 처리 시 구매오더는 같지만 다른 B/L 번호인 경우 B/L 번호에 의해 동일한 PO이지만 송장, 차후차변 처리방식이
  "다른 경우가 발생 이 경우 동시에 처리할수없다고 에러 리턴. 시스템의 처리 기준은 PO 이기 떄문에...


  DATA(lt_dt) = pt_dt[].
  SORT lt_dt BY ebeln ebelp zimbl de_cre_ind.
  SORT pt_dt BY ebeln ebelp zimbl.

  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_dt COMPARING ebeln ebelp zimbl de_cre_ind.

  LOOP AT pt_dt ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dt>).

    "동일 구매오더지만 B/L에 의해 다른 처리방식이 있는지 확인
    CASE <fs_dt>-de_cre_ind.
      WHEN gc_x.
        "차후차변인 경우 송장 처리 대상이 있는지
        lv_indi = abap_false.
      WHEN abap_false.
        "송장인 경우 차후차변 대상이 있는지
        lv_indi = gc_x.
    ENDCASE.

    ls_check = VALUE #( lt_dt[ ebeln      = <fs_dt>-ebeln
                               ebelp      = <fs_dt>-ebelp
                               de_cre_ind = lv_indi ] OPTIONAL ).

    "동일 구매오더지만 다른 처리 방식이 있는 경우 에러 처리
    IF ls_check IS NOT INITIAL.
      "입력 할 수 없는 형식입니다. BL번호를 하나로 통합해주세요.
      DATA(lv_msg) =  TEXT-e20 &&  |{ <fs_dt>-zimbl }/{ ls_check-zimbl }|.
      PERFORM error_out_item_0200 TABLES pt_out
                                  USING <fs_dt>
                                     'E'
                                    lv_msg.
      pv_err ='X'.
      CONTINUE.


    ENDIF.

    CLEAR : ls_check, lv_msg.

  ENDLOOP.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form datax_pohead
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM datax_pohead USING p_field01
                   CHANGING ps_datax STRUCTURE bapimepoheaderx
                            ps_data STRUCTURE bapimepoheader
                     .

  FIELD-SYMBOLS :<datax>, <cnt>, <val>, <data>.
  DATA : l_n TYPE n LENGTH 2.
  DATA : fieldname(30).
  CLEAR : ps_datax, fieldname, l_n.

  DO 1 TIMES.
    ADD 1 TO l_n.
    CONCATENATE 'p_field' l_n INTO fieldname.
    ASSIGN (fieldname) TO <cnt>.
    ASSIGN (fieldname) TO <val>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF <val> IS NOT INITIAL.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <val> OF STRUCTURE ps_data TO <data>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
***>> ps_data가 존재하면 ps_datax를 설정하기 ***********************************
          IF <data> IS NOT INITIAL.
            IF <cnt> IS NOT INITIAL.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT <cnt> OF STRUCTURE ps_datax TO <datax>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                <datax> = 'X'.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
***<< ps_data가 존재하면 ps_datax를 설정하기 ***********************************
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDDO.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form MM_PRICE_CONDITON
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LS_LIST
*&      <-- LV_TYPE
*&      <-- LV_MSG
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM mm_price_conditon USING ps_list STRUCTURE zmms_info_item
                        CHANGING pv_type
                                 pv_msg.

  DATA:
    it_bapicondct  TYPE tt_bapicondct,
    it_bapicondhd  TYPE tt_bapicondhd,
    it_bapicondit  TYPE tt_bapicondit,
    it_bapicondqs  TYPE tt_bapicondqs,
    it_bapicondvs  TYPE tt_bapicondvs,
    it_bapiret2    TYPE tt_bapiret2,
    it_bapiknumhs  TYPE tt_bapiknumhs,
    it_men_initial TYPE tt_mem_initial.


  " KEY 업데이트
  DATA : l_key LIKE bapicondct-varkey.


  CONSTANTS : lc_999(3)         VALUE '999', " 조건 테이블 '기본 값 'A999'
*                     LC_OPERAITON(3) VALUE '009',
*                     LC_COND_USAGE(1) VALUE 'A',  "
*                     LC_APPLICATION(1) VALUE 'M',
              lc_con_no_new(10) VALUE '$000000001'.
*                     LC_COND_TYPE(4) VALUE 'ZPDP',


  "업데이트 테이블명
  DATA(l_table_no) = '999'. "
  "Create new condition - 009, Change - 004, Delete - 003
*  DATA(l_operation) = COND #( WHEN ps_list-status IS INITIAL THEN gc_009 " NEW CONDITON
*                                        WHEN ps_list-status EQ gc_x THEN gc_004 " CHANGE CONDITON
*                                         WHEN ps_list-status EQ gc_d THEN gc_003 ). " DELETE
*
*
*  DATA(l_cond_usage) = COND #( WHEN ps_list-status IS INITIAL THEN gc_009 " NEW CONDITON
*                                      WHEN ps_list-status EQ gc_x THEN gc_004 " CHANGE CONDITON
*                                       WHEN ps_list-status EQ gc_d THEN gc_003 ). " DELETE

  DATA(l_operation) = gc_009.
  DATA(l_cond_usage) = gc_a.
  DATA(l_application) = gc_m. " M 구매
  DATA(l_cond_no) = lc_con_no_new. "新規登#時に使用するダミ#の#件レコ#ド番# " 신규 생성 $000000001'.
  DATA(l_cond_type) = 'ZPDP'.
  DATA(l_valid_from) = '20251215'.
  DATA(l_valid_to) = '99990101'.


  " BAPI 업데이트 시 자재번호는 18 자리로 들어가야합니다. 넘어갈시 업데이트 안됨.
  DATA(lv_matnr) = |{ ps_list-matnr ALPHA = IN WIDTH = 18 }|.

  " BAPI 업데이트 시 해당 KEY로 A999 테이블 업데이트
  "  CONCATENATE ps_list-werks lv_matnr ps_list-esokz INTO l_key.
  l_key = |{ ps_list-bukrs }{ lv_matnr }{ ps_list-esokz }|.


  it_bapicondct = VALUE #(
   ( operation  = l_operation
     cond_usage = l_cond_usage
     table_no   = l_table_no
     applicatio = l_application
     cond_type  = l_cond_type
     varkey     = l_key " A999 DB 업데이트 키
     valid_to   = ps_list-datbi " 효력 종료일
     valid_from = ps_list-datab " 효력시작일
     cond_no    = l_cond_no )
  ).

  it_bapicondhd = VALUE #(
    ( operation  = l_operation
      cond_no    = l_cond_no
      created_by = sy-uname
      creat_date = sy-datum
      cond_usage = l_cond_usage
      table_no   = l_table_no
      applicatio = l_application
      cond_type  = l_cond_type
      varkey     = l_key
*   varkey = l_varkey
*   varkey = ls_999key
      valid_from = l_valid_from
      valid_to   = l_valid_to )
  ).
  it_bapicondit = VALUE #(
    ( operation  = l_operation
      cond_no    = l_cond_no
      cond_count = '01'
      applicatio = l_application
      cond_type  = l_cond_type
      scaletype  = 'A'
*    scalebasin = ''
*    scale_qty = '0'
      cond_p_unt = '1'
      cond_unit  = 'EA' "NOT PC
      calctypcon = 'C'
*      cond_value = ps_list-predpr "예측단가
      condcurr   = ps_list-waers )
  ).


  " CREATE BAPI

  CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_PRICES_CONDITIONS'
*  EXPORTING
**    pi_initialmode = 'X'
**PI_BLOCKNUMBER =
*    PI_PHYSICAL_DELETION = abap_on "OFFにしても#動#係なし
    TABLES
      ti_bapicondct  = it_bapicondct
      ti_bapicondhd  = it_bapicondhd
      ti_bapicondit  = it_bapicondit
      ti_bapicondqs  = it_bapicondqs
      ti_bapicondvs  = it_bapicondvs
      to_bapiret2    = it_bapiret2
      to_bapiknumhs  = it_bapiknumhs
      to_mem_initial = it_men_initial
    EXCEPTIONS
      update_error   = 1
      OTHERS         = 2.


  IF sy-subrc = 0.
    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
      EXPORTING
        wait = 'X'.
*   IMPORTING
*     RETURN        =    .
  ELSE.

*  MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE sy-msgty NUMBER sy-msgno
*  WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.
  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form goods_cancel_541
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LS_LIST
*&      <-- O_RETURN
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM goods_cancel_541 USING ps_list STRUCTURE zmms_po_gr_zic_canc_header
                                     PS_out STRUCTURE zmms_po_gr_zic_canc_return.

  DATA: ls_head   TYPE bapi2017_gm_head_02,
        lt_item   TYPE TABLE OF bapi2017_gm_item_04 WITH HEADER LINE,
        ls_cancel TYPE bapi2017_gm_head_ret,  " 취소문서
        lv_mjahr  TYPE bapi2017_gm_head_02-doc_year,
        lt_return TYPE TABLE OF bapiret2 WITH HEADER LINE.
*  DATA : lv_msg TYPE bapi_msg.
  DATA(ls_list) = ps_list.

  "직납테이블 0051 기처리내역 확인 존재 시 기처리 내역 처리

  SELECT SINGLE a~if_srm_key, a~if_srm_item, a~mblnr, a~mjahr
    FROM zmmt0051 AS a
    INNER JOIN zmmt0180 AS b
    ON a~zic_vbeln EQ b~vbeln
    AND a~zic_posnr EQ b~posnr
    WHERE a~db_type EQ @gc_s
          AND a~smbln IS INITIAL
          AND b~mblnr EQ @ls_list-mblnr
          AND b~mjahr EQ @ls_list-mjahr
   INTO @DATA(ls_0051).

  IF ls_0051 IS INITIAL.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.


  CHECK lS_0051 IS NOT INITIAL.

  ls_head-mat_doc  = ls_0051-mblnr. " LOG 자재문서
  ls_head-doc_date = ls_list-budat."전기일은 수신 전기일
  ls_head-doc_year = ls_0051-mjahr.
*
  CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_GOODSMVT_CANCEL'
    EXPORTING
      materialdocument    = ls_head-mat_doc
      matdocumentyear     = ls_head-doc_year
      goodsmvt_pstng_date = ls_head-doc_date
    IMPORTING
      goodsmvt_headret    = ls_cancel
    TABLES
      return              = lt_return.
*
  READ TABLE lt_return WITH KEY type = 'E'.
*
  IF sy-subrc = 0.
*
    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.
    DATA(lv_type)    = 'E'.
    DATA(lv_message) =  TEXT-e56 && lt_return-message. " 선행된 직납 취소에 대해 실패했습니다.

  ELSE.
*
    "직납 테이블 0051에 직납 취소한 문서 업데이트
    UPDATE zmmt0051 SET smbln = @ls_cancel-mat_doc,
                                 sjahr = @ls_cancel-doc_year,
                                 db_msg = @text-s03
                                WHERE mblnr EQ @ls_0051-mblnr
                                AND mjahr EQ @ls_0051-mjahr.

    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.

      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
        EXPORTING
          wait = 'X'.


    ELSE.
*
      CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.
      ps_out-type = gc_e.
      ps_out-errcode = 'E19'.
      ps_out-message   = TEXT-e56. "직납 취소 중 에러가 발생했습니다.

    ENDIF.
*
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form check_available_sc_stock
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_LOG
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_available_sc_stock TABLES pt_log STRUCTURE zmmt0050.

  DATA(lt_header) = pt_log[].
  DATA(lt_sub) = pt_log[].

  SORT lt_SUB BY if_srm_key if_srm_item if_srm_sub.

  DELETE lt_sub WHERE if_srm_sub IS INITIAL AND if_gubun NE gc_c."구성부품만 체크, 입고 시에만 체크

  CHECK lt_sub[] IS NOT INITIAL.

  SELECT a~matnr, a~charg, a~werks, a~lifnr, a~lblab,
      b~if_srm_key, b~if_srm_item, b~if_srm_sub
        FROM mslb AS a
        INNER JOIN @lt_sub AS b
       ON a~matnr EQ b~matnr
       AND a~werks EQ b~werks
      AND a~charg EQ b~charg
      INNER JOIN ekko AS c
    ON a~lifnr EQ c~lifnr
    AND b~ebeln EQ c~ebeln
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_mslb)
    ##ITAB_KEY_IN_SELECT.

  SORT lt_mslb BY if_srm_key if_srm_item if_srm_sub werks lifnr matnr charg lblab.


  LOOP AT pt_log ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_log>) WHERE if_srm_sub IS NOT INITIAL AND if_gubun EQ gc_c.

    DATA(ls_sc) = VALUE #( lt_mslb[ IF_SRM_kEY  = <fs_log>-if_srm_key
                                    if_srm_item = <fs_log>-if_srm_item
                                    if_srm_sub  = <fs_log>-if_srm_sub ] OPTIONAL ).

    IF ls_sc IS NOT INITIAL.
      "공급업체 재고가 입력 수량보다 작은 경우
      IF lS_SC-lblab < <fs_log>-erfmg.
        DATA(lv_matnr_o) = |{ <fs_log>-matnr ALPHA = OUT }|.
        MESSAGE s003(zmmm30) INTO DATA(lv_msg) WITH lv_matnr_o ls_sc-lblab <fs_log>-erfmg.
        PERFORM error USING
                            <fs_log>
                            'E'
                            lv_msg. "-- 공급업체 재고 & , 입력 수량 & 재고가 부족합니다.

      ENDIF.

    ELSE.

      PERFORM error USING
                          <fs_log>
                          'E'
                          TEXT-e58. "-- 공급업체에 존재하지 않는 자재코드입니다.

    ENDIF.

    CLEAR : ls_sc, lv_msg ,lv_matnr_o.

  ENDLOOP.


ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form sap_to_mes_1003
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_0050
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM sap_to_mes_1003 TABLES pt_0050 STRUCTURE zmmt0050.

  DATA : lt_0400 LIKE TABLE OF zmmt0400."입출고 확정정보 MES 전송 : 포승플랜트 1003
  DATA : lS_0400 LIKE zmmt0400."입출고 확정정보 MES 전송 : 포승플랜트 1003
  DATA : lt_send LIKE TABLE OF zmms_po_gr_sap_to_mes_in.
  DATA : ls_send LIKE zmms_po_gr_sap_to_mes_in.
  DATA : ls_return LIKE zsifmsg.
  CLEAR : lt_0400.

  DATA(lt_gr) = pt_0050[].
  SORT lt_gr BY werks mjahr mblnr zeile if_srm_key if_srm_item if_srm_sub ebeln if_gubun.

  DELETE lt_gr WHERE if_srm_sub IS NOT INITIAL. "임가공 하위품목 수신 이력은 제거
  DELETE lt_gr WHERE werks NE '1003'. "1003 포승플랜트만 대상
*-- MES 취소 제외 요청으로 입고 이외 제외
  DELETE lt_gr WHERE if_gubun NE gc_c.

  LOOP AT lt_gr INTO DATA(ls_gr).

*--전송 log
    ls_0400-mjahr = ls_gr-mjahr. "자재문서
    ls_0400-mblnr = ls_gr-mblnr. "자재문서연도
    ls_0400-zeile = ls_gr-zeile. "항목

    ls_0400-ebeln = ls_gr-ebeln. "PO
    ls_0400-ebelp = ls_gr-ebelp. "PO 품목
    ls_0400-budat = ls_gr-budat. "전기일
    ls_0400-matnr = ls_gr-matnr. "자재코드
    ls_0400-werks = ls_gr-werks. "플랜트
    ls_0400-charg = ls_gr-charg. "배치
    ls_0400-menge = ls_gr-erfmg. "입고수량
    ls_0400-meins = ls_gr-meins. "입고단위
    ls_0400-ernam = sy-uname. "생성자
    ls_0400-erzet = sy-timlo. "입고수량
    ls_0400-erdat = sy-datum. "생성일

    APPEND ls_0400 TO lt_0400.

*--전송 DATA

*--전송 log
    ls_send-ebeln = ls_gr-ebeln. "po
    ls_send-ebelp = ls_gr-ebelp. "po 품목
    ls_send-mjahr = ls_gr-mjahr. "자재문서
    ls_send-mblnr = ls_gr-mblnr. "자재문서연도
    ls_send-zeile = ls_gr-zeile. "항목

    "구분자는 펑션에서 제어 - MES  기준 모호로 계속 내용이 변경됨으로 확정 후 수정 예정
**-- SRM 입고 = C 인 경우 MES (1) - 입고 , SRM 입고 취소 = D 인 경우 MES (1) - 입고 ,
*    ls_send-gubun = COND #( WHEN ls_gr-if_gubun EQ gc_c THEN gc_1
*                                              WHEN ls_gr-if_gubun EQ gc_d THEN gc_3 ) .

    ls_send-budat = ls_gr-budat. "전기일
    ls_send-matnr = ls_gr-matnr. "자재코드
    ls_send-charg = ls_gr-charg. "배치
    ls_send-lgort = ls_gr-lgort. "저장위치
    ls_send-menge = ls_gr-erfmg. "수량
    ls_send-meins = ls_gr-meins. "단위

    APPEND ls_send TO lt_send.

  ENDLOOP.

  CHECK lt_send[] IS NOT INITIAL.

  call function 'ZMMIF_PO_GR_SAP_TO_MES'
    IMPORTING
      o_return = ls_return
    TABLES
      t_data   = lt_send[].

  "log 처리
  MODIFY lt_0400 FROM VALUE #( if_date  = sy-datum
                               if_time  = sy-timlo
                               if_uname = sy-uname
                               if_type  = COND #( WHEN ls_return-type EQ gc_s THEN gc_s
                               ELSE gc_e )
                               if_msg   = COND #( WHEN ls_return-message IS NOT INITIAL THEN
                             ls_return-message ELSE COND #( WHEN ls_return-type EQ gc_s THEN TEXT-s06
                             ELSE TEXT-e70 ) ) )
                                                      TRANSPORTING if_date if_time if_type if_msg if_uname WHERE if_type IS INITIAL.


  MODIFY zmmt0400 FROM TABLE lt_0400.

  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& Form set_iv_group_0200
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*& text
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      --> LT_DT
*&      <-- LV_LAST_GROUP
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM set_iv_group_0200 TABLES pt_dt STRUCTURE zmmt0205
                                  CHANGING pv_last_group.

  CONSTANTS lc_1000(4) TYPE c VALUE '1000'.

  DATA : lv_cnt_group TYPE i VALUE '230'.
  DATA : lv_group TYPE sy-index  VALUE 1,
         lv_cnt   TYPE i.

  CLEAR : lv_cnt.


  ""내자 송장 처리 시 아이템이 900건이 넘어갈 수 있어 분할 처리( 회계문서 항목 999으로 인해)
  "분할 처리 시 가격 단차 발생으로 인해  다음 로직에 단차 방지 로직 추가
  " 그룹핑된 아이템이 10개 이하인 경우 이전 그룹에 포함하여 처리.


  LOOP AT pt_dt INTO DATA(ls_dt).
    ls_dt-zgroup = lv_group.
    lv_cnt = lv_cnt + 1.

    IF lv_cnt = lv_cnt_group.
      lv_group = lv_group + 1.
      CLEAR lv_cnt.
    ENDIF.

    MODIFY pt_dt FROM ls_dt TRANSPORTING zgroup.
  ENDLOOP.


  ""요청사항으로 300번 씩 그룹핑했지만 마지막 그룹의 대상 아이템이 수가 적은 경우
  "
  DATA(lv_lines) = lines( pt_dt ).

  IF lv_lines > lv_cnt_group. " 300건 넘어 가는 경우

    ""처리 후 마지막 그룹 번호 확인.
    DATA(lt_last_group) = pt_dt[].
    SORT lt_last_group BY zgroup.
    DELETE  lt_last_group WHERE zgroup NE lv_group.

    DATA(lv_lines_last) = lines( lt_last_group ).

*    IF  lv_lines_last > 0 AND lv_lines_last <= 10. " 마지막 라인의 처리 수량이 1~10이면 이전 그룹과 같이 처리
*
*      MODIFY pt_dt FROM VALUE #( zgroup = lv_group - 1 )
*                                             TRANSPORTING zgroup WHERE zgroup EQ lv_group.
*
*    ENDIF.


  ENDIF.


  pv_last_group = lv_group. "마지막 그룹번호 리턴


ENDFORM.
